66407.recognize_zh: 一顆分葉核的嗜中性球，細胞質內可見數個深藍色小點狀包涵體，其中三顆排成一串，另有一個小桿狀與一個有角的深染顆粒；但這些顆粒約僅 1 µm、看不到透明暈，比典型組織漿菌（2–4 µm、有假莢膜暈）小，需與細菌或染劑沉澱鑑別。
features: Mature neutrophil with a segmented nucleus and abundant finely granular cytoplasm
Several small (about 1 um) dark basophilic intracytoplasmic bodies, including three dots in a short chain, a short rod, and an angular dark particle
The inclusions lack the clear halo/pseudocapsule and 2-4 um size typical of Histoplasma yeasts in smears
A small cytoplasmic vacuole is present near the nucleus
Background red cells are unremarkable; scattered tiny platelets
66407.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature segmented neutrophil with finely granular cytoplasm and a small cytoplasmic vacuole. The cytoplasm contains several tiny dark basophilic bodies, including a short chain of three dots, a short rod, and an angular particle. These inclusions are smaller than typical Histoplasma yeasts (2-4 um) and lack a surrounding clear halo, so on this image alone they cannot be confidently distinguished from phagocytosed bacteria or overlying stain precipitate. In the context of the companion images showing haloed yeasts in leukocytes, findings are compatible with, but not diagnostic of, peripheral blood involvement by disseminated histoplasmosis; blood cultures and Histoplasma antigen testing are recommended.

ddx.dx: Phagocytosed bacteria (bacteremia, e.g., streptococci or Gram-negative rods)
ddx.vs: Bacteria are about 1 um, stain uniformly dark without a halo, and may form chains or rods, whereas Histoplasma yeasts are 2-4 um oval forms with a clear halo and a crescent of stained cytoplasm.
Precipitate is refractile, variably sized, and lies in a different focal plane or also over red cells and background, rather than being strictly intracytoplasmic.
Morulae are mulberry-like clusters of tiny basophilic granules within a single membrane-bound inclusion rather than separate dots and rods.
Döhle bodies are pale blue-grey peripheral cytoplasmic patches and toxic granules are uniformly distributed dark granules, neither forming discrete chains or rods.

66343.recognize_zh: 骨小樑之間的骨髓腔被片狀、細胞質豐富且淡粉紅灰色、呈細纖維至泡沫狀的大型組織球取代，核小而偏位、分布稀疏，殘存造血細胞被擠到邊緣，符合儲積症巨噬細胞（storage cell）浸潤。
features: Diffuse sheets of large histiocytes filling the intertrabecular marrow space
Abundant pale eosinophilic-grey cytoplasm with a fibrillary to finely foamy texture and indistinct cell borders
Small round to oval bland nuclei, often eccentric, with low N:C ratio
Scattered small lymphocytes and residual hematopoietic cells, some with retraction halos, at the periphery
Bony trabeculae intact; no nuclear atypia, mitoses or necrosis seen
66343.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy shows extensive replacement of intertrabecular marrow by sheets of large histiocytes with abundant pale, fibrillary to finely foamy eosinophilic cytoplasm and small bland eccentric nuclei. Residual hematopoiesis and small lymphocytes are displaced to the margins. There is no cytologic atypia, necrosis or granuloma formation. Findings are consistent with marrow infiltration by storage cell macrophages, as seen in lysosomal storage disease (e.g., Gaucher disease); correlation with enzyme assay and genetic testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher histiocytes look similar but occur against a background of CML, myeloma, thalassemia or mycobacterial infection with normal enzyme activity.
Niemann-Pick cells have uniformly bubbly vacuolated cytoplasm rather than the fibrillary 'crumpled tissue paper' texture of Gaucher cells.
MAC-laden histiocytes have striated grey cytoplasm too but are packed with acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen stain.
Signet ring cells are cytokeratin positive with atypical crescent nuclei, while histiocytes are CD68/CD163 positive.

exam.answer_en: Storage-cell macrophage infiltration of marrow (lysosomal storage disease, e.g. Gaucher) — sheets of pale fibrillary/foamy histiocytes displacing hematopoiesis
pearls_zh: 考法：問「形態上 fibrillary 與 foamy 細胞質各提示哪類儲積病」；fibrillary（皺紙樣）偏 Gaucher，foamy 空泡偏 Niemann-Pick 或脂質儲積。
HIV 或免疫低下病人的片狀泡沫組織球要做 AFB 染色，排除 Mycobacterium avium complex（可呈 pseudo-Gaucher 外觀）。
Myeloma/lymphoplasmacytic neoplasm 可出現 crystal-storing histiocytosis（免疫球蛋白輕鏈結晶，常為 κ），需做 κ/λ 評估。
最終確診需結合酵素活性與基因檢測，骨髓形態只能提示儲積病而非確定病名。
exam.pitfall_zh: 泡沫狀組織球易被籠統報為 Gaucher；需以細胞質紋理、AFB 染色、κ/λ 與酵素檢測區分 Niemann-Pick、MAC 感染與 crystal-storing histiocytosis。

quiz.q: HIV 病人骨髓出現類似圖中的片狀組織球，必須加做哪一種特殊染色？
quiz.a: Acid-fast（AFB/Ziehl-Neelsen）染色，排除 Mycobacterium avium complex。

66087.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指細胞有雙葉核，胞質內密布大小一致、橘粉紅色、具折光性的粗大圓形顆粒，顆粒不遮蓋核，這就是嗜酸性球（eosinophil）；左側為淋巴球可作對照。
features: Granulocyte slightly larger than a red cell with a bilobed nucleus and condensed chromatin
Cytoplasm packed with uniform, coarse, round, refractile orange-pink granules that do not obscure the nucleus
Adjacent lymphocyte with round nucleus and pale blue cytoplasm for size comparison
Background red cells with refractile drying artifact and focal stacking; scattered platelets
66087.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature eosinophil (arrow) with a bilobed nucleus and cytoplasm filled with uniform, coarse, refractile orange-pink granules. A small-to-medium lymphocyte lies adjacent. Background red cells show refractile drying artifact, and platelets are adequate in this field. Findings are consistent with a normal mature eosinophil.

ddx.vs: Basophils have coarse dark purple-black granules of variable size that obscure the nucleus, rather than uniform orange-pink granules around a clearly visible bilobed nucleus.
Toxic granules are dark blue-purple and finer, in a neutrophil with three to five lobes, not orange refractile granules with a bilobed nucleus.
Eosinophilic myelocytes have a round non-segmented nucleus and a mixture of purplish immature and orange granules.

exam.answer_en: Mature eosinophil — bilobed nucleus with uniform coarse refractile orange-pink granules
pearls_zh: 考法：與 basophil、toxic granulation 並列比較；答 eosinophil，關鍵是橘紅折光顆粒不遮核、雙葉核清楚。
嗜酸性球增多：≥0.5×10⁹/L 為 eosinophilia，≥1.5×10⁹/L 為 hypereosinophilia；台灣臨床先排除寄生蟲、過敏、藥物。
克隆性病因需查 FIP1L1::PDGFRA（FISH 看 CHIC2 缺失）、PDGFRB、FGFR1、JAK2 等融合；PDGFRA/PDGFRB 重排對 imatinib 反應佳。
持續高嗜酸性球可造成終末器官傷害，尤其 endomyocardial fibrosis 與血栓，需追蹤 troponin 與心臟超音波。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 basophil 混淆；basophil 顆粒深紫黑、大小不一且遮住核，eosinophil 顆粒大小一致、橘粉紅具折光性且雙葉核清楚可見。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指細胞為何？若此類細胞持續 ≥1.5×10⁹/L 且排除反應性病因，應檢測哪個常見融合基因？

65703.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大型母細胞胞質豐富、灰藍色，內有許多細小空泡，核摺疊或腎形、染色質細緻，符合單核球性母細胞；在治療後 AML 中，這種單核球分化加上空泡要想到 KAT6A::CREBBP 融合。
features: Large blasts with abundant grey-blue cytoplasm and low to moderate N:C ratio
Folded, reniform to irregular nuclei with fine, lacy chromatin; some with visible nucleoli
Numerous small cytoplasmic vacuoles in many blasts
Some cells with fine azurophilic cytoplasmic granulation
No definite Auer rods or erythrophagocytosis identified in this field
65703.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows numerous large blasts with abundant grey-blue cytoplasm, folded to reniform nuclei with fine chromatin, and conspicuous fine cytoplasmic vacuolation, with occasional fine azurophilic granules. The morphology indicates monocytic differentiation (monoblasts and promonocytes). Definite Auer rods or erythrophagocytosis are not seen in this field. In a patient with prior cytotoxic therapy and a KAT6A::CREBBP fusion, findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia post cytotoxic therapy with KAT6A::CREBBP fusion.

ddx.vs: KMT2A-rearranged AML also shows monocytic blasts, and separation relies on FISH/RNA sequencing rather than morphology.
Microgranular APL has bilobed, butterfly nuclei, strong MPO, occasional Auer rod bundles and PML::RARA, and lacks prominent vacuolated monocytic cytoplasm.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and round nuclei with coarse chromatin, CD10+ B cells rather than NSE-positive monocytic blasts.
CMML shows mostly mature monocytes with fewer than 20% blasts and promonocytes.

65575.recognize_zh: 骨髓被單一型態的中型不成熟細胞成片取代，抹片中的芽細胞染色質細緻、細胞質灰藍並帶小空泡；TCF4 核陽性，流式 CD123 強陽性合併 CD56 與 HLA-DR 陽性，符合 BPDCN，即使沒有皮膚病灶。
features: Biopsy with diffuse sheets of monotonous medium-sized immature cells effacing the marrow (panel A)
Aspirate blasts with round to slightly irregular nuclei, fine chromatin, small nucleoli, and gray-blue cytoplasm containing small vacuoles (panel B)
Strong nuclear TCF4 staining in most neoplastic cells (panel C)
Flow cytometry: bright CD123 with CD56 coexpression (D), downregulated/partial CD303 (E), and HLA-DR positivity (F)
No granules or Auer rods in the blasts
65575.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy shows diffuse sheets of monotonous medium-sized immature cells replacing normal hematopoiesis. The aspirate shows blasts with fine chromatin, small nucleoli, and agranular gray-blue cytoplasm with small vacuoles. The neoplastic cells show strong nuclear TCF4 staining, and flow cytometry demonstrates a CD123-bright, CD56-positive, HLA-DR-positive population with downregulated CD303. Findings are consistent with blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm extensively involving the bone marrow, notably without cutaneous disease.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation (CD56+/CD123+)
ddx.vs: Monocytic AML expresses CD11b, CD14, CD64, lysozyme, and often MPO and lacks the TCF4/TCL1/CD303 plasmacytoid dendritic cell program.
In this entity the pDCs are a minor mature CD34-negative population accompanying CD34+ myeloid blasts rather than the dominant neoplastic population.
These express cytoplasmic CD3, CD2, or CD7 with TdT and lack bright CD123 with TCF4.

ddx.dx: Mature plasmacytoid dendritic cell proliferation associated with myeloid neoplasm
ddx.vs: These pDCs are CD56 negative and cytologically mature, in contrast to these CD56-positive blastic cells.

65383.recognize_zh: GMS 銀染色下，右上方可見一個圓形囊泡周圍放射狀排列的瓶梗，即麴菌的孢子頭（fruiting head），周圍有大量被染成黑色的小圓形孢子（conidia），配合臨床為骨髓侵襲性麴菌症。
features: Round vesicle with radially arranged phialides forming an Aspergillus conidiophore (fruiting) head
Numerous GMS-positive black round conidia in clusters
Faintly stained hyphal fragments in the background, with weaker silver impregnation than the conidia
Large aggregate of polygonal clear compartments with dark outlines of uncertain nature (possible contaminant or plant-like material)
Light green counterstained necrotic background with scattered nuclei
65383.describe_en: Grocott methenamine silver stain of the bone marrow section shows a well-formed fruiting head composed of a central vesicle with radiating phialides, accompanied by abundant black-staining round conidia. Hyphal fragments are present but only faintly impregnated in this field. A separate large aggregate of polygonal clear compartments with dark outlines is also seen and is of uncertain significance. Findings support invasive aspergillosis; fungal culture or molecular identification is recommended for speciation.

ddx.vs: Mucorales produce broad pauci-septate hyphae and sporangia rather than a vesicle with radiating phialides.
Tissue hyphae overlap with Aspergillus and require culture or PCR, but a conidial head with radiating phialides is characteristic of Aspergillus.
Histoplasma forms small intracellular budding yeasts within macrophages without hyphae or fruiting heads.

65319.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有多顆母細胞，核圓或凹陷、染色質細緻並偶見核仁，灰藍色細胞質邊緣排列一圈小空泡（string of pearls），部分拉出偽足；同時可見形態異常的嗜中性球，符合 BPDCN 合併 CMML。
features: Medium to large blasts with round to indented nuclei, fine chromatin and occasional small nucleoli
Moderate grey-blue agranular cytoplasm with small vacuoles lining the cell membrane ('string of pearls')
Cytoplasmic tail-like pseudopodia in some blasts
Neutrophils with hypolobated or clumped nuclei suggestive of dysgranulopoiesis
Mild anisopoikilocytosis of background red cells
65319.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows medium to large blasts with round to indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, occasional small nucleoli, and moderate grey-blue agranular cytoplasm. Several cells show a rim of small peripheral cytoplasmic vacuoles in a 'string of pearls' arrangement and tail-like pseudopodia. Admixed neutrophils show hypolobated and irregularly clumped nuclei. Findings are consistent with blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm, with background dysgranulopoiesis compatible with concurrent chronic myelomonocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts and promonocytes may be vacuolated but show fine azurophilic granules, folded nuclei and NSE/lysozyme positivity with CD14/CD11c expression.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent round lipid vacuoles and a mature B-cell phenotype with MYC rearrangement.
Promonocytes have folded nuclei and fine granules and count as blast equivalents in CMML, whereas BPDCN blasts are agranular and CD123+TCF4+TCL1+.

exam.answer_en: BPDCN with background dysgranulopoiesis (concurrent CMML) — agranular blasts with 'string of pearls' peripheral vacuoles
pearls_zh: 考法：同一視野兩種族群——指細胞膜下一圈小空泡的母細胞問 BPDCN，指分葉不良的嗜中性球問 dysgranulopoiesis，要能說出合併髓系腫瘤。
BPDCN 可與 CMML/MDS 同時或先後發生，常共享 TET2 等 clonal hematopoiesis 突變，提示共同的髓系前驅起源。
需與 CMML 常見的 mature plasmacytoid dendritic cell proliferation 區分：後者為成熟 pDC 結節、非母細胞樣，CD56 常陰性。
CMML 計數時 promonocyte 算 blast equivalent，但 BPDCN 母細胞需以 CD123/TCF4/TCL1 另行界定，避免誤判為 CMML 急性轉化。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤判為 CMML 轉成 AML with monocytic differentiation；BPDCN 母細胞無顆粒、NSE/MPO 與 CD14 陰性，而 CD123/TCF4 陽性。

quiz.q: 圖中母細胞細胞質邊緣排成一圈的小空泡稱為什麼？背景異常嗜中性球提示合併何種疾病？

65255.recognize_zh: 四顆嗜中性球的細胞質幾乎看不到顆粒、呈淡灰透明（hypogranular），核分葉異常：左上一顆為多葉且形狀不規則，其餘為 C 形或兩三葉；背景紅血球可見淚滴形與碎片，符合 MDS 的顆粒球發育不良（dysgranulopoiesis）。
features: Four neutrophils with markedly hypogranular, pale grey cytoplasm
Abnormal nuclear segmentation: one hypersegmented, irregularly lobulated nucleus (upper left) and others with C-shaped or two-to-three-lobed nuclei
Coarsely clumped nuclear chromatin
Small cytoplasmic vacuole in the upper-left neutrophil
Red cells with teardrop forms, fragments and elliptocytes; platelets not seen in the field
65255.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows four neutrophils with striking cytoplasmic hypogranularity and abnormal nuclear segmentation, including an irregular hypersegmented form and several with C-shaped or bilobed to trilobed nuclei. Toxic granulation and Döhle bodies are not present. The red cells show poikilocytosis with teardrop cells and occasional fragments, and platelets are not seen in this field, in keeping with the reported thrombocytopenia. In the context of known TP53-mutated MDS, the findings are consistent with dysgranulopoiesis.

ddx.dx: Smear preparation or storage artifact (EDTA delay)
ddx.vs: Storage artifact causes nuclear lobe rounding and cytoplasmic vacuolation in all cells, whereas true hypogranularity persists in freshly prepared smears and accompanies cytopenias.
Megaloblastic neutrophils are large and hypersegmented but retain normal granulation, with macro-ovalocytes and low B12/folate.

ddx.dx: Acquired or reactive hypogranularity (e.g., SARS-CoV-2 infection, drugs such as mycophenolate)
ddx.vs: Reactive hypogranularity is transient and occurs without cytogenetic or molecular evidence of clonality.

exam.answer_en: Myelodysplastic neoplasm (TP53-mutated) — hypogranular neutrophils with abnormal nuclear segmentation (dysgranulopoiesis)
pearls_zh: 考法：指淡灰透明細胞質的中性球問異常；答 hypogranularity 合併 abnormal nuclear segmentation，屬 dysgranulopoiesis。
判讀：WHO 以該系 ≥10% 細胞有 dysplasia 為準；hypogranularity 要和同片中正常顆粒的細胞對照，避免染色偏淡造成假象。
TP53 突變 MDS 常伴 complex karyotype、多系 dysplasia 與深度血球低下；ICC 2022 設 MDS/AML with mutated TP53，WHO 5th 設 MDS with biallelic TP53 inactivation。
反應性 hypogranularity 或 pseudo-Pelger 可見於 mycophenolate、tacrolimus、valproate 等藥物；診斷 MDS 前需查用藥史、B12/folate 與銅。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易被忽略為染色太淡或當成 toxic change；toxic 中性球顆粒是增加且粗大、可伴 Döhle body，MDS 則是顆粒缺乏合併分葉異常。

quiz.q: 圖中中性球細胞質最主要的異常是什麼？屬於哪一系列的發育不良？

65191.recognize_zh: 縱膈腫塊切片中上皮細胞與小淋巴球混合，keratin 顯示網狀上皮細胞，CD5 與 TdT 標示大量不成熟胸腺 T 細胞；CD20 雖在大片細胞團呈強膜狀陽性，但著色於黏聚的上皮細胞群而非淋巴球，是胸腺瘤（AB 型）的 CD20 異常表現陷阱。
features: Cellular mediastinal lesion with cohesive clusters/sheets of intermediate-sized oval to spindle cells with fine chromatin, admixed with small lymphocytes
Keratin highlights a meshwork of epithelial cells throughout the lesion
CD5 diffusely positive in abundant background small T cells
TdT shows nuclear positivity in numerous small lymphocytes, consistent with immature thymic T cells
CD20 shows strong membranous staining in cohesive clusters and cords of epithelial cells, with negative intervening lymphocytes (higher power)
65191.describe_en: Mediastinal biopsy shows a cellular neoplasm composed of cohesive clusters of intermediate-sized epithelial cells with fine chromatin and thin nuclear membranes, admixed with small lymphocytes lacking atypia. Keratin highlights a network of epithelial cells, and the background lymphocytes are CD5- and TdT-positive immature thymic T cells. CD20 is strongly positive in large cohesive clusters of cells that correspond to the epithelial component, while other B-cell markers (CD19, CD79a, PAX5, OCT2) were negative. Findings are consistent with thymoma, type AB, with aberrant CD20 expression by neoplastic epithelial cells, a potential pitfall for B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: PMBL consists of large discohesive B cells with sclerosis that are CD20, PAX5 and CD79a positive and keratin negative, whereas these CD20+ cells are cohesive keratin-positive epithelial cells lacking other B markers.
T-LBL also has TdT+ T cells but shows sheets of cytologically atypical blasts without a keratin-positive epithelial meshwork.
Thymic carcinoma shows overt cytologic atypia, desmoplasia, and CD5/CD117 positivity in the epithelial cells with few TdT+ immature T cells.
cHL shows scattered large Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells that are CD30/CD15 positive in a mixed inflammatory background, not keratin-positive epithelial clusters.

65191.stain: H&E; IHC: keratin, CD5, TdT, CD20

65063.recognize_zh: 一顆嗜中性球的細胞質內有一個清楚的吞噬空泡，裡面含有十多隻短而直、兩端鈍圓的桿菌，細胞質另有多個小空泡；在周邊血抹片看到細胞內細菌即代表菌血症，培養證實為克雷伯氏菌（Klebsiella pneumoniae）。
features: Segmented neutrophil containing a large phagocytic vacuole packed with numerous short, straight, plump bacilli
Additional small cytoplasmic vacuoles (toxic vacuolation) in the neutrophil
Nucleus segmented with clumped chromatin, pushed aside by the vacuole
Background red cells with central pallor and scattered platelets; no extracellular organisms clearly identified
65063.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil containing a large phagocytic vacuole filled with numerous short, straight rod-shaped bacteria, together with smaller cytoplasmic vacuoles. The nucleus is segmented and displaced by the vacuole. Red cells and platelets show no specific abnormality in this field, and extracellular organisms are not evident. Findings are consistent with bacteremia with intracellular bacilli; the morphology suggests gram-negative rods, and blood culture is required for species identification (Klebsiella pneumoniae in this case).

ddx.dx: Stain precipitate or platelets overlying a neutrophil
ddx.vs: Precipitate is irregular and lies in a different focal plane, whereas bacteria here are uniform rods confined within a membrane-bound vacuole.
Dohle bodies are pale blue peripheral cytoplasmic patches and toxic granules are fine dots, not discrete rods within a vacuole.
Morulae are mulberry-like clusters of tiny cocci-sized inclusions without distinct rods.
Fungi appear as larger oval budding yeasts or pseudohyphae (Candida) or small oval yeasts with a halo (Histoplasma), not slender rods.

exam.answer_en: Bacteremia on peripheral blood smear — neutrophil phagocytic vacuole containing numerous short plump bacilli (Klebsiella pneumoniae on culture)
pearls_zh: 考法：指中性球內含桿狀物的空泡問「這是什麼、代表什麼」；答被吞噬的細菌（bacilli），抹片見細胞內細菌表示高菌量菌血症，應立即通知臨床並做血液培養。
抹片可檢出的菌血症多見於無脾、免疫低下、中心靜脈導管感染或重度敗血症，通常代表病情嚴重。
可在抹片上加做 Gram stain 初步分辨 Gram 陰/陽性；形態只能推測，種別仍依血液培養。
伴隨 toxic granulation、Döhle body、cytoplasmic vacuolation 支持感染；空泡需在新鮮血製片判讀，EDTA 放置過久會出現人工空泡。
exam.pitfall_zh: 常被當成染料沉澱或 Döhle body/毒性顆粒；細菌為大小一致、邊界清楚的桿狀體並位於膜包空泡內，沉澱則形狀不一且位於不同焦平面。

quiz.q: 圖中中性球空泡內的桿狀物是什麼？可在同一張抹片加做何種染色做初步分類？

65127.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片中有大型漿細胞，細胞質充滿桃紅色物質並向周邊延伸成火焰狀邊緣（flame cell），另見雙核漿細胞與大型嗜伊紅性細胞質球狀包涵物，符合漿細胞腫瘤。
features: Plasma cells of varying size with eccentric round nuclei and clumped chromatin
Large flame cells with magenta-pink cytoplasm and irregular frayed borders
Occasional binucleate plasma cells
Large round pink cytoplasmic globules pushing the nucleus to the periphery (Russell-body-like inclusions)
Background small lymphocytes, erythroid precursors and poorly spread red cells
65127.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows an increase in plasma cells of varying size admixed with small lymphocytes and erythroid precursors. Several plasma cells have abundant magenta cytoplasm with ragged peripheral fringes (flame cells), and occasional binucleate forms are present. A large cell contains a voluminous homogeneous pink cytoplasmic globule that compresses the nucleus to one pole, consistent with immunoglobulin inclusion (Russell body). Findings are consistent with a plasma cell neoplasm showing flame cell morphology and immunoglobulin inclusions.

ddx.vs: Reactive states can show flame and Mott cells, but plasma cells remain polytypic by flow or IHC, whereas this case shows kappa restriction with aberrant CD20/CD200.
Storage histiocytes have striated or fibrillary pale cytoplasm and central small nuclei rather than eccentric plasma cell nuclei with magenta cytoplasm.
LPL shows a mixture of small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes with Dutcher bodies and an IgM paraprotein, not a predominance of large atypical plasma cells.

exam.answer_en: Plasma cell neoplasm — flame cells with magenta frayed cytoplasm, binucleate plasma cells and Russell-body-like globules
pearls_zh: 考法：一張圖同時考三種漿細胞變異：flame cell（洋紅色火焰邊緣）、binucleate plasma cell、Russell body（細胞質內大型粉紅圓球）；需逐一指認。
Russell body 為堆積在擴張 rough ER 的免疫球蛋白，PAS 陽性；多顆聚集成葡萄狀即 Mott cell；核上方的假包涵體稱 Dutcher body。
雙核、多核或核仁明顯的不成熟漿細胞提高腫瘤可能，但型態不能取代 clonality；需 kappa/lambda IHC/ISH 或 flow 確認。
Myeloma 初診必做：SPEP + immunofixation、serum FLC、24 小時 urine 或 UPEP、全身低劑量 CT 或 PET-CT/MRI，以及 FISH 細胞遺傳風險評估。
exam.pitfall_zh: 細胞質大型粉紅球易被誤當吞噬物而判成 histiocyte 或噬血細胞；Russell body 位於有偏心車輪狀核的漿細胞內，沒有被吞入細胞的核或紅血球輪廓。

quiz.q: 圖中漿細胞內將核推向邊緣的大型粉紅色圓球叫什麼？成分是什麼？
quiz.a: Russell body；堆積於 ER 內的免疫球蛋白（PAS+）。

64743.recognize_zh: 兩個比旁邊嗜中性球大好幾倍的巨大原紅血球，細胞質深藍，巨大圓核內為淡粉紫色、細顆粒毛玻璃樣的病毒包涵體，染色質沿核膜濃縮成一圈，形成燈籠細胞外觀，符合 Parvovirus B19 感染。
features: Two giant pronormoblasts several times the size of adjacent neutrophils (scale bar 10 µm)
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with irregular, slightly frayed borders
Very large nucleus with pale pink-lilac, finely granular glassy inclusion and marginated chromatin
Nucleolus-like pale areas within the inclusion
Background mature neutrophils, band forms, a myelocyte and erythrocytes
64743.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows two giant pronormoblasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and enormous round nuclei in which the chromatin is replaced by a pale, glassy, finely granular intranuclear inclusion with a thin rim of condensed chromatin. Adjacent mature neutrophils and granulocytic precursors are unremarkable. These cells are characteristic lantern cells of parvovirus B19 infection; correlation with reticulocytopenia and viral PCR or serology is recommended.

ddx.vs: PEL blasts occur in sheets and lack the glassy intranuclear inclusions with chromatin margination seen in scattered parvovirus-infected pronormoblasts.
Megaloblastic precursors show open sieve-like chromatin and a full maturation spectrum of megaloblasts, rather than an inclusion-filled nucleus with erythroid maturation arrest.

ddx.dx: Reed-Sternberg-like or other large atypical tumor cells
ddx.vs: Tumor cells have prominent eosinophilic macronucleoli and are erythroid-marker negative, not deeply basophilic cells with a glassy viral nuclear inclusion.

exam.answer_en: Parvovirus B19 infection — giant pronormoblasts with pale glassy intranuclear inclusions and marginated chromatin (lantern cells)
pearls_zh: 考法：以旁邊嗜中性球作大小對照，問「為何說是巨大」並描述核內變化；答染色質被推向核膜、中央為毛玻璃包涵體。
血液檢查特徵：網狀紅血球計數極低（接近 0），骨髓紅血球系成熟細胞缺乏，白血球與血小板多相對保留。
確診：parvovirus B19 DNA PCR；骨髓切片可用 parvovirus B19 IHC 標出受感染細胞。
Transient aplastic crisis 可致嚴重貧血而需輸血，病人與醫護接觸時具傳染性，需飛沫防護。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤為大型腫瘤細胞或 megaloblastic pronormoblast：megaloblastic 變化會在各成熟階段出現核質不同步；腫瘤細胞核仁明顯。此處核內為均勻毛玻璃包涵體而非核仁。

quiz.q: 此骨髓變化病人的網狀紅血球數會呈現什麼狀況？確診最常用哪種檢測？
quiz.a: 網狀紅血球極低（reticulocytopenia）；parvovirus B19 PCR。

64615.recognize_zh: 周邊血液拼圖中多顆中等大小的淋巴細胞，核圓形、卵圓或腎形，細胞質淡藍紫色且邊緣呈不規則、四周放射狀的細毛突起，是毛細胞白血病的典型毛細胞。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cells, larger than small lymphocytes, with moderate N:C ratio
Round, oval or bean/kidney-shaped nuclei with homogeneous, moderately condensed chromatin
Nucleoli absent or inconspicuous
Moderate pale blue-violet cytoplasm with irregular, ruffled circumferential hair-like projections
Background red cells normochromic; scattered platelets
64615.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (composite) shows medium-sized lymphoid cells with round, oval or kidney-shaped nuclei, homogeneous chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. The cells have moderate amounts of pale blue-violet cytoplasm with irregular, circumferential hair-like projections. Background red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with circulating hairy cells of hairy cell leukemia; flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123) and BRAF V600E testing are recommended for confirmation.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant (splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli)
ddx.vs: HCL-v cells show a distinct central nucleolus, higher WBC counts, and are CD25-negative and BRAF wild-type.
SMZL cells have short polar villi at one or two poles and more clumped chromatin rather than circumferential projections.
LGLs have abundant pale cytoplasm containing distinct azurophilic granules and no hairy projections.
Monocytes are larger with folded nuclei, lacy chromatin, fine azurophilic granules and vacuoles.

exam.answer_en: Hairy cell leukemia — circulating medium-sized lymphoid cells with kidney-shaped nuclei, no nucleoli and circumferential ruffled hair-like projections
pearls_zh: 考法：多格拼圖同型細胞，要答 hairy cell 並說出支持點：核無明顯核仁、染色質均勻、整圈細毛；若見明顯中央核仁應改想 HCL variant。
典型血液學：全血球低下、monocytopenia；周邊 hairy cell 數量通常不多，需仔細找或靠 flow 偵測。
確診：flow CD11c/CD25/CD103/CD123，加上 BRAF V600E（分子或 VE1 IHC）與 annexin A1。
BRAF 野生型且 IGHV4-34 的 HCL 樣病例對 purine analog 反應較差，須與典型 HCL 分開看待。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 large granular lymphocyte 或單核球混淆；LGL 細胞質有明顯嗜天青顆粒，單核球核摺疊且細胞質有空泡與細顆粒，hairy cell 則無顆粒、邊緣有細毛。

quiz.q: 看到圖中這類細胞，病人血球計數最具特徵的單一白血球亞群異常是什麼？

64487.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片以漿細胞為主；肝臟切片見膽汁淤積與肝細胞羽毛狀退化，kappa 染色沿竇狀隙與血管壁呈線狀沉積，而 lambda 與 Congo red 陰性，符合骨髓瘤合併肝臟 kappa 輕鏈沉積症。
features: Bone marrow (A): diffuse infiltrate of plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, clumped chromatin and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm
Liver (B): hepatocytes with swollen, pale, rarefied (feathery) cytoplasm, canalicular bile plugs, and foamy cell clusters
Kappa IHC (C): linear perisinusoidal and vascular wall deposition with a focal dense aggregate of kappa-positive material
Lambda IHC (E) negative in the deposits; Congo red (D) negative, arguing against amyloid
No amorphous eosinophilic amyloid-like material visible on H&E
64487.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy shows a diffuse infiltrate of plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and clumped chromatin, consistent with plasma cell myeloma. The liver biopsy shows cholestasis with bile plugs, feathery degeneration of hepatocytes, and small clusters of foamy cells. Kappa immunostaining demonstrates linear deposition along sinusoids and vascular walls with a focal dense aggregate, whereas lambda and Congo red stains are negative. Findings are consistent with multiple myeloma with hepatic kappa light chain deposition disease.

ddx.vs: Amyloid forms amorphous eosinophilic deposits that are Congo red positive with apple-green birefringence, often in a parenchymal/space of Disse pattern, whereas here Congo red is negative.
These produce bile plugs and feathery degeneration but no monotypic light chain deposition along sinusoids.

ddx.dx: Myeloma involvement of the liver (hepatic plasmacytoma/infiltration)
ddx.vs: Direct infiltration shows sinusoidal or portal sheets of plasma cells (CD138+) rather than acellular linear light chain deposits.

ddx.dx: Heavy chain or light-and-heavy chain deposition disease
ddx.vs: These are distinguished by immunostaining/immunofluorescence for heavy chains; here the deposits are kappa-only.

64487.stain: H&E; IHC: kappa, lambda; Congo red

64295.recognize_zh: 七格周邊血液影像中，小至中型淋巴球的周圍都被一圈血小板環繞貼附（衛星現象），而非環繞中性球，這種血小板聚集可造成假性血小板減少。
features: Small to medium mature lymphocytes with round nuclei, condensed chromatin, and scant to moderate pale blue cytoplasm
Platelets adherent in a rosette around the lymphocyte membrane (satellitism)
Phenomenon present in multiple lymphocytes across fields, including a pair of lymphocytes both rimmed by platelets
Platelets individually normal in size and granularity
Background red cells unremarkable; no atypical lymphocytes
64295.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (composite of seven fields) shows mature small to medium lymphocytes with round nuclei and scant blue cytoplasm, each surrounded by a rosette of adherent platelets. The platelets themselves appear normal in size and granulation, and the red cells and lymphocytes are otherwise unremarkable. This lymphocytic platelet satellitism sequesters platelets from automated counting. Findings are consistent with platelet satellitism causing pseudothrombocytopenia; a repeat count in citrate or heparin anticoagulant and smear review are recommended.

ddx.vs: The classic EDTA-dependent form rims segmented neutrophils, whereas here platelets rosette around lymphocytes.
Platelet clumping forms free aggregates of platelets in the smear (often at feathered edge) rather than rings adherent to leukocytes.
True thrombocytopenia shows few platelets, often large, without satellitism or clumps, and persists in citrate-anticoagulated samples.
Cytoplasmic projections of villous lymphocytes can mimic adherent platelets, but they are continuous with the cytoplasm and lack platelet granules.

exam.answer_en: Lymphocytic platelet satellitism — platelet rosettes adherent around mature lymphocytes, causing spurious (pseudo)thrombocytopenia
pearls_zh: 考法：指淋巴球外圍一圈血小板問「這會造成什麼檢驗錯誤？」——答血小板被計入白血球或漏計，造成假性血小板低下；應先看抹片再報危急值。
與經典型不同：常見的血小板衛星現象圍繞中性球（EDTA 依賴），圍繞淋巴球者罕見，考題可能要求說出「宿主細胞是哪一種」。
處理：改用 citrate 或 heparin 抗凝管重新計數並即時製片；確認後在報告註明，避免不必要輸血或停用抗凝/抗血小板藥物。
判讀抹片時同時檢查 feathered edge 是否有血小板團塊，並比對儀器 platelet histogram 與 flag。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把貼附的血小板當成毛細胞或絨毛淋巴球的細胞質突起；血小板是獨立、有紫紅顆粒的小碎片，細胞質突起則與細胞質連續且無顆粒。

quiz.q: 圖中血小板圍繞的是哪一種白血球？這種現象如何確認血小板真實數值？
quiz.a: 淋巴球（lymphocytic satellitism）；改用 citrate/heparin 抗凝管重抽計數並看抹片

64423.recognize_zh: 腦脊髓液細胞離心抹片中可見中至大型異型淋巴細胞，核不規則、染色質細緻、有小核仁，細胞質淡藍且有少數空泡；流式細胞儀顯示 CD2+、CD7+、CD56+、CD16+ 但 CD3、CD5 與 TCR 陰性，看似 NK 細胞，TRG 克隆性重排則證實為 T 細胞淋巴瘤復發。
features: Panel B (CSF cytospin): medium to large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, indented nuclei and fine chromatin
Small but visible nucleoli and moderate pale blue cytoplasm with occasional small vacuoles; no conspicuous azurophilic granules
Panel A: MRI with asymmetric enhancement/signal of the left optic nerve (arrow)
Panel C: CD45-bright population (orange) positive for CD2, CD7, CD16 and CD56, negative for CD3, CD4, CD5, CD8, TCRαβ and TCRγδ
Panel D: NGS clonality showing a dominant Vγ9-Jγ1/2 TRG rearrangement (75.2%)
64423.describe_en: Cerebrospinal fluid cytospin shows medium to large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular nuclear contours, finely dispersed chromatin, small nucleoli and moderate amounts of pale blue, focally vacuolated cytoplasm. Flow cytometry identifies an abnormal population expressing CD2, CD7, CD16 and CD56 while lacking surface CD3, CD5, CD4, CD8, TCRαβ and TCRγδ, mimicking an NK-cell phenotype. Next-generation sequencing demonstrates a dominant clonal TRG (Vγ9-Jγ1/2) rearrangement. In a patient with prior γδ hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma, findings are consistent with CNS relapse of HSTCL with aberrant loss of the CD3/TCR complex.

ddx.vs: Reactive NK cells are small granular lymphocytes with polyclonal KIR expression and no clonal TRG rearrangement or STAT5B mutation.
ANKL is EBV-positive with azurophilic granules and lacks TCR gene rearrangement, unlike this EBV-unrelated TRG-clonal process.

ddx.dx: Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma with CNS involvement
ddx.vs: ENKTL expresses cytoplasmic CD3ε and is EBER-positive, whereas this relapse carries HSTCL-type STAT5B/SETD2 mutations and prior TCRγδ history.
BPDCN is CD4+/CD56+/CD123+/TCL1+ and lacks CD16, CD7-bright expression and TCR gene rearrangement.

64231.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中散在數顆大型組織球（箭頭），細胞質大量淡藍灰色、呈細小空泡的泡沫狀／肥皂泡樣（soap bubble），核小而偏位；插圖放大可見細緻多空泡的細胞質，提示儲積症，本例為 Niemann-Pick 病 C 型。
features: Large histiocytes (arrowheads) several times the size of surrounding myeloid cells, scattered singly
Abundant pale gray-blue cytoplasm filled with innumerable small uniform vacuoles giving a foamy/soap-bubble appearance
Small, round, eccentric nuclei with condensed chromatin
Inset: high-power view showing finely vacuolated cytoplasm with occasional larger clear vacuoles, lacking the fibrillary crumpled-tissue-paper texture of Gaucher cells
Background of cellular trilineage marrow with erythroid and myeloid precursors and platelet clumps
64231.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular background of maturing hematopoietic elements with several scattered large histiocytes. These cells have abundant pale gray-blue cytoplasm distended by numerous small, uniform vacuoles imparting a foamy, soap-bubble appearance, and small eccentric nuclei. The high-power inset confirms finely vacuolated rather than fibrillary cytoplasm. Findings are consistent with foamy storage histiocytes, suggestive of a lipid storage disorder such as Niemann-Pick disease; enzymatic assay (acid sphingomyelinase), oxysterol/biomarker studies, and NPC1/NPC2 sequencing are required for classification.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have fibrillary, striated 'wrinkled tissue paper' cytoplasm rather than discrete small vacuoles, and show low glucocerebrosidase activity.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain blue-green ceroid granules on Romanowsky stain rather than clear foamy vacuoles, though they can coexist in Niemann-Pick disease.
Morphology of foamy cells is similar; ASM deficiency shows markedly low sphingomyelinase activity and SMPD1 mutations, whereas type C has normal to borderline enzyme and NPC1/NPC2 mutations.

ddx.dx: Reactive lipid-laden macrophages (e.g., hyperlipidemia, TPN, infection)
ddx.vs: Reactive foamy macrophages are fewer and accompany the clinical context, and lack genetic or enzymatic evidence of storage disease.

exam.answer_en: Niemann-Pick disease type C — marrow foamy (soap-bubble) storage histiocytes with finely vacuolated cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：指箭頭處泡沫狀大細胞問名稱與鑑別；答 foamy/Niemann-Pick cell，重點與 Gaucher cell（皺紙樣纖維狀胞質）區分。
遺傳：NPC 為 NPC1（大多數）或 NPC2 突變，屬膽固醇細胞內運輸異常，非 acid sphingomyelinase 缺乏；NP A/B（ASMD）則為 SMPD1 突變。
臨床：新生兒膽汁鬱積、肝脾腫大，後續神經退化，典型為 vertical supranuclear gaze palsy、cataplexy、ataxia。
診斷：血漿 oxysterols 或 lyso-SM-509 等 biomarker 篩檢，NPC1/NPC2 基因定序確認；骨髓中也可見 sea-blue histiocytes。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 Gaucher cell：Gaucher cell 胞質呈皺紙／洋蔥皮樣纖維紋路、PAS 強陽性，Niemann-Pick cell 則為均一小空泡的泡沫狀；也需與高細胞更新（CML、thalassemia）的 pseudo-Gaucher/泡沫巨噬細胞區分。

quiz.q: 圖中泡沫狀組織球提示的疾病 type C，是哪兩個基因的突變？

64167.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD163 免疫染色中，大量大型上皮樣細胞的細胞膜與細胞質呈強烈棕色顆粒狀、樹枝狀陽性，勾勒出細胞輪廓，支持這群上皮樣細胞為組織球（histiocyte／macrophage）來源。
features: Dense sheet-like infiltrate of large cells with ovoid pale nuclei replacing much of the marrow
Strong CD163 staining with membranous and coarse granular cytoplasmic pattern
Positive cells show irregular, dendritic-like cytoplasmic extensions outlining cell borders
Admixed CD163-negative smaller hematopoietic cells
Few residual adipocyte spaces
64167.describe_en: CD163 immunohistochemistry on the bone marrow core biopsy shows strong membranous and granular cytoplasmic staining in numerous large epithelioid cells, which form a dense, sheet-like infiltrate with irregular cytoplasmic processes. Interspersed smaller hematopoietic cells are negative. In conjunction with CD34 negativity and only dot-like keratin staining, the CD163 expression supports histiocytic/monocyte-macrophage lineage of the epithelioid infiltrate; distinction between a reactive histiocytic proliferation and a histiocytic neoplasm requires correlation with cytologic atypia, extent, and additional markers.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells are CD163-negative with strong diffuse cytokeratin, whereas these cells are CD163-positive with only dot-like keratin.
Histiocytic sarcoma is also CD163-positive but shows marked cytologic atypia and mitoses on H&E with CD68/lysozyme, and requires exclusion of other lineages.
Monoblasts/promonocytes are smaller with fine chromatin, often CD34/CD117 variable, and typically CD163 weak to negative, with blasts evident on aspirate.
Resident macrophages are scattered, interstitial, and dendritic rather than forming a dense cohesive sheet of large epithelioid cells.

64103.recognize_zh: 明顯疊錢狀紅血球背景中，一顆核偏心、染色質塊狀、胞質淡藍的漿細胞，胞質內擠滿許多細長針狀、成束排列的粉紫色結晶桿狀物，外觀像 Auer 小體；漿細胞含結晶狀包涵體，見於漿細胞骨髓瘤。
features: Plasma cell with an eccentric round nucleus and coarse clock-face chromatin
Pale blue cytoplasm packed with numerous thin, needle-like, pink-violet crystalline rods arranged in bundles (Auer rod-like inclusions)
Rods extend beyond the nucleus into most of the cytoplasm
Striking rouleaux formation of red cells in the background, consistent with a paraprotein
Scattered small lymphocytes and a granulocyte in the background
64103.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows marked rouleaux formation of red cells, with a plasma cell whose eccentric nucleus has coarsely clumped chromatin and whose pale blue cytoplasm contains numerous thin, needle-like, pink-violet crystalline rods arranged in bundles. These Auer rod-like inclusions represent crystallized immunoglobulin (often kappa light chain) and are distinct from true Auer rods, which are MPO-positive fused primary granules of myeloid blasts. Scattered small lymphocytes are also present. Findings are consistent with a plasma cell neoplasm with crystalline cytoplasmic inclusions; evaluation for light-chain proximal tubulopathy (Fanconi syndrome) or crystal-storing histiocytosis may be warranted.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with Auer rods
ddx.vs: True Auer rods occur in myeloblasts with fine chromatin and nucleoli and are MPO-positive, whereas these crystals lie in a mature plasma cell with clock-face chromatin and are MPO-negative.
Crystals accumulate in CD68+ histiocytes with bland oval nuclei rather than in CD138+ plasma cells, although both reflect the same underlying light-chain disorder.
Gaucher cells are large histiocytes with fibrillar 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm and a small nucleus, not discrete needle-shaped rods in a plasma cell.

ddx.dx: Plasma cells with Russell bodies (Mott cells)
ddx.vs: Russell bodies are round globular inclusions rather than elongated needle-like crystals.

64039.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中巨核細胞數量增加，許多為單核圓形或核分葉很少的小型至中型巨核細胞（monolobated/hypolobated megakaryocyte），另見兩個分開圓核的巨核細胞，這種巨核細胞形態是 MDS del(5q) 的典型線索。
features: Hypercellular bone marrow biopsy with trilineage hematopoiesis among fat spaces
Increased megakaryocytes, many small to medium-sized with round monolobated or hypolobated nuclei
Occasional megakaryocytes with two separate round nuclear lobes
Megakaryocytes scattered singly without tight clustering
No sheets of blasts or fibrosis evident at this magnification
64039.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy (H&E, medium power) is hypercellular for age with trilineage hematopoiesis. Megakaryocytes are increased and predominantly small to medium-sized with round monolobated or hypolobated nuclei, with occasional forms showing separated round nuclear lobes. They are dispersed without tight clusters, and there are no sheets of immature cells in this field. The megakaryocytic morphology is characteristic of myelodysplastic neoplasm with isolated del(5q), which requires cytogenetic confirmation and blast enumeration.

ddx.vs: ET megakaryocytes are large to giant with hyperlobulated 'staghorn' nuclei, not small monolobated forms.
PMF megakaryocytes form dense clusters with bulbous, hyperchromatic 'cloud-like' nuclei and are associated with reticulin fibrosis.

ddx.dx: Other MDS or MDS/MPN with dysmegakaryopoiesis
ddx.vs: Micromegakaryocytes and separated nuclear lobes occur in other MDS, so predominance of monolobated megakaryocytes suggests but does not prove del(5q); karyotype or FISH is required.
Reactive states (e.g., immune thrombocytopenia) show increased megakaryocytes with normal lobation and size spectrum.

exam.answer_en: MDS with isolated del(5q) — hypercellular marrow with increased small-to-medium monolobated/hypolobated megakaryocytes, not clustered
pearls_zh: 考法：biopsy 中指著散在的小至中型、圓形單葉核巨核細胞問最可能的細胞遺傳異常；答 del(5q)，需以 karyotype 或 FISH 確認。
WHO 5th MDS-5q：del(5q) 單獨或加一個不涉及 -7/del(7q) 的異常；blasts BM <5%、PB <2%；ICC 2022 名稱為 MDS with del(5q)。
臨床典型：年長女性、大球性貧血、血小板正常或增加；以 lenalidomide 治療輸血依賴者常可達脫離輸血並出現細胞遺傳學反應。
需檢測 TP53 突變：MDS-5q 合併 TP53 突變者對 lenalidomide 反應較差、進展為 AML 風險較高；CD61/CD42b IHC 可幫助辨識小型巨核細胞。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為 MPN（ET/PMF）：MPN 巨核細胞多大型、hyperlobated 或 bulbous 且常緊密成群；CML 的 dwarf megakaryocytes 也小而少葉，但伴 myeloid hyperplasia 與 BCR::ABL1。本圖為單葉核、散在不成群。

quiz.q: 此骨髓切片中散在的小型、圓形單葉核巨核細胞最典型對應哪一個 MDS 亞型？首選藥物為何？

63911.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中箭頭所指為循環母細胞：核大、染色質細緻、細胞質少且偏藍，旁邊還有帶空泡的單核球與分葉核嗜中性球；在急性骨髓性白血病的背景下代表母細胞進入周邊血。
features: Circulating blasts (arrows) with high N:C ratio, round nucleus and fine chromatin
Scant to moderate basophilic, agranular cytoplasm
Monocytes with folded nuclei and cytoplasmic vacuoles
Segmented and band neutrophils with normal-appearing granulation
Red cells mostly normocytic with mild anisocytosis; platelets appear decreased in this field
63911.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating blasts (arrows) with a high N:C ratio, round nuclei with fine chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm. There are admixed segmented neutrophils, bands and monocytes, some of which contain cytoplasmic vacuoles. Red cells show mild anisocytosis without significant poikilocytosis, and platelets appear reduced in this field. No Auer rods are identified. Findings are consistent with circulating blasts in the setting of acute myeloid leukemia.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have more abundant cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells and condensed chromatin, not the fine blast chromatin seen here.
These show a left shift with myelocytes and metamyelocytes and nucleated red cells, with only rare blasts.
Lymphoblasts can look identical on smear; flow cytometry (TdT, CD19/CD3 vs MPO/CD13/CD33) is required.
Lymphoma cells often have nuclear clefts or clumped chromatin and express mature B- or T-cell markers without CD34.

63847.recognize_zh: HPLC 圖上 4.09 分鐘（D-window，43.6%）與 4.36 分鐘（S-window，33.8%）兩個相鄰的高峰形成「雙峰」，HbA 幾乎消失（Ao 2.0%），HbF 升高到 12.6%；同時出現 S 與 D 變異且無 HbA，符合 HbS/HbD-Punjab 雙重異合子（HbSD disease）。
features: Cation-exchange HPLC report with peak table and chromatogram (lower-resolution scan)
Two large closely spaced variant peaks: D-window at 4.09 min (43.6%) and S-window at 4.36 min (33.8%)
Near-absent HbA (Ao 2.0% at 2.10 min)
Raised HbF at 12.6% (1.12 min) and HbA2 3.5%
Several small unknown peaks between 1.9 and 2.9 min
63847.describe_en: Cation-exchange HPLC shows two large adjacent variant peaks, one in the D-window at 4.09 minutes (43.6%) and one in the S-window at 4.36 minutes (33.8%), with near-absence of HbA (2.0%). HbF is increased at 12.6% and HbA2 is 3.5%. The co-existence of D- and S-window variants without significant HbA indicates compound heterozygosity for HbS and a D-window variant, most likely HbD-Punjab, confirmed by parental studies showing HbS trait and HbD trait. Findings are consistent with HbSD disease, a clinically significant sickling disorder.

ddx.vs: HbSS shows a single S-window peak without a separate D-window peak.

ddx.dx: HbS trait with a split or degraded S peak
ddx.vs: Sample aging can create shoulder peaks, but HbS trait retains more HbA than HbS, whereas here HbA is almost absent.
HbG-Philadelphia is an alpha-chain variant producing hybrid peaks with retained HbA and is non-sickling in combination, so DNA sequencing is needed to identify the D-window variant definitively.

63783.recognize_zh: 網狀纖維染色（reticulin stain）下，骨髓組織幾乎整片被黑色、彼此交錯成網、局部粗厚成束的纖維佔滿，造血細胞與脂肪都很少；這種瀰漫而密集、有粗纖維束的交錯網狀纖維，對應 MF-2 到 MF-3 級骨髓纖維化，符合真性紅血球增多症後骨髓纖維化。
features: Bone marrow core biopsy stained for reticulin with a pale green counterstain
Diffuse, dense network of intersecting black reticulin fibers throughout the marrow space
Focal coarse, thick fiber bundles, raising the possibility of associated collagenization
Marrow elements streamed and compressed between fibers; hematopoietic cells and fat sparse at this magnification
Crush and tissue fragmentation at the edges; no bone trabeculae clearly included in this field
63783.describe_en: Reticulin-stained bone marrow biopsy shows a diffuse and dense increase in intersecting reticulin fibers throughout the marrow space, with focal coarse, thick fiber bundles. The fibrous network entraps and compresses residual marrow elements, and fat is sparse in this field. These findings correspond to MF-2 grade fibrosis, approaching MF-3 where thick bundles are present; a trichrome stain is needed to confirm collagen deposition, and osteosclerosis should be assessed on H&E. In a patient with prior polycythemia vera, findings are consistent with post-polycythemic myelofibrosis.

ddx.vs: PMF shows identical marrow fibrosis and is separated by the absence of a documented prior polycythemia vera or essential thrombocythemia phase.
Post-ET myelofibrosis has the same fibrosis grading but follows documented ET, often CALR- or MPL-mutated, rather than JAK2-mutated erythrocytosis.
Fibrosis due to metastatic carcinoma, hairy cell leukemia, mastocytosis or renal osteodystrophy is identified by the associated infiltrate or clinical cause on H&E and immunohistochemistry.
APMF presents acutely with pancytopenia, ≥20% CD34+ blasts and dysplastic megakaryocytes without splenomegaly or a preceding MPN history.

exam.answer_en: Post-polycythemic myelofibrosis — reticulin stain with diffuse dense intersecting fibers (MF-2 to MF-3)
pearls_zh: 考法：問網狀纖維分級。MF-2 為瀰漫密集且廣泛交錯，可有局部粗纖維束；MF-3 再加上粗厚纖維束（相當於 collagen），常伴骨硬化。
分級只在造血區評估；reticulin 為銀染，collagen 需 trichrome 確認，骨硬化看 H&E。
Post-PV MF（IWG-MRT）：有先前確診 PV，骨髓纖維化 grade 2–3，再加貧血、脾腫大增加、leukoerythroblastosis、全身症狀等次要條件至少兩項。
PV 幾乎全帶 JAK2 突變（V617F 或 exon 12）；纖維化期治療考量 JAK 抑制劑（如 ruxolitinib）與異體移植評估。
exam.pitfall_zh: 形態與 primary myelofibrosis 無法區分，須靠先前 PV/ET 病史；也要排除轉移癌、HCL 等次發性纖維化。

quiz.q: 依 European consensus，此網狀纖維染色屬幾級？

63719.recognize_zh: 箭頭處是一條橫貫視野、帶淡紫色纖維狀基質的條帶，沿其長軸排列著長橢圓形、染色質細緻的紡錘狀細胞核，這是骨髓抽吸片中被帶出的微血管內皮細胞（capillary endothelial cells），周圍則是正常造血細胞。
features: Linear cord of spindle-shaped cells with elongated oval nuclei aligned parallel to the long axis
Nuclei with finely granular to smooth chromatin and no conspicuous nucleoli
Pale lilac, fibrillar, poorly demarcated cytoplasm/stroma forming a continuous strip
Adherent hematopoietic cells along the vessel: myelocytes, band neutrophil and erythroid precursors
Background red cells with focal rouleaux-like stacking
63719.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a linear, band-like structure with pale fibrillar lilac cytoplasm containing a row of elongated, spindle-shaped nuclei with fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli, consistent with capillary endothelial cells from a marrow vessel. The nuclei are bland and uniform without mitoses or cohesive epithelial clustering. Surrounding hematopoietic cells, including granulocytic precursors and erythroid precursors, show normal maturation. Findings represent a normal bone marrow vascular structure (capillary) and should not be mistaken for a pathologic cell cluster.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma clumps are cohesive three-dimensional groups of large pleomorphic cells with high N:C ratio and nucleoli, not a single-file row of bland spindle nuclei within a fibrillar strip.
Isolated marrow fibroblasts are scattered spindle cells with wispy cytoplasm, whereas endothelial cells form an organized tubular band with aligned nuclei.
Smudged or crushed cells lack the regular elongated oval nuclei and the continuous linear vascular architecture.
Malignant spindle cells show nuclear atypia, hyperchromasia, prominent nucleoli and mitoses, which are absent here.

63655.recognize_zh: 巨噬細胞的細胞質內擠滿許多小型卵圓形酵母菌（約 2–4 µm），每顆有偏心、半月形的深紫色染色體部，周圍一圈透明暈（假莢膜），看不到動基體（kinetoplast），符合 Histoplasma capsulatum。
features: Macrophage with dense eccentric nucleus and cytoplasm crowded with numerous small intracellular organisms
Organisms uniform, oval, approximately 2-4 µm, each with an eccentric crescent-shaped dark purple staining body
Each yeast surrounded by a clear halo (pseudocapsule)
No rod-shaped kinetoplast identified
Image slightly out of focus; background red cells
63655.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a macrophage whose cytoplasm is packed with numerous small, uniform, oval intracellular organisms measuring approximately 2-4 µm. Each organism has an eccentric crescent-shaped basophilic body surrounded by a clear halo, and no rod-shaped kinetoplast is identified, although focus is suboptimal. Findings are consistent with intracellular Histoplasma capsulatum yeasts; confirmation by GMS or PAS stain, culture, or urine/serum antigen testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Amastigotes show a nucleus plus a small rod-shaped kinetoplast without a clear halo and are GMS/PAS negative.
Talaromyces yeasts are elongated, sausage-shaped, and divide by fission with a central transverse septum.
Tachyzoites are crescent-shaped without a halo and lack a fungal cell wall on GMS.
Cryptococcus is larger and variable in size with narrow-based budding and a thick mucicarmine-positive capsule.

exam.answer_en: Histoplasma capsulatum — marrow macrophage packed with 2–4 µm intracellular yeasts with clear halos and no kinetoplast
pearls_zh: 考法：巨噬細胞內 2–4 µm 小體三大鑑別必考：Histoplasma（透明暈、無動基體）、Leishmania（有棒狀動基體、無暈）、Talaromyces marneffei（橫隔、分裂增殖）。
特殊染色：Histoplasma 為真菌，GMS 與 PAS 陽性；Leishmania 為原蟲，GMS 陰性，是切片上最實用的區分點。
確診：尿液或血清 Histoplasma 抗原、真菌培養；瀰漫性感染多見於 HIV 等免疫低下者，並可誘發 HLH。
治療：瀰漫性重症以 liposomal amphotericin B 誘導，再以 itraconazole 維持。台灣與東南亞需同時想到 Talaromyces marneffei。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 Leishmania amastigote：Leishmania 每顆有核加一根棒狀 kinetoplast、無透明暈且 GMS 陰性；Histoplasma 有假莢膜透明暈、無 kinetoplast、GMS 陽性。

quiz.q: 巨噬細胞內這些帶透明暈的小體最可能是什麼？哪個特殊染色可與 Leishmania 區分？
quiz.a: Histoplasma capsulatum 酵母菌；GMS（Histoplasma 陽性、Leishmania 陰性）

63463.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中的大型巨核細胞，細胞核大而分葉，豐富紫紅色顆粒狀細胞質內清楚可見一顆完整的分葉嗜中性球（三至四個小核葉），被包入細胞形態完整無退化，即巨核細胞穿入現象（emperipolesis）。
features: Large megakaryocyte with a large lobulated nucleus and coarse chromatin
Abundant pinkish-purple granular cytoplasm
Intact segmented neutrophil with three to four dense lobes enclosed within the megakaryocyte cytoplasm
Engulfed neutrophil shows preserved nuclear morphology without digestion
Background band neutrophil, myelocyte, small dense nucleated cell, and red cells
63463.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large megakaryocyte with a lobulated nucleus and abundant granular cytoplasm. An intact segmented neutrophil with well-preserved lobes is present within the megakaryocyte cytoplasm, without features of degradation. Surrounding myeloid precursors appear unremarkable. Findings are consistent with megakaryocytic emperipolesis, a non-specific finding seen in reactive states (here, autoimmune hemolytic anemia) and increased in myeloproliferative neoplasms, especially primary myelofibrosis.

ddx.vs: Phagocytosis is performed by histiocytes with vacuolated cytoplasm, and the ingested cell is degraded, whereas emperipolesis occurs in a megakaryocyte with an intact passenger cell.

ddx.dx: Hyperlobated or dysplastic megakaryocyte with separated nuclear lobes
ddx.vs: Megakaryocyte lobes share the same chromatin texture and connect to the main nucleus, whereas the neutrophil lobes are smaller, denser, and grouped as a distinct cell.
An overlying cell lies in a different focal plane without a surrounding clear halo inside the megakaryocyte cytoplasm.

exam.answer_en: Megakaryocytic emperipolesis — well-preserved segmented neutrophil inside a large megakaryocyte
pearls_zh: 考法：考官可能問「巨核細胞內這顆細胞是什麼？它還活著嗎？」答中性球，emperipolesis 中被包入細胞保持活性並可離開。
在骨髓切片或抹片見 emperipolesis 明顯增加，應考慮 MPN（尤其 PMF）或反應性巨核細胞增生，需結合 JAK2/CALR/MPL 與 reticulin 染色評估。
Emperipolesis（活細胞穿入）vs hemophagocytosis（巨噬細胞吞噬血球並消化）vs entosis（細胞侵入後於宿主內死亡）是常見的名詞對照。
巨核細胞本身核為單一多分葉大核；看到內含細胞具獨立小葉與粉紅細胞質時，才能判定為 emperipolesis。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 dysplastic 巨核細胞分離的核小葉當成被包入的中性球；真正 emperipolesis 的中性球小葉外有自己的淡粉紅細胞質與透明暈。

quiz.q: 巨核細胞 emperipolesis 增加最常與哪一種骨髓增生性腫瘤的纖維化機轉相關？

63399.recognize_zh: 小腸黏膜被一致的中型淋巴球瀰漫浸潤，上皮內淋巴球明顯增加（C 箭頭），腫瘤延伸到脂肪層（B）；免疫染色 CD3、CD8、CD56 陽性，這組合指向單形性親上皮性腸道 T 細胞淋巴瘤（MEITL）。
features: Diffuse transmural infiltrate of monomorphic medium-sized lymphoid cells replacing intestinal wall and extending into adipose tissue
Marked epitheliotropism with intraepithelial lymphocytes within villous and crypt epithelium (arrow)
Tumor cells with round to irregular hyperchromatic nuclei, small nucleoli and a moderate rim of pale cytoplasm; mitoses present
Relatively little inflammatory background or necrosis in the high-power field
IHC panel: CD3, CD7, CD8 and CD56 positive, BCL-2 staining weak to positive in tumor cells
63399.describe_en: Sections of small intestine show a diffuse infiltrate of atypical lymphoid cells that effaces the mucosa, ulcerates the surface and extends through the wall into the adipose tissue. The adjacent mucosa shows prominent intraepithelial lymphocytosis. At high power the neoplastic cells are monomorphic and medium-sized with irregular hyperchromatic nuclei, small nucleoli, a moderate rim of pale cytoplasm and frequent mitoses. Immunohistochemistry shows the tumor cells are positive for CD3, CD7, CD8 and CD56. Findings are consistent with monomorphic epitheliotropic intestinal T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: EATL has pleomorphic medium-to-large cells with abundant inflammatory background and necrosis, is usually CD8-/CD56-, and arises in celiac disease.
ENKTL shows angiocentric necrosis and is EBER-positive with cytoplasmic CD3, whereas MEITL is EBV-negative.
RCD II has aberrant intraepithelial lymphocytes without a destructive transmural mass of atypical cells.

ddx.dx: Indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the GI tract
ddx.vs: The indolent disorder consists of small bland lymphocytes confined to the lamina propria with a low Ki-67 and without epitheliotropism or transmural invasion.

63399.stain: H&E; IHC: CD3, CD7, CD8, BCL-2, CD56

63335.recognize_zh: A 圖為周邊血中一個單核球樣的吞噬細胞，胞質內包著一顆紅血球；B 圖為骨髓抹片中一個巨噬細胞吞入多個有核細胞（嗜中性球等）。兩者合看就是血球吞噬（hemophagocytosis），配合臨床可支持 HLH。
features: Panel A (PB): mononuclear phagocyte with irregular nucleus and gray-blue cytoplasm containing an engulfed red cell
Panel A: background red cells with mild anisocytosis; no other leukocytes in field
Panel B (BM aspirate): macrophage with abundant cytoplasm containing multiple engulfed nucleated cells, including segmented neutrophils
Panel B: engulfed cells show intact nuclear lobes within a clear phagocytic vacuole
Panel B: thick hemodilute aspirate background limits cytologic detail
63335.describe_en: Composite image. Panel A, peripheral blood smear, shows a mononuclear phagocyte (monocyte/histiocyte) containing an ingested red cell. Panel B, bone marrow aspirate, shows a macrophage engulfing multiple nucleated cells, including segmented neutrophils. No lymphoma cells are identified in these fields. Findings demonstrate hemophagocytosis in blood and marrow, which, in conjunction with fever, cytopenias and hypertriglyceridemia, supports secondary hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis associated with DLBCL; hemophagocytosis alone is not diagnostic.

ddx.dx: Monocyte with vacuole or overlying red cell (artifact)
ddx.vs: An overlapping red cell lies outside the cytoplasmic boundary in a different focal plane, whereas true phagocytosis shows a surrounding vacuole within the cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Reactive hemophagocytosis after transfusion or infection
ddx.vs: Isolated hemophagocytosis is common after transfusion or sepsis and is not HLH without meeting HLH-2004 clinical/laboratory criteria.
In emperipolesis intact cells pass through the cytoplasm without degradation, whereas hemophagocytosis shows engulfed and degenerating cells in phagocytic vacuoles.
Erythrophagocytic blasts have fine blast chromatin and high N:C ratio, as in AML with t(8;16), rather than mature histiocytic features.

exam.answer_en: Hemophagocytosis supporting secondary HLH — phagocyte with ingested red cell in blood (A) and macrophage engulfing neutrophils in marrow (B)
pearls_zh: 考法：指吞噬細胞問「胞質內包的是什麼」，再問「只看到噬血可否診斷 HLH」——不行，噬血現象既不敏感也不特異，需符合臨床與檢驗準則。
HLH-2004：分子診斷，或 8 項中符合 5 項——發燒、脾腫大、≥2 系血球減少、高三酸甘油酯和/或低纖維蛋白原、噬血現象、NK 活性低、ferritin ≥500 ng/mL、sCD25 升高。
成人次發性 HLH 常見誘因：淋巴瘤（T/NK 或 B 細胞，如本例 DLBCL）、EBV 等感染、自體免疫疾病（MAS）；成人可用 HScore 估計機率。
周邊血直接看到噬血很罕見，一旦見到應積極評估 HLH；治療需處理誘因，並常以 dexamethasone、etoposide 為基礎（HLH-94）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把疊在單核球上的紅血球當成被吞噬；真正吞噬物位於胞質內、同一焦平面並有吞噬泡空暈。也勿把 emperipolesis（細胞穿過而不被分解）當成噬血。

quiz.q: 圖 B 巨噬細胞胞質內的分葉核細胞是什麼？此現象稱為什麼？

63079.recognize_zh: EMA 免疫染色中，一片小淋巴球背景裡只有兩顆大型細胞呈細胞膜及細胞質棕色陽性，另有少數大細胞淡染；背景小淋巴球皆為陰性，這種散在的 EMA 陽性大細胞符合 NLPHL 的 LP 細胞（popcorn cells）。
features: Immunohistochemical stain for EMA at high power
Two large cells with membranous and cytoplasmic brown EMA staining and vesicular nuclei (upper center)
A few other large cells show faint, weak EMA staining
Background small lymphocytes with round dark nuclei are EMA-negative
Diffuse sheets of small lymphocytes without sheets of large cells
63079.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for EMA shows scattered large cells with membranous and cytoplasmic positivity, including two strongly stained cells, while a few additional large cells show weak staining. The background small lymphocytes are negative. EMA expression is seen in a subset of cases of nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin lymphoma and supports the identity of these large cells as LP (lymphocyte predominant) cells. Findings are consistent with nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin lymphoma in the appropriate morphologic and immunophenotypic context (CD20+, CD45+, CD30-, CD15-).

ddx.vs: Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are generally EMA-negative and CD30/CD15-positive with weak PAX5, whereas LP cells are EMA-positive in a subset with strong CD20, OCT2 and BOB1.
Neoplastic cells may be EMA-positive and similar in appearance, but they lie in a diffuse T-cell and histiocyte-rich background lacking nodules with follicular dendritic meshworks and small B cells.
ALCL cells are often EMA-positive but form cohesive clusters with strong uniform CD30 and T-cell/ALK expression, unlike CD30-negative LP cells.

63271.recognize_zh: CD7/CD34 流式散佈圖中，紅色芽細胞族群位於上方，CD34 異常強陽性且帶有弱 CD7，紫色正常 T 細胞為 CD7+CD34−，棕色成熟嗜中性球與單核球兩者皆陰性；骨髓系芽細胞異常表現 CD7 且 CD34 偏亮，是 TAM／唐氏症相關芽細胞常見的表型。
features: Flow cytometry dot plot: CD7-APC700 (x-axis) versus CD34-PC7 (y-axis) with quadrant gates
Red blast population: bright CD34 with dim CD7, spanning into the CD34+CD7+ quadrant
Purple normal T cells: CD7-positive (brighter than blasts) and CD34-negative
Brown mature neutrophils and monocytes: CD34-negative and CD7-negative (lower-left quadrant)
Blast CD7 intensity is clearly lower than that of normal T cells, confirming dim aberrant expression
63271.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot of CD7 versus CD34 shows a large blast population (red) with abnormally bright CD34 and dim, aberrant CD7 expression. Normal T cells (purple) express brighter CD7 without CD34, and mature neutrophils and monocytes (brown) are negative for both, serving as internal controls. Together with CD33 and CD117 co-expression on the blasts, this aberrant myeloid blast phenotype in a neonate with Down syndrome is consistent with transient abnormal myelopoiesis; CD7 expression alone does not indicate T lineage.

ddx.dx: Myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome
ddx.vs: Shares the CD34+CD7+ myeloid/megakaryoblastic phenotype and is separated clinically by age, persistence and additional mutations rather than by flow cytometry.
ETP-ALL is CD7+CD34+ but expresses cytoplasmic CD3 and lacks the megakaryocytic markers (CD41/CD61) typical of TAM blasts.
Requires bright cytoplasmic CD3 on the blasts, whereas dim CD7 on myeloid blasts is a common non-lineage-defining aberrancy.

63207.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片九格拼圖，每格都有大團淡紫至深紫色、雲絮狀、邊緣呈羽毛狀的無細胞沉積物，淋巴球、漿細胞與髓系細胞圍繞或陷於其中；同一種 cloud-like 物質在多個視野重複出現，提示類澱粉（amyloid）浸潤骨髓。
features: Recurrent large extracellular aggregates of amorphous, fluffy, cloud-like lilac to deep purple material in all nine fields
Deposits are acellular with granular to faintly fibrillar texture and feathery margins
Small lymphocytes, plasma cells and maturing myeloid cells clustered around or embedded within the deposits
Occasional darker blue cells trapped in the material; background gray-purple red cell masses
63207.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears (composite of nine fields) show multiple large, irregular extracellular aggregates of amorphous, fluffy, cloud-like lilac to deep purple material with granular to faintly fibrillar texture and feathery margins. Lymphocytes, plasma cells and maturing myeloid cells are clustered around and trapped within the deposits. The consistent appearance across fields favors a true deposit over focal artifact, and is suggestive of amyloid; Congo red staining with apple-green birefringence on particle, clot or trephine sections is required for confirmation. Findings are suggestive of bone marrow involvement by amyloidosis.

ddx.vs: These have a fibrillar meshwork or granular platelet texture, occur in partially clotted samples and are Congo red negative.
Ground substance is pale mucoid background material in a hypocellular smear, Alcian blue positive and Congo red negative.
Precipitate is dark, crystalline or granular, randomly distributed and unrelated to cells.

63143.recognize_zh: 血片中可見一顆較大的淋巴球，核輪廓不規則、有褶皺感（腦回狀，cerebriform），旁邊還有兩顆核質比高、染色質緻密的小淋巴球，符合大小不一的 Sézary 細胞。
features: Large atypical lymphocyte with irregular, folded nuclear contour suggestive of cerebriform nucleus
Hyperchromatic nuclei with dense chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant pale-blue cytoplasm, high N:C ratio
Two smaller lymphocytes with dense chromatin and subtly irregular outlines
Background red cells unremarkable; occasional platelets
63143.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows atypical lymphocytes of variable size. The largest cell has an irregular, folded nuclear contour with dense hyperchromatic chromatin, no conspicuous nucleolus, and scant pale cytoplasm; two smaller lymphocytes with high N:C ratio and dense chromatin are also present. The nuclear grooves characteristic of cerebriform nuclei are only partly resolved at this magnification. Findings are suggestive of circulating Sézary cells (large and small variants) in the appropriate immunophenotypic and clinical context.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have more abundant cytoplasm hugging red cells and smooth nuclear contours, without cerebriform folding.
ATLL flower cells show deeply polylobated, petal-like nuclei rather than finely grooved cerebriform nuclei, with HTLV-1 positivity.
T-PLL cells have a visible single nucleolus and cytoplasmic blebs, and lack cerebriform nuclear folding.
CLL cells are small round with clumped soccer-ball chromatin and smudge cells, and are B-cell (CD5+CD23+) by flow.

exam.answer_en: Circulating Sézary cells, large and small variants — atypical lymphocytes with irregular folded (cerebriform) hyperchromatic nuclei and scant cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：同一視野出現大、小兩型 Sézary cell，考官問「大小不一是否仍屬同一疾病」；是，large 與 small cell variants 可並存。
光學顯微鏡對小型 Sézary cell 的腦回狀溝紋不易看清，因此診斷與分期倚賴 flow（CD4+CD7−、CD4+CD26−）與 TCR 克隆性，而非單靠形態計數。
Sézary syndrome 定義為紅皮症＋淋巴結病變＋周邊血腫瘤性 T 細胞（B2）；與 mycosis fungoides 同屬 CTCL，但預後較差。
良性紅皮症（如嚴重異位性皮膚炎、藥物反應）也可見少量腦回狀淋巴球，血液中少量 Sézary-like cell 不足以診斷。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤為反應性淋巴球；反應性淋巴球胞質較多、會包覆紅血球且核輪廓平滑，Sézary cell 胞質極少、染色質緻密且核呈摺疊溝紋。

quiz.q: 此片形態難以單獨確診 Sézary syndrome，需加做哪兩項檢查？
quiz.a: 周邊血 flow cytometry（CD4+CD7−／CD26− 族群、CD4/CD8 比）與 TCR 基因重組克隆性分析

63015.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中大多數紅血球呈卵圓形，且許多細胞中央淡染區變成橫向的縫隙（stomatocytes），有些甚至出現兩條平行縫隙或被橫條分隔（theta cells / knizocytes）；卵圓形紅血球加上多種縫隙型態，是東南亞卵圓形紅血球症（SAO）的特徵。
features: Numerous oval to slightly elongated red cells (ovalocytes) with mild anisocytosis
Many stomatocytes with slit-like central pallor oriented along or across the long axis
Occasional cells with two slits or a central transverse ridge (theta cells/knizocytes)
Scattered round, slightly larger pale cells without central pallor
Platelets normal in appearance; no spherocytes, fragments or nucleated red cells
63015.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (Wright-Giemsa) shows a red cell population dominated by ovalocytes, many of which display slit-like central pallor (stomatocytes), with occasional cells showing double slits or a central transverse bar (theta cells). There is mild anisocytosis, without spherocytes, schistocytes, target cells or nucleated red cells, and platelets appear normal. The combination of oval stomatocytes with one or two transverse slits is characteristic. Findings are consistent with Southeast Asian ovalocytosis, supported by reduced eosin-5'-maleimide binding and confirmable by detecting the SLC4A1 27-bp deletion.

ddx.vs: Hereditary elliptocytes are more elongated with preserved or absent central pallor and lack the slit-like stomatocytic pallor and theta cells of SAO.
Hereditary stomatocytes are round rather than oval, and the disorder shows cation leak with overt hemolysis instead of rigid ovalocytes.
Acquired stomatocytes are round, usually fewer, and accompanied by target cells or macrocytes, without predominant ovalocytes.
Iron deficiency shows hypochromic microcytes with pencil cells and increased central pallor, not stomatocytic slits.

exam.answer_en: Southeast Asian ovalocytosis — oval stomatocytes with one or two transverse slits (theta cells)
pearls_zh: 考法：問這群卵圓形、中央縫隙的紅血球叫什麼疾病，以及分子缺陷：SLC4A1（band 3）27-bp deletion。
SAO 為體染色體顯性，異型合子通常無症狀或僅輕微溶血；同型合子被認為與胎兒致死相關。
SAO 紅血球較硬，與抵抗 Plasmodium（包括嚴重腦性瘧）相關，故盛行於東南亞與巴布亞紐幾內亞。
Band 3 缺陷使 EMA binding 下降，易與遺傳性球形紅血球症混淆；可用 PCR 偵測 27-bp deletion 確認。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為遺傳性橢圓形紅血球症（HE）：HE 細胞較細長、無縫隙狀中央淡染；SAO 為較胖的卵圓形且帶 1–2 條橫向縫隙（stomatocytic ovalocytes）。

quiz.q: 這種卵圓形帶橫向縫隙的紅血球，其致病基因缺陷為何？

62951.recognize_zh: CD20 免疫染色中，成片單一型態的中小型淋巴球全部呈強烈膜陽性，核圓至略不規則，只有血管內皮與間質細胞陰性，證明是 B 細胞腫瘤；需搭配 CD5、cyclin D1/SOX11 才能判定為被套細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse sheets of monotonous small to medium-sized lymphoid cells
Strong, uniform membranous CD20 staining in virtually all tumor cells
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with scant to moderate cytoplasm
No residual CD20-negative T-cell rich areas evident in the field
Negative stromal and endothelial cells along small vessels
62951.describe_en: CD20 immunostain shows diffuse sheets of monotonous small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with strong, uniform membranous positivity. The tumor cells have round to slightly irregular nuclei with scant cytoplasm, while vessels and stromal cells are negative. This establishes a diffuse B-cell population; in the context of the reference case, the findings support mantle cell lymphoma, which requires CD5 co-expression and cyclin D1 or SOX11 positivity for confirmation.

ddx.vs: SLL shows proliferation centers and dim CD20 with CD23+/LEF1+ and cyclin D1-negative cells.
FL is CD10+/BCL6+ with centrocytes and centroblasts and is CD5- and cyclin D1-negative.
MZL has monocytoid/plasmacytoid cells and is CD5-, CD10- and cyclin D1-negative.
These have larger cells with finer chromatin or vesicular nuclei and high Ki-67, which cannot be judged on CD20 alone.

62823.recognize_zh: Lambda 輕鏈免疫染色下，瀰漫浸潤的大型淡胞質腫瘤細胞全為陰性（藍色核），只見細胞間細網狀的血清背景染色及零星幾顆小型陽性細胞；與 kappa 同樣陰性，表示腫瘤不是輕鏈限制的漿細胞腫瘤。
features: IHC for lambda light chain on a marrow core diffusely infiltrated by tumor cells with scattered fat spaces
Tumor cells with pale cytoplasm and round nuclei are negative
Delicate lace-like interstitial brown staining from serum immunoglobulin outlining cells and adipocytes
Only rare scattered small positive cells, consistent with residual polytypic plasma cells
No sheet-like or clustered cytoplasmic lambda positivity
62823.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for lambda light chain on the bone marrow core shows that the diffusely infiltrating tumor cells are negative. A delicate lace-like interstitial staining pattern reflects background serum immunoglobulin, and only rare scattered small positive cells, likely residual reactive plasma cells, are present. With concurrent kappa negativity, the absence of light chain expression in the neoplastic cells argues against a plasma cell neoplasm and supports metastatic carcinoma with plasmacytoid morphology.

ddx.vs: Myeloma would show strong cytoplasmic lambda staining in most neoplastic cells, rather than only background serum staining.
Light chain-negative myeloma remains CD138/MUM1 positive and cytokeratin, GATA3 and ER negative.
Carcinoma is kappa and lambda negative with cytokeratin, GATA3 and ER expression, fitting this case.

62759.recognize_zh: 骨髓與肝臟切片的巨噬細胞胞質內擠滿許多細小圓點狀的無鞭毛體（amastigote，放大圖可見核與動基體），免疫染色顯示巨噬細胞內棕色顆粒狀陽性，即使血清學陰性仍支持內臟利什曼原蟲病。
features: Bone marrow macrophage containing numerous small round to oval intracytoplasmic organisms (arrow, inset)
Organisms about 2-4 micrometers with a dot-like nucleus and adjacent kinetoplast visible at high magnification
Liver section: Kupffer cell/macrophage distended by abundant intracellular amastigotes (arrow, inset)
Immunostain shows granular brown positivity of organisms within macrophages in marrow and liver
Background marrow with erythroid and myeloid precursors; no well-formed granulomas in the fields shown
62759.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy shows a cellular marrow in which macrophages contain numerous small round to oval intracytoplasmic organisms with a punctate nucleus and kinetoplast. A liver biopsy shows Kupffer cells/macrophages distended by similar abundant intracellular organisms. Immunohistochemistry demonstrates granular positivity of the intracellular organisms in both the marrow and liver sections. Findings are consistent with visceral leishmaniasis with bone marrow and hepatic involvement, despite negative serology; PCR confirmation and speciation are recommended.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts are similar in size but have a clear halo, lack a kinetoplast, and stain with GMS and PAS.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescent-shaped and lack a kinetoplast, forming pseudocysts in various cell types rather than filling macrophages.
T. cruzi amastigotes also have a kinetoplast but are found mainly in cardiac and smooth muscle cells rather than marrow and hepatic macrophages.
Talaromyces yeasts divide by fission with a central transverse septum and are GMS-positive, lacking a kinetoplast.

exam.answer_en: Visceral leishmaniasis — marrow and hepatic macrophages packed with amastigotes (Leishman-Donovan bodies) showing nucleus and kinetoplast
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指巨噬細胞內小圓點狀微生物問名稱（amastigote／Leishman-Donovan body），關鍵辨識點是「核＋棒狀 kinetoplast」。
Visceral leishmaniasis（kala-azar）由 L. donovani／L. infantum 引起，經白蛉（sandfly）傳播；表現發燒、脾腫大、全血球減少、高 gamma globulin 血症。
血清學（如 rK39）在 HIV 或免疫抑制病人可能陰性，此時需靠組織找病原或 PCR 確診。
可繼發 HLH，骨髓噬血現象合併發燒脾腫時要主動找 Leishmania。
治療首選 liposomal amphotericin B。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 Histoplasma capsulatum 混淆；Histoplasma 酵母有透明暈、無 kinetoplast、GMS/PAS 陽性，Leishmania amastigote 有核與 kinetoplast、GMS 陰性。

quiz.q: 巨噬細胞內小圓點狀病原的名稱？與 Histoplasma 區分的關鍵構造？

62695.recognize_zh: 淋巴球 gate 的 CD3 對 CD7 流式四象限圖：CD7+CD3− 細胞高達 40.63%（綠色 NK 細胞），CD7+CD3+ T 細胞 52.33%，CD7−CD3− 為 6.37%，表示表面 CD3 陰性的 NK 細胞明顯增加。
features: Quadrant dot plot gated on lymphocytes: CD3-PC5.5 (x) versus CD7-APC700 (y)
CD7+CD3- quadrant 40.63%, dominated by green NK-cell population
CD7+CD3+ quadrant 52.33% (blue T cells), with some T cells showing dimmer CD7
CD7-CD3- quadrant 6.37% (magenta, likely B cells)
CD7-CD3+ quadrant 0.67%, no significant CD7-loss T-cell population
62695.describe_en: Flow cytometric quadrant plot of the lymphocyte gate displays CD3 versus CD7. Surface CD3-negative, CD7-positive NK cells account for 40.63% of lymphocytes, with CD3-positive, CD7-positive T cells 52.33%, double-negative cells 6.37%, and only 0.67% CD7-negative T cells. The marked expansion of surface CD3-negative NK cells without a CD7-loss T-cell population supports an NK-cell rather than T-cell LGL process. Findings are consistent with the reported chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells, pending absolute NK count and persistence over 6 months.

ddx.vs: T-LGL expands a surface CD3-positive population, often with CD7 or CD5 loss, whereas the expansion here is CD3 negative.
Reactive expansions are transient with polyclonal KIR expression, whereas CLPD-NK persists with restricted KIR or uniform CD94/NKG2A.
ANKL is typically CD56 bright, EBV positive and clinically fulminant rather than an indolent lymphocytosis.

62631.recognize_zh: 體液細胞塊中的大型腫瘤細胞核呈強棕色 MUM1 陽性，而夾雜其中較小的反應性淋巴球核呈藍色陰性，大小對比清楚，顯示腫瘤具漿母細胞分化。
features: Cell block aggregate of large tumor cells admixed with small lymphocytes
Strong nuclear MUM1 staining in large cells with vesicular nuclei and visible nucleoli
Small round lymphocytes are MUM1-negative (blue), internal size and staining contrast
Some cells show additional weak cytoplasmic blush
Loose, discohesive arrangement in proteinaceous material
62631.describe_en: MUM1 (IRF4) immunohistochemistry on an effusion cell block shows strong nuclear staining in the large neoplastic cells, while the admixed small reactive lymphocytes are negative. The positive cells have enlarged vesicular nuclei with nucleoli. MUM1 positivity indicates plasmablastic/post-germinal center differentiation; in a CD20-negative, light-chain-negative, HHV8-positive effusion lymphoma, findings are consistent with primary effusion lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Also MUM1-positive with CD20 loss but HHV8/LANA-negative.
Also MUM1-positive but retains CD20/PAX5 and is HHV8-negative.
Melanoma may express MUM1 but is S100/SOX10-positive and CD45-negative.

62567.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片：左側嗜中性球細胞質內塞滿多個有透明空暈的卵圓形小酵母（莢膜組織漿菌），右側的桿狀／分葉嗜中性球雖無病原，但有明顯毒性顆粒與細胞質空泡，反映嚴重感染的全身性反應。
features: Left neutrophil with cytoplasm packed by numerous small oval yeast forms with clear halos
Yeasts uniform, about 2-4 um, with an eccentric basophilic dot or crescent
Right neutrophil (band to early segmented form) with prominent toxic granulation
Cytoplasmic vacuolization in the right neutrophil
Background red cells with scattered platelets and rouleaux-like stacking
62567.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two neutrophils. The neutrophil on the left contains numerous small, uniform, oval intracytoplasmic yeast forms, each with an eccentric basophilic dot or crescent and a surrounding clear halo, while the neutrophil on the right, a band to early segmented form, lacks organisms but shows prominent toxic granulation and cytoplasmic vacuolization. No kinetoplasts or intraerythrocytic parasites are identified. Findings are consistent with disseminated histoplasmosis with circulating Histoplasma capsulatum in neutrophils and accompanying toxic neutrophil changes.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes show a distinct kinetoplast beside the nucleus and are found mainly in macrophages rather than neutrophils.
Toxic neutrophils show coarse dark granules and empty vacuoles but no discrete oval organisms with a central body and halo.
Talaromyces yeast cells are elongated with a central transverse septum dividing by fission.
Morulae are mulberry-like clusters of tiny basophilic bacteria in a single inclusion, not separate haloed yeast cells.

exam.answer_en: Disseminated histoplasmosis — neutrophil packed with haloed Histoplasma yeasts, with toxic granulation and vacuolization in an adjacent neutrophil
pearls_zh: 考法：圖中兩顆嗜中性球對照，考官會先問左邊細胞內的病原，再問右邊細胞的反應性變化（toxic granulation、vacuolization）代表什麼。
在血液抹片直接看到 Histoplasma 通常表示病原負荷很高，多見於 AIDS 或接受免疫抑制治療者，屬需立即抗黴菌治療的急症。
診斷輔助：尿液 Histoplasma antigen 敏感度在瀰漫性感染較高；骨髓抹片與切片（GMS 染色）、培養可一併送檢。
細胞質空泡化在嗜中性球中比單純毒性顆粒更提示菌血症/敗血症，但檢體放置過久（EDTA 儲存）也會產生空泡，需用新鮮抹片判讀。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把胞內酵母誤認為粗大毒性顆粒或吞噬的血小板：酵母大小一致、呈卵圓形、有偏心深染點與透明暈；毒性顆粒則是細小均勻分布的深紫色顆粒。

quiz.q: 右側嗜中性球沒有病原，它顯示了哪兩種反應性改變？

62503.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片低倍下，骨小樑之間的骨髓腔幾乎 100% 被深藍色、均一的小淋巴球瀰漫性佔滿，脂肪幾乎消失，只剩少數散在的巨核細胞；這種瀰漫浸潤模式符合 CLL 的骨髓侵犯（預後較差的模式）。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow (near 100%) between bony trabeculae
Diffuse, sheet-like infiltrate of small dark lymphoid cells effacing the marrow
Near-complete loss of fat spaces
Scattered residual megakaryocytes and few red cell-rich areas
No discrete nodular or paratrabecular pattern identified at this power
62503.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy at low power shows a markedly hypercellular marrow, approaching 100% cellularity, with diffuse effacement of the intertrabecular spaces by a monotonous infiltrate of small dark lymphoid cells. Fat is nearly absent, and only scattered residual megakaryocytes are identified. No nodular or paratrabecular pattern is evident. Findings are consistent with diffuse bone marrow involvement by chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma; the diffuse pattern is associated with more advanced disease.

ddx.vs: MCL can show a similar diffuse or nodular marrow infiltrate, so cyclin D1/SOX11 and CD23 are required.
FL typically infiltrates the marrow in a paratrabecular pattern with CD10-positive centrocytes.
Acute leukemia also packs the marrow, but at higher power shows blasts with fine chromatin and CD34/TdT expression.

62439.recognize_zh: 高倍下一大團立體、細胞彼此重疊擠壓的小圓藍細胞團，核質比高、核互相擠壓變形（nuclear molding），細胞質少且邊緣毛躁；骨髓抹片中這種緊密三維腫瘤細胞團是轉移性小圓藍細胞瘤（本例為神經母細胞瘤）的線索。
features: Large, thick three-dimensional cohesive cluster of overlapping tumor cells
Small-to-intermediate cells with high N:C ratio and nuclear molding
Dark nuclei with fine chromatin; nucleoli not resolvable due to cluster thickness
Scant, frayed pale-blue cytoplasm with faint fibrillary material at the cluster periphery
Admixed granulated myeloid precursors at the edges; background grey-tinted red cells in a camera photograph
62439.describe_en: High-power view of a bone marrow aspirate smear (Wright-Giemsa) shows a large, thick, cohesive cluster of overlapping small-to-intermediate tumor cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, nuclear molding and scant frayed cytoplasm. Cellular detail in the centre of the cluster is limited by thickness and focus, and a few granulated myeloid precursors are admixed at the periphery. Tight three-dimensional clusters with molding are characteristic of metastatic non-hematopoietic tumors rather than leukemia. Findings are consistent with metastatic neuroblastoma involving the bone marrow.

ddx.vs: Blasts may pile up in thick areas but do not show nuclear molding or cohesive borders and are CD45/TdT or MPO-positive.
Rhabdomyosarcoma clusters show more cytoplasmic vacuolation and occasional multinucleated cells and are desmin/myogenin-positive.
Ewing sarcoma cells are CD99/NKX2.2-positive with EWSR1 fusion and lack neuropil.
Carcinoma clusters have more cytoplasm and keratin positivity, and medulloblastoma marrow spread is rare and clinically distinct.

62375.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散佈圖，在母細胞閘（blast gate）中 CD34 對 CD117 作圖，71.02% 母細胞同時表現 CD34 與 CD117，顯示為未成熟骨髓系母細胞族群。
features: Dot plot gated on blasts: CD34-PC7 (y-axis) versus CD117-APC (x-axis)
Dominant cluster in the upper-right quadrant: CD34+CD117+ 71.02%
Tight, relatively homogeneous population indicating a clonal immature myeloid blast population
