62375.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot gated on the blast region displays CD34 versus CD117. The majority of gated events (71.02%) co-express CD34 and CD117 as a cohesive cluster, with smaller CD117-only (11.25%) and double-negative (14.47%) fractions. This indicates an immature myeloid blast population. Lineage assignment and aberrancies require the remaining panel, and the specific genetic subtype (inv(3)/t(3;3)) cannot be inferred from this plot alone.

ddx.vs: MPAL requires MPO or monocytic markers plus lineage-defining T (cytoplasmic CD3) or B markers, which are not assessed in this CD34/CD117 plot.
Lymphoblasts are CD34+ but typically CD117-negative, whereas this population is predominantly CD117-positive.

62311.recognize_zh: 流式細胞圖中 CD19 陽性 B 細胞族群（藍色）CD20 高亮、CD5 陰性、CD38 陰性、lambda 輕鏈限制，並共同表現 CD25、CD103 與 CD11c（箭頭處），這組抗原組合是毛狀細胞白血病（HCL）的免疫表型。
features: Dominant CD19+ B-cell population (blue) gated in the lymphocyte region with bright CD45
Bright CD20 expression (arrowhead) compared with background cells
CD5-negative and CD38-negative B cells
Lambda light-chain restriction with absent kappa expression
Co-expression of CD25, CD103 and bright CD11c by the B-cell population (arrows)
Surface CD3-negative B cells separated from residual T cells (red)
62311.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of the lymphocyte gate shows a predominant clonal B-cell population that is CD19-positive, bright CD20-positive and CD45 bright. The B cells are negative for CD5 and CD38 and demonstrate lambda light-chain restriction. They co-express CD25, CD103 and bright CD11c, while residual T cells are separated by surface CD3 expression. This immunophenotype (CD11c+, CD25+, CD103+, bright CD20, lambda restricted) is diagnostic of a clonal B-cell population consistent with hairy cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: HCL-v is CD11c+ and often CD103+ but CD25-negative (and CD123/CD200 dim), unlike this CD25-positive population.
SMZL B cells are usually CD103-negative and CD25-negative or weak, with CD11c at most partial.
CLL is CD5+, CD23+ with dim CD20 and dim light chain, unlike the CD5-negative, bright CD20 population here.
MCL is CD5-positive and CD103/CD25-negative, with cyclin D1/SOX11 expression.

exam.answer_en: Hairy cell leukemia by flow — lambda-restricted CD19+ bright CD20+ B cells, CD5−/CD38−, co-expressing CD25, CD103 and bright CD11c
pearls_zh: 判讀步驟：先以 CD19 圈出 B 細胞，看 kappa/lambda 是否 restricted（本例 lambda）證明 clonal，再看 CD5、CD10 排除 CLL/MCL/FL，最後看 HCL 標記組合。
HCL 典型：CD11c 亮、CD25+、CD103+、CD123+、CD200 亮、CD5−、CD38 多為陰性；四標記（CD11c/CD25/CD103/CD123）評分越高越支持 classic HCL。
CD103 並非 HCL 專屬：enteropathy-associated T-cell lymphoma 與部分 SMZL/variant 型 B 細胞也可陽性，須看是否在 B 細胞上且合併其他標記。
流式也可用於治療後追蹤 minimal residual disease。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為 SMZL：SMZL 多為 CD25−/CD103−、CD11c 弱或陰性、CD200 較弱；若 CD25+ 但 CD103− 需再考慮其他 B 細胞淋巴瘤，不宜只憑單一標記。

quiz.q: 此流式中 B 細胞表現哪一種輕鏈？CD5 與 CD103 的結果分別為何？
quiz.a: Lambda restricted；CD5 陰性、CD103 陽性

62247.recognize_zh: CD20 染色時，胸腺小葉大部分淋巴球為陰性（藍色），只有左下方一團 B 細胞及少數散在細胞呈棕色膜陽性，說明此淋巴組織以 T 細胞為主、B 細胞僅佔少數。
features: Most lymphocytes within the thymic lobules are CD20-negative
Discrete aggregate of strongly membranous CD20-positive B cells at the lower-left edge of the lobule (medullary/perivascular B-cell zone)
Scattered CD20-positive B cells within the lobule and between thyroid follicles
No expanded or nodular B-cell follicles with germinal centers
Thyroid follicles negative; colloid shows faint nonspecific tan background
62247.describe_en: CD20 immunohistochemistry shows that the majority of lymphoid cells in the thymic lobules are negative, with a discrete cluster of CD20-positive B cells at one edge and scattered positive cells extending between the thyroid follicles. There is no nodular B-cell expansion. The distribution is the reciprocal of the CD3 stain and is consistent with the small normal thymic B-cell population. Findings are consistent with a cervical thymic remnant with intermixed ectopic thyroid tissue.

ddx.dx: Reactive lymph node or lymphocytic thyroiditis
ddx.vs: These show CD20-positive follicles with germinal centers as a major component, whereas here B cells are a minor, localized population within a T-cell-predominant lobule.
Thymic MALT lymphoma shows sheets of CD20-positive B cells with lymphoepithelial lesions and cystic change, not the sparse B cells seen here.

62183.recognize_zh: 小型成熟淋巴球（CLL 細胞）之間可見數顆明顯較大的淋巴樣細胞，細胞質中度嗜鹼性、染色質較開放並隱約有核仁，大小差異提示 CLL 中出現大細胞族群，需組織切片確認 Richter 轉化。
features: Several large lymphoid cells with moderate basophilic cytoplasm and round to oval nuclei
Large cells show more open chromatin with indistinct nucleoli and a rim of darker blue cytoplasm
Numerous small mature lymphocytes with dense clumped chromatin
Echinocytes (crenated red cells) in the background
No smudge cells or granulocytes prominent in this field
62183.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows small mature lymphocytes with dense clumped chromatin admixed with several large lymphoid cells. The large cells have moderate basophilic cytoplasm, round to oval nuclei with more open chromatin and indistinct nucleoli, and are roughly two to three times the size of the small lymphocytes. Red cells show crenation. In a patient with CLL, this dual population raises concern for large-cell (Richter) transformation, which requires tissue confirmation.

ddx.vs: Prolymphocytes are medium-sized with a single prominent central nucleolus and condensed chromatin, while transformed large cells are bigger with more abundant basophilic cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Leukemic phase of mantle cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: MCL cells are medium-sized with irregular nuclei and are cyclin D1/SOX11 positive with t(11;14), CD5+ but CD23−.
Monocytes have folded nuclei with lacy chromatin and grey-blue vacuolated cytoplasm with fine granules rather than round nuclei with basophilic cytoplasm.

62119.recognize_zh: 一顆大型異常前骨髓球（abnormal promyelocyte），細胞質內可見多根交錯成束的 Auer 桿（faggot cell），核呈不規則折疊、分葉狀，這組合強烈指向急性前骨髓性白血病（APL）。
features: Large cell with abundant pale cytoplasm and moderate N:C ratio
Multiple slender pink-purple Auer rods arranged in crisscrossing bundles (faggot cell)
Irregular, folded/lobulated nucleus with a notched contour
Finely granular to vacuolated-appearing cytoplasm; nucleolus not clearly resolved
Surrounding red cells in the background; image is high-magnification and slightly blurred
62119.describe_en: High-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows a large abnormal promyelocyte with abundant pale cytoplasm containing numerous needle-like Auer rods arranged in bundles. The nucleus is irregularly folded with a lobulated, notched outline and fairly condensed chromatin. The image is slightly out of focus, limiting assessment of nucleoli and fine granules. In the clinical setting of cytopenias and bleeding, findings are consistent with a faggot cell of acute promyelocytic leukemia; urgent confirmation of PML::RARA and coagulation work-up is indicated.

ddx.vs: Blasts usually carry single, long, tapered Auer rods and a salmon-colored paranuclear hof rather than multiple bundled Auer rods in bilobed promyelocytes.
Normal promyelocytes have round, eccentric nuclei with a Golgi hof and primary granules but never contain Auer rods.
The hypogranular variant shows bilobed nuclei with sparse visible granules and faggot cells are rare, whereas this cell shows abundant bundled Auer rods typical of hypergranular APL.

exam.answer_en: Acute promyelocytic leukemia — faggot cell: abnormal promyelocyte with bundles of Auer rods and folded bilobed nucleus
pearls_zh: 考法：指細胞質內交錯成束的粉紫色細桿問名稱（faggot cell, Auer rod bundles），並直接問遺傳異常：t(15;17)(q24.1;q21.2) PML::RARA。
急症：APL 常合併 DIC 與 hyperfibrinolysis，早期出血死亡率高；型態懷疑即應立刻開始 ATRA，不必等遺傳確認，並積極補充 cryoprecipitate／血小板。
表型：MPO 強陽性、CD34−、HLA-DR−、CD33 強陽性、CD117 可陽性；快速確認可用 PML 免疫螢光（微斑點型）或 FISH/RT-PCR。
治療：非高危險（WBC ≤10×10⁹/L）以 ATRA + arsenic trioxide 為標準；注意 differentiation syndrome 與 ATO 造成的 QTc 延長。
WHO 5th 對 APL with PML::RARA 不設 blast 門檻；ICC 2022 則要求 ≥10%。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 AML with maturation（t(8;21)）中的單根 Auer rod：t(8;21) 多為單根細長 Auer rod、核圓；faggot cell 為多根成束且核呈雙葉摺疊。

quiz.q: 圖中細胞質內多根交錯成束的桿狀物稱為什麼？這類細胞最典型的融合基因為何？

62055.recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結結構完全被瀰漫性浸潤取代，深藍小淋巴球間夾雜大量淡粉紅色的斑駁區域（組織球或大細胞），看不到明確結節，呈現 NLPHL 瀰漫型或類 THRLBCL 型態的線索。
features: Diffuse effacement of lymph node architecture without discernible nodules
Mottled appearance from numerous small pale eosinophilic foci interspersed among dark small lymphocytes
Pale foci likely represent histiocytes and/or scattered large cells; individual cytology not assessable
Scattered small vessels; no broad sclerosis or necrosis
No residual normal follicles or sinuses seen in this field
62055.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of lymph node shows diffuse effacement of the architecture by a lymphoid infiltrate with a mottled appearance, created by numerous pale eosinophilic foci distributed among dark small lymphocytes. No nodules, residual follicles, sinuses, sclerosis, or necrosis are evident in this field. The pale foci likely correspond to histiocytes and/or large cells, but cytologic detail is not assessable at this magnification. In the context of nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin lymphoma, this diffuse histiocyte-rich pattern resembles T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma; CD20, CD3, CD8, PD-1 and CD21 staining is needed to distinguish a diffuse variant pattern from transformation.

ddx.vs: THRLBCL is entirely diffuse with scattered large B cells among CD8+ T cells and histiocytes and lacks residual nodules or CD21+ meshworks anywhere in the node.
MCCHL has a mottled diffuse pattern too, but contains eosinophils, plasma cells and CD30+/CD15+ HRS cells.
The Lennert variant shows diffuse epithelioid histiocyte clusters among atypical small CD4+ T cells with clonal TCR rearrangement and no CD20+ large cells.
DLBCL shows confluent sheets of large cells, which would appear as a monotonous rather than mottled infiltrate.

61991.recognize_zh: 骨小樑下方的骨髓中可見鬆散的類上皮組織球聚集，夾雜大小不一的脂肪空泡（lipogranuloma）與一個多核巨細胞；右上方另有一個邊界圓、外圍帶淡嗜伊紅同心環的肉芽腫，符合外圈纖維環（fibrin ring）肉芽腫。
features: Bone trabecula at top with adjacent cellular marrow
Loose aggregates of epithelioid histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm interspersed with lipid vacuoles (lipogranulomas)
Multinucleated giant cell within the histiocytic aggregate
Well-circumscribed round granuloma at right with a concentric eosinophilic outer rim (fibrin ring)
Residual hematopoiesis with megakaryocytes and maturing precursors at the periphery
No caseous necrosis or atypical large lymphoid cells identified
61991.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a bony trabecula with adjacent cellular marrow containing loose aggregates of epithelioid histiocytes admixed with variably sized lipid vacuoles, consistent with lipogranulomas, including a multinucleated giant cell. At the right is a well-circumscribed granuloma with a concentric eosinophilic outer rim, consistent with a fibrin-ring granuloma. Residual trilineage hematopoiesis is present, and no caseous necrosis or atypical lymphoid infiltrate is identified. Findings are consistent with a granulomatous marrow reaction including lipogranulomas and fibrin-ring granuloma, compatible with an infectious etiology such as EBV in this clinical context; stains for organisms are recommended.

ddx.vs: These produce compact epithelioid granulomas, often with caseous necrosis, and organisms demonstrable by AFB or GMS stains and culture.
Sarcoid granulomas are tight, non-necrotizing, non-lipid-associated epithelioid granulomas without fibrin rings, diagnosed by exclusion with systemic findings.

ddx.dx: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma with granulomatous reaction
ddx.vs: Hodgkin involvement requires CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells, typically with fibrosis, which are not evident here.

61927.recognize_zh: 這是血紅素高效液相層析（HPLC）圖：主峰為2.48分鐘的HbA，3.68分鐘處標示A2的陰影峰相對明顯，搭配小的F峰（1.11分鐘），需對照數值報告確認HbA2升高才能支持β-地中海型貧血帶因者。
features: Cation-exchange HPLC chromatogram of hemoglobin fractions (x-axis retention time in minutes, y-axis percent signal)
Dominant off-scale HbA (A0) peak at 2.48 min
Shaded HbA2 peak at 3.68 min that is visibly prominent relative to baseline
Small shaded HbF peak at 1.11 min with minor early-eluting peaks at 1.22, 1.36 and 1.77 min (glycated/minor HbA fractions)
Additional small unlabeled late peak at 4.53 min whose identity cannot be assigned from the image alone
No large variant peak in the S, D or C windows is labeled; percentage values are not shown
61927.describe_en: Hemoglobin HPLC chromatogram shows a dominant HbA peak eluting at 2.48 minutes, a small HbF peak at 1.11 minutes, and a distinct HbA2 peak at 3.68 minutes. Minor early peaks represent glycated and other minor HbA fractions, and a small unlabeled peak at 4.53 minutes should be interpreted against the instrument's retention-time windows. The quantitative report is not included in the image, so HbA2 elevation cannot be confirmed numerically. In the appropriate context of microcytosis with a normal or near-normal hemoglobin, an increased HbA2 (typically about 3.5-7%) is consistent with beta-thalassemia trait.

ddx.vs: Alpha-thalassemia trait gives a normal or low HbA2 on HPLC and requires DNA testing, whereas beta-thalassemia trait shows increased HbA2.
Iron deficiency lowers HbA2 and can mask beta-thalassemia trait, so iron studies should be checked before interpreting a borderline HbA2.
HbE co-elutes in the A2 window on many HPLC systems, producing a much larger 'A2' peak (about 25-30%) than the 3.5-7% seen in beta-thalassemia trait.
These show a markedly increased HbF with normal or low HbA2, unlike the small F peak and prominent A2 peak here.

exam.answer_en: Consistent with beta-thalassemia trait — HPLC with distinct HbA2 peak, small HbF and no variant peak (HbA2 % not shown)
pearls_zh: 考法：要辨識各峰：F（約 1.1 分）、A0 主峰（約 2.5 分）、A2（約 3.7 分）；本圖未附百分比，需對照數值報告判定 HbA2 是否 >3.5%。
HbE 與 Hb Lepore 在 cation-exchange HPLC 與 HbA2 同窗溶出；A2 窗數值明顯過高時要懷疑 HbE。
缺鐵會降低 HbA2，可能遮蔽 β-thalassemia trait，判讀臨界值前應先查鐵。
帶因者常見 Hb 正常或輕度貧血、MCV/MCH 低而 RBC 數偏高；Mentzer index（MCV/RBC）<13 傾向 thalassemia。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易只憑「A2 峰看起來明顯」就下診斷；HPLC 必須看定量百分比，並注意缺鐵造成偽低、HbE 同窗溶出造成偽高。

quiz.q: 此 HPLC 圖中 3.68 分鐘的陰影峰代表哪一種血紅素？

61799.recognize_zh: 這是家族譜系圖（非形態圖）：先證者（箭頭，41 歲女性）罹患 CMML 並有疣與 M. kansasii 感染，姐姐 43 歲 MDS 轉 AML，兩人皆帶 GATA2 p.A286V；父親有血小板低下，堂表親有白血病，顯示體染色體顯性遺傳的骨髓腫瘤傾向。
features: Pedigree chart with proband (arrow): 41-year-old female with CMML, warts and Mycobacterium kansasii infection
Affected sister aged 43 with MDS progressing to AML; both sisters marked as GATA2 p.A286V carriers
Father with thrombocytopenia, deceased of colon cancer at 70; paternal-side male relative with leukemia
Offspring with urogenital anomalies (duplicated ureters, ureteral reflux) and warts in the proband's daughter
Pattern consistent with autosomal dominant inheritance across generations
61799.describe_en: The figure is a family pedigree rather than a morphologic image. The proband, a 41-year-old woman with CMML, warts and Mycobacterium kansasii infection, and her 43-year-old sister with MDS evolving to AML both carry the germline GATA2 p.A286V variant. The father had thrombocytopenia, another relative developed leukemia, and the next generation shows warts and urogenital anomalies (duplicated ureters, ureteral reflux). The combination of familial myeloid neoplasia, atypical mycobacterial and HPV infection and urogenital malformations is characteristic of GATA2 deficiency syndrome.

61735.recognize_zh: 低倍 CD20 染色可見棕色陽性 B 細胞呈斑塊狀、帶狀聚集，部分沿血管周圍分布，其餘大片區域為陰性；符合淋巴瘤樣肉芽腫中 B 細胞散在、圍繞血管的分布。
features: Low-power view with patchy, irregular aggregates of CD20-positive cells
Band-like CD20-positive cuffs around vascular structures
Large intervening areas largely CD20-negative
Individual cell morphology not assessable at this magnification
61735.describe_en: Low-power immunohistochemistry for CD20 shows a patchy distribution of CD20-positive B cells forming irregular aggregates and band-like perivascular collections, separated by broad areas with few positive cells. Cytologic detail and the size of the positive cells cannot be assessed at this magnification. The perivascular, patchy B-cell distribution is compatible with lymphomatoid granulomatosis when correlated with EBER in situ hybridization and the H&E findings.

ddx.vs: GPA shows necrotizing granulomas with neutrophilic microabscesses and vasculitis, and lacks clusters of large atypical CD20-positive, EBER-positive B cells.
DLBCL forms confluent sheets of CD20-positive large cells rather than patchy perivascular aggregates in a T-cell-rich background.
EBV-positive DLBCL usually forms sheets without the prominent angiocentric-angiodestructive pattern; distinction from grade 3 LYG relies on site and architecture.

61671.recognize_zh: 黏液胭脂紅（mucicarmine）染色下，細胞被黃褐色對比染色，視野上方與右側可見成群的小圓形菌體呈淡色、未被染成紅色，表示菌體沒有黏多醣莢膜，可用來排除隱球菌（Cryptococcus）。
features: Mucicarmine-stained section with yellow-brown counterstain throughout cells and stroma
Small clusters of tiny round, pale, refractile organisms without red capsular staining (upper centre and right)
No carmine-red capsular material around organisms anywhere in the field
Background densely packed hematopoietic and histiocytic cells with brown-stained nuclei and cytoplasm
Occasional yellow refractile bodies/pigment, likely non-specific
61671.describe_en: Mucicarmine-stained section shows cellular tissue with a yellow-brown counterstain. Small clusters of tiny, round, pale organisms are present, and none show carmine-red staining of a capsule. The negative mucicarmine reaction argues against Cryptococcus, whose polysaccharide capsule is mucicarmine positive. In context with GMS- and PAS-positive small yeasts, findings support Histoplasma capsulatum.

ddx.vs: Cryptococcal yeasts are larger (4-10 um) with a thick capsule that stains red with mucicarmine, whereas these organisms are unstained.
Blastomyces is larger (8-15 um) with a thick refractile wall and broad-based budding and may show weak mucicarmine cell-wall staining, unlike these tiny yeasts.
Rhinosporidium forms very large sporangia containing mucicarmine-positive endospores, which are far larger than the organisms here.

61607.recognize_zh: 大型腫瘤細胞核呈淡藍、細胞本身完全不染 PD-1，只有少數小型背景 T 細胞呈棕色膜狀陽性，可作為內部陽性對照；代表漿母細胞淋巴瘤腫瘤細胞 PD-1 陰性。
features: Sheet of medium-to-large tumor cells with round-to-oval vesicular nuclei
Tumor cells are negative for PD-1
Scattered small lymphocytes with membranous/granular PD-1 positivity (internal positive control)
Positive cells are sparse and not arranged in rosettes around tumor cells
Faint background cytoplasmic blush without specific staining
61607.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for PD-1 shows a diffuse population of medium-to-large tumor cells with vesicular nuclei that are negative for PD-1. Only scattered small reactive lymphocytes show membranous to granular PD-1 staining, serving as an internal positive control, and they do not form rosettes around the neoplastic cells. The neoplastic cells therefore do not express PD-1, which argues against a T-follicular helper phenotype and is consistent with the plasmablastic lymphoma immunoprofile.

ddx.dx: Nodal T-follicular helper cell lymphoma, angioimmunoblastic type
ddx.vs: Neoplastic cells are PD-1+/CD10+/CXCL13+ T cells with expanded FDC meshworks, whereas here PD-1 highlights only scattered background cells.
PD-1+ T cells form rosettes around scattered large B cells, a pattern not seen here.
Also PD-1-negative, so PD-1 does not help; separation relies on clinical, EBER and marrow findings.

61543.recognize_zh: 淋巴球門控的 CD8 對 CD4 散點圖：紅色為 CD4+ 輔助 T 細胞，綠色為 CD8+ 細胞毒性 T 細胞，藍色族群 CD4 與 CD8 皆陰性；搭配前圖 CD3 亮陽性、CD5 弱陰性，判讀為 γδ T 細胞。
features: Lymphocyte-gated dot plot of CD8-ECD (x-axis) versus CD4-APC750 (y-axis)
Red population: CD4 positive, CD8 negative (helper T cells)
Green population: CD8 positive, CD4 negative, with a tight bright cluster and a trailing dimmer CD8 smear
Blue population: CD4/CD8 double-negative (the CD3-bright, CD5-dim cells on the companion plot)
Purple population: largely double-negative with a small dim CD4/CD8 diagonal smear, corresponding to CD3-negative B/NK cells
61543.describe_en: Flow cytometry dot plot gated on lymphocytes displays CD8 versus CD4. Distinct CD4-positive (red) and CD8-positive (green) T-cell populations are present, the latter including a dimmer CD8 subset. A sizable blue population is negative for both CD4 and CD8; on the companion plot these cells are bright CD3-positive with dim to absent CD5. Purple events representing CD3-negative B and NK cells are mostly double-negative. The CD3+, CD5 dim, CD4−/CD8− phenotype of the blue population is most consistent with gamma-delta T cells, with confirmation by TCRγδ staining if a neoplastic process is suspected.

ddx.dx: Hepatosplenic or other gamma-delta T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Neoplastic gamma-delta cells form an expanded, uniform population with additional aberrancies (e.g. CD7 loss, CD56 gain) and clonal TCRG rearrangement, rather than a heterogeneous minor subset.
T-LGL is usually CD8+ with CD57/CD16 expression and aberrant CD5/CD7 dimming, whereas the blue cells lack CD8.

ddx.dx: Double-negative alpha-beta T cells in ALPS
ddx.vs: ALPS double-negative T cells are TCRαβ+ and elevated above ~2.5% of T cells, requiring TCRαβ/γδ staining to separate from gamma-delta cells.

61479.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片左側與下方可見成群、成片的大型異型漿細胞：細胞質豐富偏雙嗜性、核偏心、核仁明顯或染色質呈車輪狀，與右上方正常的紅血球系及顆粒球系前驅細胞混雜，符合多發性骨髓瘤的局部浸潤。
features: Clusters and small sheets of atypical plasma cells, most prominent in the left and lower portions of the core
Plasma cells medium-to-large with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm and eccentric round nuclei
Nuclei with vesicular or clock-face chromatin, some with distinct nucleoli and occasional binucleation
Residual normal hematopoiesis (erythroid precursors with dark round nuclei, granulocytes) interspersed, especially upper right
Bony trabecula at the bottom edge; scattered fat spaces
61479.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows cellular marrow in which clusters and small sheets of atypical plasma cells are interspersed among residual normal hematopoietic elements, most prominent in the left and lower portions of the section adjacent to a bony trabecula. The plasma cells are medium to large with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm, eccentric nuclei, variably vesicular chromatin and occasional prominent nucleoli or binucleation. Erythroid and granulocytic precursors remain in the intervening areas. Findings are consistent with involvement by plasma cell myeloma with a focal/interstitial pattern; CD138 and kappa/lambda staining are recommended to quantify and confirm clonality.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are small, mature, scattered singly or around vessels and polytypic, not forming clusters of atypical nucleolated cells.
Carcinoma forms cohesive glands or nests with desmoplasia and is keratin positive, whereas these discohesive eccentric-nucleus cells would be CD138+ and light-chain restricted.
Erythroid precursors have round central nuclei, deeply basophilic scant cytoplasm and form colonies, lacking the eccentric nuclei and amphophilic cytoplasm of plasma cells.

ddx.dx: Large B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytoid features
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells are CD20/PAX5 positive with less abundant cytoplasm; immunostains separate them from CD138+ CD20- myeloma cells.

exam.answer_en: Plasma cell myeloma involving marrow — interstitial clusters/small sheets of atypical plasma cells on H&E core
pearls_zh: 考法：H&E 核心切片中找偏心核、胞質豐富嗜雙色、核旁淡區的細胞團，問「浸潤的是什麼細胞、呈何種分佈」→ plasma cells，interstitial/focal 分佈。
骨髓侵犯型態：interstitial、nodular、diffuse（packed marrow）；結節或瀰漫型通常代表較高腫瘤負荷。
H&E 對漿細胞比例常低估，應加 CD138 定量並以 kappa/lambda 證明單株性。
必做細胞遺傳：FISH 應在 CD138 純化漿細胞上做；高風險異常包括 del(17p)、t(4;14)、t(14;16)、1q gain/amp。
有核仁明顯、binucleation 的 atypical plasma cells 支持腫瘤性，但仍需免疫表型確認。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 pronormoblast 群或 metastatic carcinoma；漿細胞有偏心核與核旁 hof、CD138+/keratin−，erythroid 前驅細胞核居中、胞質深嗜鹼且成群排列。

quiz.q: 此骨髓切片中在骨小樑旁成群的偏心核細胞是什麼？建議加做哪兩種染色？
quiz.a: Plasma cells（plasma cell myeloma）；CD138 與 kappa/lambda

61415.recognize_zh: H&E 200x 見中大型淋巴細胞緊密成片，核圓至卵圓、染色質空泡狀、可見小核仁，偶見核分裂，右下緣有小淋巴球作對照，符合大B細胞淋巴瘤；是否為 IRF4 重組需靠 MUM1 與 FISH 確認。
features: Densely packed sheet of medium to large lymphoid cells with little intervening stroma
Round to oval, sometimes indented nuclei with vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli
Moderate amount of pale cytoplasm with distinct cell borders in areas
Scattered mitoses and apoptotic bodies; rare histiocytes
Small mature lymphocytes at the periphery (lower right) for size comparison; thin fibrovascular septa
61415.describe_en: Section at medium power shows sheets of monotonous medium to large lymphoid cells with round to oval vesicular nuclei, small nucleoli and moderate pale cytoplasm, with scattered mitoses and apoptotic bodies. Small mature lymphocytes are present at the periphery for comparison, and thin fibrovascular septa traverse the infiltrate. No starry-sky pattern or Reed-Sternberg-like cells are evident. Morphology is that of a large B-cell lymphoma; in conjunction with strong MUM1 expression and IRF4 rearrangement, findings are consistent with large B-cell lymphoma with IRF4 rearrangement.

ddx.vs: Pediatric-type FL has expansile follicles with blastoid centroblasts but is MUM1-negative/weak and lacks IRF4 rearrangement.
Burkitt shows smaller monotonous cells with squared-off cytoplasm, a prominent starry-sky pattern and MYC rearrangement.
Morphologically similar; separation requires MUM1 immunostaining and IRF4 break-apart FISH.
Lymphoblasts have finer dusty chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and express TdT.

61351.recognize_zh: ZAP-70 免疫染色中，成片的小型 CLL 細胞呈較淡的棕色染色，而散在的反應性 T 細胞呈深棕色強陽性，兩者強度對比明顯；判讀時應以內部 T 細胞為對照來評估 CLL 細胞表現量。
features: Diffuse sheets of small, monotonous round lymphocytes
Majority of neoplastic cells with weak to moderate nuclear and cytoplasmic ZAP-70 staining
Scattered cells with strong dark brown ZAP-70 staining, consistent with admixed normal T cells (internal positive control)
Interspersed unstained cells with blue hematoxylin counterstain
No large cells or proliferation centers identifiable at this magnification
61351.describe_en: Section shows a diffuse infiltrate of small monotonous lymphocytes. ZAP-70 immunostain shows weaker staining in the neoplastic cells compared with scattered strongly positive background T cells, which serve as an internal positive control. Immunohistochemical ZAP-70 assessment is semiquantitative and poorly standardized; in a case otherwise established as chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma (CD5+, CD23+, LEF1+), dim ZAP-70 favors a mutated IGHV profile, which is better determined directly by IGHV sequencing.

ddx.vs: Also a small CD5+ B-cell lymphoma, but cells have irregular nuclei and are cyclin D1 and SOX11 positive, CD23 negative.
A T-cell-predominant population would show uniformly strong ZAP-70 with CD3 positivity, rather than a dim B-cell sheet with scattered bright cells.
Marginal zone cells are typically CD5 and LEF1 negative with monocytoid or plasmacytic features and marginal zone pattern.
Shows a follicular architecture with CD10+/BCL6+ centrocytes and centroblasts, not diffuse sheets of round small lymphocytes.

61287.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中央三顆大型母細胞聚在一起，核大而圓、染色質細緻，細胞質量中等至豐富、呈灰藍色且無明顯顆粒，符合單核母細胞（monoblast）的外觀；左下另有一顆退化變形的細胞。
features: Cluster of three large blasts, roughly 2-3 times the diameter of adjacent red cells
Round to slightly oval nuclei with finely dispersed, delicate chromatin; nucleoli are indistinct at this focus
Moderate to abundant gray-blue cytoplasm without visible granules or Auer rods
A distorted, degenerating/smudged cell at the lower left
Background of red cells with abundant stain precipitate; photographed through the eyepiece with limited sharpness
61287.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a small cluster of large circulating blasts in a background of red cells with prominent stain precipitate. The blasts have round to slightly oval nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and a moderate to abundant amount of agranular gray-blue cytoplasm; no Auer rods are identified. An additional degenerated cell is present at the lower left. Image resolution limits assessment of nucleoli and fine granules, and nonspecific esterase or flow cytometry is required to confirm monocytic lineage. Findings are consistent with circulating monoblasts in acute monoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts have scantier cytoplasm, may show Auer rods and azurophilic granules, and are MPO-strong/NSE-negative, whereas monoblasts have abundant gray-blue cytoplasm and are NSE-positive.
Promonocytes show folded or convoluted nuclei and fine lilac granules, while monoblasts in this field have round nuclei and agranular cytoplasm.
Megakaryoblasts often show cytoplasmic blebs and cluster formation but are CD41/CD61-positive and NSE/lysozyme-negative.
Mature monocytes have condensed, lobulated nuclei and vacuolated gray cytoplasm without fine blast chromatin.

exam.answer_en: Acute monoblastic leukemia — circulating large blasts with round nuclei, fine chromatin and abundant agranular gray-blue cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：周邊血中出現成群大型母細胞，考官問「依型態最可能哪一系？下一步如何證實？」答：monoblast；NSE 細胞化學與流式（CD14、CD64、CD11b、CD4）。
Monoblast 與 myeloblast 的型態區分：monoblast 細胞質較豐富灰藍、核圓可偏心、核仁明顯，通常 MPO 陰性或弱；myeloblast 細胞質少、可見顆粒或 Auer rod、MPO 陽性。
單核球性 AML 常見髓外侵犯（牙齦、皮膚、CNS）與高白血球；需注意 leukostasis 與 DIC。
遺傳：兒童常見 KMT2A 重排；成人單核球分化 AML 亦常見 NPM1 突變，需一併檢測 FLT3。
exam.pitfall_zh: 本圖為目鏡拍攝、解析度有限，易將 monoblast 誤判為 myeloblast 或 megakaryoblast；應以 NSE 陽性並被 NaF 抑制、CD14/CD64 表現證實單核球系，而非僅憑型態。

quiz.q: 周邊血中如圖的大型母細胞，若 NSE 染色陽性且被 sodium fluoride 抑制，代表何種分化？

61223.recognize_zh: EBER 原位雜交中，黏膜腺體間的固有層被大量淋巴樣細胞浸潤，這些細胞的核呈深藍紫色陽性訊號、瀰漫分布，而腺上皮為陰性，符合 EBV 陽性的結外 NK/T 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Intestinal mucosa with preserved but separated crypts/glands showing negative (pink counterstained) epithelium
Lamina propria and deeper mucosa diffusely infiltrated by lymphoid cells
Dark blue-purple nuclear EBER signal in a large proportion of infiltrating cells
Signal is nuclear and diffuse throughout the infiltrate rather than confined to rare scattered cells
Pale counterstain makes weakly positive versus negative nuclei somewhat difficult to separate at this magnification
61223.describe_en: EBER in situ hybridization on intestinal mucosa shows a dense lymphoid infiltrate expanding the lamina propria between the crypts. A large proportion of the infiltrating cells show nuclear EBER signal distributed diffusely throughout the infiltrate, whereas the glandular epithelium is negative. The pale counterstain limits precise quantification at this power. Diffuse EBER positivity in an atypical lymphoid infiltrate is consistent with extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, nasal type, in the appropriate immunophenotypic context (cytoplasmic CD3+, CD56+, cytotoxic markers+).

ddx.vs: Can be CD56 positive and cytotoxic but is EBER negative.
EBER-positive cells are large B cells expressing CD20/PAX5 rather than CD3/CD56 cytotoxic cells.

ddx.dx: Reactive EBV infection or bystander EBV-positive B cells
ddx.vs: Only scattered EBER-positive cells are present in a polymorphous background, rather than diffuse positivity of the neoplastic population.

exam.answer_en: Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma (intestinal involvement) — diffuse nuclear EBER positivity in the lymphoid infiltrate, epithelium negative
pearls_zh: 判讀方式：EBER ISH 陽性訊號位於細胞核（深藍紫色），看的是腫瘤細胞群是否「瀰漫」陽性；只有零星陽性細胞多為反應性或 bystander B cells，不足以支持 ENKTL。
表型：cytoplasmic CD3ε+、CD56+、cytotoxic markers（TIA-1、granzyme B、perforin）+，surface CD3 與 CD5 常陰性；EBER 陽性幾乎是診斷必要條件。
WHO 5th 名稱改為 extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma（去掉 nasal type）；形態常見 angiocentric、血管破壞與凝固性壞死，東亞較常見。
臨床：血漿 EBV DNA 量可用於分期、預後與追蹤；治療以含 L-asparaginase 的方案（如 SMILE、P-GemOx）合併放療，並注意合併 HLH。
exam.pitfall_zh: 腸道病灶最易與 MEITL 混淆：MEITL 也可 CD56+、具細胞毒性並侵入上皮，但 EBER 陰性；本圖瀰漫 EBER 陽性支持 ENKTL。另需與 EBV+ DLBCL（CD20/PAX5+）區分。

quiz.q: EBER ISH 陽性訊號位於細胞的哪個部位？腸道 CD56+ T/NK 淋巴瘤中，EBER 陰性應考慮哪個診斷？
quiz.a: 細胞核；monomorphic epitheliotropic intestinal T-cell lymphoma（MEITL）

61159.recognize_zh: A、B 圖骨髓芽細胞具豐富嗜鹼性細胞質，內有淡灰藍色的圓形包涵體與細長的類 Auer 小體結構（紅箭頭）及空泡；C 圖 MPO 染色中細胞質為棕色陽性但包涵體不染色；D 圖 RT-PCR 膠體顯示病人與陽性對照同位置條帶，對應 t(8;21) 融合轉錄物。
features: Panels A-B: blasts with large nuclei, fine chromatin and moderate basophilic cytoplasm containing pale grey-blue round inclusions and elongated Auer rod-like structures (red arrows)
Several blasts show cytoplasmic vacuoles and occasional perinuclear pale zones
Panel C: MPO cytochemistry shows granular brown positivity in blast cytoplasm, while the inclusions and rod-like structures remain unstained (arrows)
Panel D: agarose gel with 50 bp and 100 bp ladders; no band in negative control, band in positive control and an identically sized band in the patient sample
A cell with an abnormally clumped/lobulated nucleus is present among the blasts (panel B)
61159.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate shows blasts with fine chromatin and moderately abundant basophilic cytoplasm, many containing pale grey-blue round inclusions and elongated Auer rod-like structures, with scattered cytoplasmic vacuoles. Myeloperoxidase cytochemistry demonstrates granular positivity in the blast cytoplasm, but the inclusions and rod-like structures are MPO negative, unlike true Auer rods. RT-PCR shows a product in the patient sample comigrating with the positive control and absent in the negative control. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with RUNX1::RUNX1T1 containing unusual MPO-negative inclusions.

ddx.vs: Genuine Auer rods are fused primary granules and are strongly MPO positive, whereas these structures do not stain with MPO.
Pseudo-Chediak-Higashi granules are large azurophilic granules that are typically MPO positive, while these inclusions are pale and MPO negative.
APL shows heavily granular or bilobed promyelocytes with bundles of MPO-positive Auer rods (faggot cells) and PML::RARA rather than RUNX1::RUNX1T1.
Phagocytic inclusions are heterogeneous in shape and often within vacuoles, whereas these inclusions are uniform and occur across many leukemic blasts.

61095.recognize_zh: 大量中至大型芽細胞，細胞質深嗜鹼性且周邊有明顯的出芽狀突起（cytoplasmic blebs），核染色質細緻、可見核仁，背景有血小板團塊；在 Down 症兒童身上，這種巨核芽細胞（megakaryoblast）型態即指向 ML-DS。
features: Medium to large blasts with moderate N:C ratio and round to slightly irregular nuclei
Fine, dispersed chromatin with one or more visible nucleoli
Deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm with prominent cytoplasmic blebs and pseudopod-like budding
Occasional smaller dark blast/lymphoid-appearing cells admixed
Clumps of granular platelet/megakaryocytic material in the background
61095.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows numerous medium to large blasts with fine chromatin, visible nucleoli and deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm bearing conspicuous cytoplasmic blebs. Aggregates of platelet-like granular material are present in the background. Auer rods and cytoplasmic granulation are not seen. The morphology is that of megakaryoblasts; in a child with Down syndrome, findings are consistent with myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome (acute megakaryoblastic type), to be confirmed by flow cytometry (CD41/CD61) and GATA1 mutation analysis.

ddx.vs: TAM shows morphologically identical megakaryoblasts but occurs in neonates (usually <3 months) and often regresses spontaneously; age and clinical course, not morphology, separate them.
Morphology overlaps; separation relies on absence of trisomy 21/GATA1 mutation and presence of t(1;22).
Lymphoblasts have scant, less basophilic cytoplasm without blebs and are CD19/CD79a/TdT positive rather than CD41/CD61 positive.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor (e.g., neuroblastoma)
ddx.vs: Tumor cells form cohesive clusters/rosettes with molding and are negative for CD41/CD61 and CD45.

exam.answer_en: Myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome — megakaryoblasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and cytoplasmic blebs
pearls_zh: 考法：指有胞質出芽（blebs）、深藍胞質的芽細胞問系別 → megakaryoblast；追問 flow 標記：CD41、CD61（CD42b）。
分子：ML-DS 與 TAM 幾乎皆帶 GATA1 突變（產生截短的 GATA1s），合併 constitutional trisomy 21。
TAM 發生於新生兒、多可自行緩解，但部分會在幼兒期進展為 ML-DS；兩者形態無法區分，靠年齡與病程。
ML-DS 對 cytarabine 敏感，採減量強度化療預後良好，明顯優於非 Down 症的 AMKL。
巨核芽細胞白血病常伴骨髓纖維化，抽吸易 dry tap，需切片加 IHC（CD61、CD42b）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 B-lymphoblastic leukemia；megakaryoblast 胞質較深藍、有 blebs、背景有血小板團，flow 為 CD41/CD61 陽性而非 CD19/TdT。

quiz.q: Down 症幼兒骨髓中這些帶胞質出芽的芽細胞屬哪一系？必驗哪個基因突變？

61031.recognize_zh: 周邊血在大量小淋巴球中混有較大、胞質較多的母細胞樣細胞；FISH 顯示 MYC 斷裂分離訊號與 ATM/TP53 訊號缺失，骨髓切片被大細胞瀰漫取代，符合 CLL 克隆演化成 DLBCL 型 Richter 轉化。
features: Peripheral blood with marked lymphocytosis: many small mature lymphocytes plus larger blast-like cells with more cytoplasm
Larger cells with open chromatin and small nucleoli, distinct from prolymphocytes
FISH with MYC break-apart probe showing separated red and green signals (rearrangement)
FISH with ATM/TP53 enumeration probe showing reduced signal numbers in some nuclei (loss)
Bone marrow biopsy with diffuse sheets of lymphoid cells replacing marrow adjacent to bony trabecula
61031.describe_en: Composite figure. The peripheral blood film shows marked lymphocytosis composed of small mature lymphocytes admixed with a population of larger blast-like cells with more abundant basophilic cytoplasm. Interphase FISH shows split MYC signals indicating MYC rearrangement, and ATM/TP53 enumeration reveals signal loss in a subset of nuclei. The bone marrow biopsy is diffusely replaced by a lymphoid infiltrate. Together with the flow cytometric and clonality data, findings are consistent with clonally related Richter transformation of CLL to an aggressive large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Prolymphocytes have a single prominent central nucleolus and moderate cytoplasm, and lack the diffuse large-cell marrow replacement seen here.
Accelerated CLL shows expanded proliferation centers with Ki-67 >40% but not confluent sheets of large cells.

ddx.dx: Leukemic mantle cell lymphoma or high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC rearrangement
ddx.vs: Immunophenotype (CD23, cyclin D1/SOX11) and IGHV clonal relationship to the prior CLL separate these entities.

60967.recognize_zh: 周邊血血小板大量增加伴隨有核紅血球與未成熟顆粒球（A），骨髓抹片有顆粒球增生與巨母紅血球樣、核不規則的有核紅血球，插圖為核分離異常的發育不良巨核細胞（B），鐵染色見多顆環形鐵粒幼紅血球（C），切片為富含大型異型巨核細胞的高細胞量骨髓（D），符合 MDS/MPN-RS-T。
features: Panel A (PB): marked thrombocytosis with numerous platelets, a nucleated red cell and immature granulocyte (leukoerythroblastic picture)
Panel B (BM aspirate): granulocytic hyperplasia with abundant band and segmented neutrophils; erythroid precursors with megaloblastoid chromatin and irregular/budding nuclei
Panel B inset: dysplastic megakaryocyte with widely separated, small round nuclear lobes
Panel C (Perls stain): numerous ring sideroblasts with perinuclear blue iron granules
Panel D (H&E core): hypercellular marrow with increased, large atypical megakaryocytes with hyperlobated/bulbous nuclei, some loosely clustered
60967.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked thrombocytosis with a leukoerythroblastic picture. The hypercellular marrow aspirate displays granulocytic hyperplasia, megaloblastoid dyserythropoiesis with irregular nuclear contours, and dysplastic megakaryocytes with separated nuclear lobes, while the iron stain demonstrates abundant ring sideroblasts (40% by report). The core biopsy is hypercellular with increased large atypical megakaryocytes with hyperlobated nuclei that mimic a prefibrotic MPN pattern. In the setting of thrombocytosis ≥450 × 10^9/L, ≥15% ring sideroblasts and JAK2 V617F, the findings are consistent with myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm with ring sideroblasts and thrombocytosis (MDS/MPN with SF3B1 mutation and thrombocytosis in current WHO terminology).

ddx.vs: Shares hypercellularity, atypical megakaryocytes and JAK2 V617F, but lacks significant ring sideroblasts and erythroid dysplasia.
Features large mature staghorn megakaryocytes without granulocytic hyperplasia, dyserythropoiesis or ring sideroblasts.

ddx.dx: MDS with ring sideroblasts / SF3B1 (low blasts)
ddx.vs: Has ring sideroblasts but platelet count is below 450 × 10^9/L without MPN-type megakaryocytic proliferation.
Can show thrombocytosis but has small hypolobated (monolobated) megakaryocytes and del(5q) on karyotype, whereas cytogenetics here were normal.

exam.answer_en: MDS/MPN with ring sideroblasts and thrombocytosis (MDS/MPN with SF3B1 mutation and thrombocytosis) — ring sideroblasts plus large atypical megakaryocytes mimicking prefibrotic PMF
pearls_zh: 考法：四格圖中考官指 C 圖鐵染色核周藍色顆粒問名稱 → ring sideroblast；再指 D 圖大型異型巨核細胞，問為何容易誤診為 prefibrotic PMF。
Ring sideroblast 定義：鐵顆粒 ≥5 顆，環繞核周至少 1/3；以占紅血球前驅細胞百分比報告。
WHO 5th 名稱為 MDS/MPN with SF3B1 mutation and thrombocytosis：血小板 ≥450 ×10⁹/L，具 SF3B1 突變；若無 SF3B1，需 ring sideroblasts ≥15%。常同時帶 JAK2 V617F。
臨床兼具 MDS 的貧血與 MPN 的血小板增多與血栓風險；需排除 BCR::ABL1、del(5q)、t(3;3)/inv(3) 等可歸入其他分類的異常。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤診為 prefibrotic PMF 或 ET（同樣有大型異型巨核細胞、血小板增多與 JAK2）；關鍵在骨髓鐵染色找 ring sideroblasts、紅血球系發育不良與 SF3B1 突變。

quiz.q: C 圖鐵染色中環繞紅血球前驅細胞核的藍色顆粒細胞稱為什麼？合併血小板 ≥450 ×10⁹/L 時，應檢測哪個基因突變以支持 MDS/MPN-RS-T？

60903.recognize_zh: Diff-Quik 觸片中可見成團及散在的大型細胞，細胞質豐富淡藍、帶細小空泡，細胞核圓至腎形、部分可見核溝或摺痕，混有少數嗜酸性球（紅色顆粒）與紅血球；這些大型組織球樣細胞為淋巴結 LCH 的腫瘤性蘭格漢斯細胞。
features: Loose clusters and single large cells with abundant pale blue, finely vacuolated cytoplasm
Round, reniform or irregular nuclei, some folded or grooved, with fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Few eosinophils with orange-red granules and smaller lymphocytes admixed
Background of red blood cells, small vacuoles and stripped/crushed nuclear strands
60903.describe_en: Diff-Quik-stained touch imprint of the lymph node shows cellular clusters and dispersed large cells with abundant pale, finely vacuolated cytoplasm and round to reniform nuclei with occasional folds or grooves, fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. A few eosinophils and small lymphocytes are admixed in a background of red blood cells and crushed nuclear material. Air drying accentuates the size difference between the large neoplastic cells and the small lymphocytes. Findings are consistent with Langerhans cell histiocytosis in the appropriate histologic and immunophenotypic (CD1a/langerin positive) context.

ddx.vs: RDD histiocytes are larger with emperipolesis of intact lymphocytes and round nuclei with a nucleolus, lacking the grooved reniform nuclei.
Carcinoma cells form tight cohesive three-dimensional clusters with nuclear molding and prominent nucleoli, unlike these loosely aggregated grooved cells with eosinophils.
Sinus histiocytes have abundant foamy cytoplasm and bland oval nuclei without grooves and are CD1a negative.
ALCL cells are larger and more pleomorphic with horseshoe nuclei, basophilic cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli, and are CD30/ALK positive.

60839.recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結結構被多個淡粉紅色、界限清楚的結節狀肉芽腫取代，周圍有淋巴球帶與增厚纖維化的被膜，左上區域較淡染、疑似融合的壞死區，屬壞死性肉芽腫性淋巴結炎的低倍觀。
features: Low-power view with effacement of normal nodal architecture by multiple pale, rounded to confluent granulomatous nodules
Well-circumscribed epithelioid granulomas surrounded by a cuff of darker-staining lymphocytes
Larger pale eosinophilic areas suggestive of confluent granulomas with central necrosis (necrosis not resolvable in detail at this power)
Thickened fibrotic capsule and perinodal fibrosis on the right
No follicles with germinal centers clearly preserved
60839.describe_en: Low-power section of lymph node shows extensive replacement of the normal architecture by numerous pale, rounded and focally confluent granulomatous nodules rimmed by lymphocytes, with a thickened fibrotic capsule. Some larger pale zones appear to represent confluent granulomas with central necrosis, although cellular detail cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with granulomatous lymphadenitis, in keeping with the necrotizing pattern seen at higher power; special stains and microbiologic studies are recommended.

ddx.vs: Sarcoid granulomas are tight, uniform and non-necrotizing with minimal lymphocytic cuffing, whereas infectious granulomas are often confluent with central necrosis.

ddx.dx: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma with granulomatous reaction
ddx.vs: Hodgkin lymphoma shows fibrous bands with a mixed inflammatory background containing CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells, identified only at higher power and by IHC.
Toxoplasmosis shows small, non-necrotizing epithelioid histiocyte clusters encroaching on reactive germinal centers with monocytoid B-cell hyperplasia, not large necrotizing granulomas.

60775.recognize_zh: EBER 原位雜交在群聚的大型多形性腫瘤細胞核中出現深藍黑色訊號，周圍其他細胞只有粉紅色對比染色；在 HHV8 陽性淋巴瘤中，EBV 共感染是原發性積液淋巴瘤（含體腔外型）的常見特徵。
features: Dark blue-black nuclear EBER hybridization signal in clusters of large, pleomorphic tumor cells with abundant cytoplasm
Signal is strong but heterogeneous in intensity, with some cells showing coarse granular nuclear deposits
Many surrounding cells show only pink counterstain without detectable signal in this field
Retraction artifact around the positive cell clusters, suggesting cells lying within vascular or sinusoidal spaces
60775.describe_en: In situ hybridization for EBV-encoded small RNA (EBER) shows strong dark nuclear signal in clusters of large, pleomorphic tumor cells, some of which appear to lie within retracted vascular or sinusoidal spaces. The surrounding cells in this field show only counterstain without detectable signal, and positivity is heterogeneous in intensity. Given co-expression of HHV8/LANA in the same neoplastic cells, findings support EBV co-infection in an extracavitary primary effusion lymphoma.

ddx.dx: EBV-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS
ddx.vs: Tumor cells are EBER positive but HHV8/LANA negative and usually express CD20/PAX5.
Frequently EBER positive with a CD138+ plasmablastic phenotype, but HHV8/LANA is negative.

ddx.dx: HHV8-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS
ddx.vs: Is LANA positive but typically EBER negative and arises in the setting of multicentric Castleman disease with IgM lambda expression.
EBER-positive cells are scattered Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells in a mixed inflammatory background with CD30+/CD15+ and HHV8 negativity.

60583.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片可見細胞量逐漸增加、巨核細胞增生且成簇、形態不規則，網狀纖維染色（inset）顯示纖維明顯增加；周邊血可見有核紅血球與未成熟骨髓細胞（leukoerythroblastic picture），符合骨髓纖維化進展為骨髓增生性腫瘤。
features: Bone marrow biopsy with increasing cellularity across panels, from mildly hypercellular (A) to markedly hypercellular with reduced fat (B, C)
Megakaryocytic hyperplasia with enlarged, hyperlobated or hyperchromatic megakaryocytes forming loose clusters
Reticulin stain insets show a progressive increase in reticulin fibers, dense and intersecting in the later biopsy
Low-power inset of core shows a densely cellular marrow abutting bone trabecula
Peripheral blood smear with nucleated red blood cell, immature myeloid precursor and a basophil-like granulated cell (leukoerythroblastic features)
60583.describe_en: Sequential bone marrow core biopsies (H&E) show progression from a mildly hypercellular marrow with scattered megakaryocytes to a markedly hypercellular marrow with granulocytic and megakaryocytic proliferation, including atypical, clustered megakaryocytes. Reticulin stains (insets) demonstrate a progressive increase in reticulin fibrosis. The peripheral blood smear shows nucleated red cells and immature myeloid forms, a leukoerythroblastic picture. Findings are suggestive of progression from thrombopoietin receptor agonist (romiplostim)-associated marrow fibrosis to a myeloproliferative neoplasm; molecular testing (JAK2, CALR, MPL) and clinical correlation are needed.

ddx.vs: Drug-related fibrosis is usually low grade with normal cellularity and regresses on withdrawal, lacking the progressive hypercellularity, atypical megakaryocyte clusters and leukoerythroblastosis seen here.
Morphology is overlapping, so separation rests on the clinical history of TPO-agonist exposure and serial biopsies documenting evolution.
MDS with fibrosis shows small hypolobated dysplastic megakaryocytes and dysgranulopoiesis rather than large hyperlobated MPN-type megakaryocytes.
ITP marrow shows increased megakaryocytes without clustering, significant fibrosis, or leukoerythroblastic blood.

60647.recognize_zh: 組織切片中一顆巨大細胞，多個深染的核葉環狀排列、包圍中央淡粉紅細胞質，形成玫瑰花環（rosette）狀多核樣外觀，周圍為壞死碎屑與單核細胞；在急性骨髓單核球性白血病與複雜核型背景下屬怪異芽細胞型態。
features: Single giant cell with approximately six dark nuclear lobes arranged in a ring around a central pale eosinophilic cytoplasmic core (rosette/floret-like)
Nuclear lobes hyperchromatic with coarse chromatin; outer rim of abundant finely granular/vacuolated gray-lilac cytoplasm
Surrounding smaller mononuclear cells, some with folded nuclei and granular cytoplasm, admixed with red cells
Background of loose fibrinous/proteinaceous material and degenerating cells
Section thickness and degeneration limit fine nuclear detail
60647.describe_en: Section shows a loosely cellular infiltrate of mononuclear cells with folded nuclei in a background of fibrinous material and cellular debris. A conspicuous giant cell has multiple hyperchromatic nuclear lobes arranged circumferentially around a central core of pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, producing a rosette-like multinucleated appearance, with an outer rim of granular cytoplasm. This bizarre blast morphology has been described in AML with complex cytogenetic abnormalities and should not be mistaken for a megakaryocyte or metastatic tumor giant cell. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia (myelomonocytic) with rosette-like multinucleated blasts; immunohistochemistry (CD34, MPO, lysozyme, CD61) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have a single lobulated nucleus with connected lobes and abundant pink granular cytoplasm and are CD61/CD42b positive, unlike this myeloid/monocytic marker-positive blast.

ddx.dx: Floret-type multinucleated giant cells (e.g., pleomorphic lipoma, giant cell fibroblastoma)
ddx.vs: Floret cells occur in soft tissue tumors with stromal context, not in a leukemic infiltrate, and lack myeloid markers.
Osteoclasts have many separate, uniform, round nuclei scattered in cytoplasm next to bone, rather than lobes arranged in a ring.
Reed-Sternberg cells have large inclusion-like nucleoli and CD30/CD15 positivity, while hallmark cells are CD30+/ALK+ with horseshoe nuclei.

60711.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片被大量小型淋巴球與淋巴漿細胞樣細胞 (lymphoplasmacytoid cells) 佔據，其間散佈多顆顆粒深紫黑色、核被顆粒遮蔽的肥大細胞 (mast cells)，這是淋巴漿細胞淋巴瘤的典型伴隨表現。
features: Markedly hypercellular aspirate replaced by a monotonous population of small lymphoid cells
Small round nuclei with clumped chromatin; many cells with modest basophilic cytoplasm and eccentric nuclei (plasmacytoid)
Scattered mature plasma cells admixed
Numerous interspersed mast cells with dense dark purple metachromatic granules obscuring the nucleus
Mast cells round to oval, not spindle-shaped or clustered in dense aggregates
60711.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hypercellular and largely replaced by small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and occasional plasma cells. Scattered throughout are increased mast cells with dense, dark metachromatic granules that obscure the nucleus; they are round and well-granulated without atypical spindle morphology. Findings are consistent with involvement by a low-grade B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation, suggestive of lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma with the characteristic reactive mast cell increase; correlation with IgM paraprotein, flow cytometry and MYD88 L265P testing is recommended.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps; LPL favours IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P mutation (>90%), which is uncommon in marginal zone lymphoma.
CLL shows smudge cells and uniform round small lymphocytes without a plasmacytoid spectrum, and is CD5+/CD23+ by flow.

ddx.dx: Systemic mastocytosis with associated hematologic neoplasm
ddx.vs: Neoplastic mast cells in SM are spindled, hypogranular and form dense aggregates with KIT D816V, whereas these mast cells are round, well-granulated and scattered.

exam.answer_en: Lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma — marrow replaced by small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with increased reactive mast cells
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指散在、顆粒深紫遮蓋細胞核的細胞，問「這是什麼細胞？提示哪種淋巴瘤？」→ mast cell，LPL 的特徵性伴隨發現。
分子：MYD88 L265P 見於絕大多數 LPL/Waldenström macroglobulinemia，約三分之一帶 CXCR4 突變；MZL 較少有 MYD88 突變，可協助鑑別。
LPL 合併 IgM paraprotein 即為 Waldenström macroglobulinemia；需注意 hyperviscosity、cryoglobulin、冷凝集與周邊神經病變。
Flow：B 細胞 CD19+、CD20+，通常 CD5−、CD10−，並有單株 plasma cell 成分（CD138+、同一輕鏈）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為 systemic mastocytosis with associated hematologic neoplasm：LPL 中 mast cell 為圓形、顆粒飽滿、散在不成聚集，無 CD25/CD2 異常表現與 KIT D816V。

quiz.q: 圖中淋巴樣細胞間散在的深紫色顆粒細胞是什麼？此淋巴瘤最常見的突變為何？

60519.recognize_zh: 視野中央有一顆僅比周圍骨髓細胞稍大的細胞，單一圓形緻密核偏向一側、未分葉，外圍有淡藍帶顆粒的細胞質與不規則邊緣，N:C 比偏高，即微小巨核細胞（micromegakaryocyte）。
features: Small megakaryocyte only about twice the size of adjacent myelocytes
Single round, non-lobated, dense eccentric nucleus with high N:C ratio
Moderate grey-blue finely granular cytoplasm with slightly irregular, budding margin
Background myeloid precursors and neutrophils with granulated cytoplasm; several large promyelocyte-like cells
Small attached platelet/lymphocyte-sized bodies at the cell edge
60519.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle edge rich in maturing granulocytic precursors. Centrally there is a small megakaryocyte, only slightly larger than surrounding myelocytes, with a single round, non-lobated, dense nucleus, a relatively high N:C ratio and grey-blue finely granular cytoplasm with an irregular margin. Findings are consistent with a micromegakaryocyte (dwarf megakaryocyte), a dysplastic feature that supports a myelodysplastic or myeloproliferative/myelodysplastic neoplasm (e.g. MDS, CML) in the appropriate context.

ddx.vs: Plasma cells have clock-face chromatin, a perinuclear hof and deep blue non-granular cytoplasm, whereas micromegakaryocytes have granular cytoplasm with budding platelets and are CD61/CD42b positive.
Megakaryoblasts have fine open chromatin with nucleoli and agranular blebby cytoplasm, while this cell has dense mature chromatin and granular cytoplasm.
Osteoblasts are larger with eccentric nuclei, a pale Golgi zone away from the nucleus and occur in clusters, lacking platelet-type granules.
Normal immature megakaryocytes are larger with basophilic cytoplasm and begin lobulation, whereas micromegakaryocytes are lymphocyte- to promyelocyte-sized with mature granular cytoplasm.

exam.answer_en: Micromegakaryocyte (dwarf megakaryocyte) — small cell with single round non-lobated nucleus and granular cytoplasm, a dysplastic feature
pearls_zh: 考法：指著這顆比骨髓前驅細胞稍大的細胞問「是什麼」；關鍵是顆粒狀帶芽狀邊緣的細胞質（可見血小板出芽）與單一圓核，答 micromegakaryocyte。
臨床意義：微小巨核細胞是可靠的 dysplasia 指標，常見於 MDS、CML（dwarf megakaryocytes）及 AML with MECOM 重排；WHO 定義單一系列 dysplasia 需 ≥10% 細胞受影響。
切片不確定時可用 CD61 或 CD42b 免疫染色標出小型巨核細胞，在骨髓切片中比抹片更容易計數。
del(5q) 的特徵是體積正常至偏大的單葉/低分葉巨核細胞，與此體積極小的 micromegakaryocyte 需分開描述。
exam.pitfall_zh: 常被誤認為漿細胞（核偏心、有核周淡區，但細胞質均勻深藍無顆粒）或骨母細胞；本細胞細胞質灰藍帶細顆粒、邊緣有血小板出芽，支持巨核系。

quiz.q: 圖中央這顆單一圓核、細胞質帶顆粒且邊緣出芽的小細胞是什麼？常見於哪些疾病？

60455.recognize_zh: 中倍 cyclin D1 染色，大多數小淋巴樣細胞呈細胞核棕色陽性（強弱不一），左側殘存區域的小淋巴球則為陰性，形成清楚的陽性腫瘤區與陰性背景對比。
features: Majority of small lymphoid cells with nuclear cyclin D1 positivity of variable intensity
Staining is strictly nuclear with occasional strongly positive nuclei
Sharp demarcation from a negative zone of small lymphocytes at left (residual non-neoplastic tissue)
Negative scattered histiocytes and endothelial-lined spaces within the infiltrate
Small, round to irregular nuclei consistent with small-to-medium cell size
60455.describe_en: Cyclin D1 immunostain shows nuclear positivity of variable intensity in the majority of small-to-medium lymphoid cells forming the infiltrate. A zone of negative small lymphocytes at the left edge is sharply demarcated from the positive population, and scattered histiocytes are negative. Nuclear cyclin D1 expression in a small B-cell infiltrate is the key surrogate for t(11;14)(q13;q32). Findings are consistent with mantle cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: CLL/SLL is cyclin D1 negative apart from occasional weak staining in proliferation centers.
Myeloma cells are also cyclin D1 positive but have plasmacytoid morphology, express CD138, and lack CD20/CD5.
HCL can show weak cyclin D1 but has abundant cytoplasm (fried-egg), CD5 negativity, and annexin A1/CD25/CD103 positivity.

exam.answer_en: Mantle cell lymphoma — nuclear cyclin D1 positivity in the lymphoid infiltrate sharply demarcated from negative residual lymphocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：考官會問如何判讀 cyclin D1：必須是細胞核陽性；左側陰性的殘存小淋巴球與組織細胞為內部陰性對照，內皮細胞/組織細胞可弱陽。
必考遺傳：t(11;14)(q13;q32) CCND1::IGH 導致 cyclin D1 過度表現；cyclin D1 陰性 MCL 多有 CCND2 重排，SOX11 陽性可協助診斷。
預後因子：blastoid/pleomorphic 型態、Ki-67 >30%、TP53 突變/過度表現與 MIPI 分數；SOX11 陰性的 leukemic non-nodal MCL 通常較惰性。
Cyclin D1 強度可不一，判讀以核陽性為準；帶 t(11;14) 的漿細胞骨髓瘤也 cyclin D1+，且對 venetoclax 較敏感，但細胞為 CD138+ 漿細胞。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 CLL 增殖中心內的少量弱陽性細胞或內皮細胞染色誤判為 MCL；MCL 為成片腫瘤小淋巴細胞核陽性，並需 CD5+、CD23− 與 SOX11+ 支持。

quiz.q: 判讀 cyclin D1 時陽性應位於細胞哪個部位？圖左側陰性的小淋巴球在判讀上有何作用？
quiz.a: 細胞核；作為非腫瘤性內部陰性對照

60135.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞密度極高，視野中布滿胞質呈亮紅色顆粒的嗜酸性球及其前驅細胞，並夾雜數顆巨核細胞；嗜酸性球這樣大量取代骨髓時，要想到伴隨PDGFRA重排的骨髓／淋巴腫瘤。此視野中不易辨認紡錘狀肥大細胞聚集。
features: Hypercellular marrow with essentially no residual fat
Markedly increased eosinophils and eosinophil precursors with bright eosinophilic granular cytoplasm and round to bilobed nuclei
Several megakaryocytes scattered in the field, some with small clustered or hypolobated nuclei
Background of maturing myeloid cells and erythroid precursors with a somewhat loose, retracted appearance
Mast cell aggregates and spindle-shaped mast cells are not clearly identifiable in this H&E field
60135.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine section shows a hypercellular marrow, approaching 100% cellularity. There is a marked increase in eosinophils and eosinophil precursors, identified by their bright eosinophilic granular cytoplasm, admixed with other maturing myeloid elements and erythroid precursors. Megakaryocytes are present in normal to increased numbers, some with small or hypolobated nuclei. Discrete mast cell aggregates are not evident in this field, and tryptase/CD25 immunostains are recommended. In conjunction with PDGFRA rearrangement (e.g., FIP1L1::PDGFRA), the findings are consistent with a myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and PDGFRA rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Reactive eosinophilia (parasitic, allergic, drug, T-cell lymphoma)
ddx.vs: Reactive eosinophilia lacks spindled mast cell infiltrates and clonal genetic abnormalities, and an underlying cause or aberrant T-cell population is usually found.
SM forms dense compact mast cell aggregates of ≥15 cells with KIT D816V, whereas PDGFRA neoplasms have loose spindled mast cell infiltrates and are KIT D816V-negative but FIP1L1::PDGFRA-positive.
CEL-NOS shows similar eosinophilia but lacks PDGFRA, PDGFRB, FGFR1, JAK2 or FLT3 rearrangements, often with increased blasts or dysplasia.
CML can have eosinophilia but shows granulocytic predominance with basophilia, dwarf megakaryocytes and BCR::ABL1.

60071.recognize_zh: 抹片中大多數有核細胞是紅血球系前驅細胞：可見大型深藍細胞質的原紅血球、嗜鹼性與多染性正母紅血球，以及核濃縮的正染性母紅血球，粒細胞相對很少；這是明顯的紅血球系增生（erythroid hyperplasia），需以鐵染色找環狀鐵粒母細胞確認鐵粒母細胞性貧血。
features: Marked erythroid hyperplasia with erythroid precursors outnumbering granulocytic cells
Full spectrum of erythroid maturation: proerythroblasts/basophilic normoblasts with deep blue cytoplasm to polychromatic and orthochromatic normoblasts with pyknotic nuclei
Some later normoblasts show scant, poorly hemoglobinized gray-blue cytoplasm with irregular borders
Occasional binucleated erythroid precursor; scattered band/segmented neutrophils and one eosinophil
No increase in myeloblasts; ring sideroblasts cannot be assessed on Wright-Giemsa
60071.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen with marked erythroid hyperplasia and a reduced myeloid-to-erythroid ratio. Erythroid precursors span all stages of maturation, from proerythroblasts and basophilic normoblasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm to polychromatic and orthochromatic normoblasts, several of which have scant, poorly hemoglobinized cytoplasm with ragged borders; an occasional binucleated form is present. Granulocytic precursors are relatively sparse but mature, with scattered neutrophils and an eosinophil, and blasts are not increased. Findings are consistent with ineffective erythropoiesis; in conjunction with a Prussian blue stain demonstrating ring sideroblasts, this supports congenital sideroblastic anemia.

ddx.vs: Erythroid precursors show nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony with open sieve-like chromatin in hemoglobinized cells and giant metamyelocytes, not seen here.
Occurs in older adults with dysplasia in multiple lineages and SF3B1 mutation, whereas congenital forms (ALAS2, SLC25A38) present in youth with microcytosis and a family history.

ddx.dx: Hemolytic anemia with compensatory erythroid hyperplasia
ddx.vs: Precursors mature normally with good hemoglobinization, peripheral reticulocytosis is high, and iron stain lacks ring sideroblasts.
Shows >=80% erythroid precursors with >=30% proerythroblasts that are large and atypical, often with TP53 mutation, rather than orderly maturation.

12647.recognize_zh: 左圖 Wright 染色見大量紅血球含成簇、細小不規則的紫色顆粒（Pappenheimer bodies），並有標靶細胞、棘狀與不規則紅血球；右圖普魯士藍（Perls）鐵染色顯示同樣顆粒呈藍色（siderocytes），證實為含鐵顆粒，脾切除使其大量出現在周邊血。
features: Wright stain: many red cells with small clusters of irregular basophilic granules, often at the cell periphery (Pappenheimer bodies)
Target cells, acanthocyte-like and irregularly shaped red cells
Occasional red cell with a single round dense inclusion suggestive of a Howell-Jolly body
Prussian blue stain: dark blue siderotic granules within numerous red cells (siderocytes)
Frequency of inclusions is much higher than expected with an intact spleen
12647.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (Wright stain) shows numerous erythrocytes containing clusters of small irregular basophilic granules, along with target cells, acanthocyte-like forms and irregular poikilocytes. A Prussian blue stain on the same specimen shows these inclusions as dark blue iron-positive granules, confirming siderocytes. In a splenectomized patient with alcohol abuse, findings are consistent with numerous Pappenheimer bodies due to asplenia together with alcohol-related disturbance of iron utilization; bone marrow examination for ring sideroblasts may be considered.

ddx.vs: Stippling is diffuse throughout the cell and is Prussian blue negative, whereas these granules stain blue with iron stain.
Howell-Jolly bodies are single round DNA remnants that remain unstained with Prussian blue.
Heinz bodies are invisible on Wright stain and require supravital crystal violet or brilliant cresyl blue staining.
Parasites show ring forms with cytoplasm and chromatin dots rather than clustered iron granules, and are iron negative.

exam.answer_en: Pappenheimer bodies (siderocytes) after splenectomy — clustered basophilic granules on Wright stain confirmed iron-positive on Prussian blue
pearls_zh: 考法：左右對照圖，問「右圖是什麼染色？證明了什麼？」→ Prussian blue（Perls），證明顆粒含鐵，紅血球稱為 siderocyte。
名詞：Wright 染色可見者叫 Pappenheimer bodies；鐵染色陽性的紅血球叫 siderocyte；有核紅血球含鐵顆粒叫 sideroblast。
原因：脾切除或脾功能低下、sideroblastic anemia（含酒精、鉛、MDS-RS）、hemoglobinopathy。
脾切除病人有 overwhelming post-splenectomy infection 風險，需完成 encapsulated organism 疫苗接種並衛教發燒即就醫。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 basophilic stippling 或 Howell-Jolly body 混淆；三者中只有 Pappenheimer bodies 為 Prussian blue 陽性，本圖右側鐵染色即為判別依據。

quiz.q: 右圖為哪種染色？呈藍色顆粒的紅血球稱為什麼？

23143.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中可見成群的大型異常細胞，細胞質豐富偏藍、核偏位，旁邊有吞入血球的巨噬細胞；右側核型圖顯示多條結構異常與標記染色體（marker chromosomes），提示非造血腫瘤轉移合併噬血現象。
features: Large atypical non-hematopoietic cells, several times the size of neighboring myeloid cells, in loose clusters
Abundant pale to deep-blue cytoplasm with eccentric round to oval nuclei and visible nucleoli
Large macrophage-like cells containing phagocytosed nucleated cells and erythrocytes (hemophagocytosis)
Background of residual maturing granulocytes, small lymphocytes and erythrocytes
Panel B: G-banded karyotype with multiple structural rearrangements (add, der) and marker chromosomes, i.e., a complex karyotype
23143.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows clusters of large atypical cells with abundant basophilic cytoplasm, eccentric nuclei and conspicuous nucleoli that are foreign to normal hematopoiesis. Scattered histiocytes contain engulfed nucleated hematopoietic cells and erythrocytes, consistent with hemophagocytosis. Residual granulocytic and lymphoid elements are present in the background. The accompanying marrow karyotype is complex, with multiple structural abnormalities and marker chromosomes. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma (adenocarcinoma) involving the marrow with secondary hemophagocytosis; confirmation requires cytokeratin and site-specific immunohistochemistry on the core biopsy.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with complex karyotype
ddx.vs: AML blasts are discohesive with high N:C ratio and fine chromatin and express CD34/MPO, whereas these tumor cells are large, cohesive-looking and cytokeratin-positive on immunohistochemistry.
Myeloma cells show a perinuclear hof and clock-face chromatin and are CD138-positive and cytokeratin-negative.
Primary or infection-associated HLH shows hemophagocytosis without a population of cohesive foreign tumor cells.
Melanoma may show melanin pigment and is S100/SOX10/HMB45-positive and cytokeratin-negative.

23015.recognize_zh: 六張高倍圖中的異常早幼粒細胞（promyelocytes）細胞質內充滿粗大、大小不一的深紫紅色顆粒，部分融合成大型包涵體，類似 Chediak-Higashi 顆粒（pseudo-Chediak-Higashi granules）；核為卵圓至凹折形，配合 DIC 臨床，指向 APL。
features: Large cells with oval to indented or bilobed (panel E) nuclei and moderately fine chromatin
Abundant cytoplasm packed with coarse azurophilic granules of varying size
Giant, round, dark purple-red cytoplasmic inclusions resembling Chediak-Higashi granules (panels B, D, E)
Some cells with a clear perinuclear zone and grey-blue cytoplasmic periphery
Auer rods are not clearly seen in these panels
23015.describe_en: High-power views of peripheral blood show abnormal promyelocytes with oval, indented or bilobed nuclei and abundant cytoplasm containing dense azurophilic granulation. Many cells contain large, round, coarse purple-red granules and inclusions resembling those of Chediak-Higashi syndrome (pseudo-Chediak-Higashi granules). Auer rod bundles are not evident in the panels shown. In the setting of disseminated intravascular coagulation, findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia with pseudo-Chediak-Higashi granules; urgent PML::RARA confirmation by FISH or RT-PCR is required.

ddx.vs: Inherited Chediak-Higashi syndrome shows giant granules in otherwise normally maturing neutrophils and lymphocytes in a child with albinism, not in a population of leukemic promyelocytes.

ddx.dx: AML with maturation (non-APL) with pseudo-Chediak-Higashi granules
ddx.vs: These AMLs have blasts with less abundant granulation and lack PML::RARA, so genetic testing is the discriminator.
G-CSF effect shows orderly maturation with a Golgi hof and normal nuclear shape, and coagulation studies and PML::RARA are negative.
Toxic granules are fine and uniform in mature neutrophils rather than giant inclusions in immature cells.

22439.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有一團彼此緊密鑲嵌（nuclear molding）的大型細胞，核淡染、染色質細緻、細胞質稀少，與周圍大量染色質塊狀的小型 CLL 淋巴球明顯不同；插圖 cytokeratin 陽性，證實是轉移癌（Merkel cell carcinoma）而非 Richter 轉化。
features: Cohesive cluster of large cells with nuclear molding and poorly defined cell borders
Pale, finely granular (salt-and-pepper) chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli and scant cytoplasm
Interspersed dark, crushed/degenerating nuclei within the cluster
Background of numerous small mature lymphocytes with clumped chromatin (CLL)
Inset: cytokeratin immunostain positive in a nest of tumor cells, negative in surrounding lymphoid cells
22439.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a background of numerous small mature lymphocytes with condensed chromatin, consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia. A cohesive cluster of larger cells with nuclear molding, pale finely granular chromatin and scant cytoplasm is present, with interspersed crushed nuclei. The inset immunostain shows a cytokeratin-positive nest of tumor cells separate from the lymphoid infiltrate. Findings are consistent with metastatic neuroendocrine carcinoma (Merkel cell carcinoma) involving a marrow with CLL, mimicking Richter transformation; CK20 (dot-like), neuroendocrine markers and Merkel cell polyomavirus staining support the diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Large lymphoma cells are discohesive, lack nuclear molding and are CD20-positive and cytokeratin-negative.
Small cell carcinoma looks the same but is typically TTF-1-positive and CK20-negative, whereas Merkel cell carcinoma is CK20-positive with a dot-like pattern and TTF-1-negative.
Prolymphocytes are single, discohesive cells with a central prominent nucleolus and B-cell immunophenotype.

ddx.dx: Neuroblastoma or other small round blue cell tumor
ddx.vs: Neuroblastoma occurs in children, forms rosettes with neuropil and is cytokeratin-negative.

21543.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 H&E（A）細胞量高、巨核細胞增多並有群聚，間質呈流水狀纖維化；網狀纖維染色（B）顯示瀰漫性增加、交錯的網狀纖維，在長期使用 romiplostim 的 ITP 病人，符合藥物相關骨髓纖維化。
features: Hypercellular marrow with increased megakaryocytes, including loose clusters
Megakaryocytes of variable size, some with hyperlobated or hyperchromatic nuclei
Streaming, spindled stromal background suggesting fibrosis
Reticulin stain: diffuse increase in intersecting reticulin fibers throughout the cellular areas
No obvious collagenous osteosclerosis or blast clusters at this magnification
21543.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy is hypercellular with a marked increase in megakaryocytes, which form loose clusters and show variable size with some hyperlobated nuclei, set in a streaming stromal background. The reticulin stain shows a diffuse, dense network of intersecting reticulin fibers. No increase in blasts or osteosclerosis is evident at this magnification. In a patient with chronic ITP treated with a thrombopoietin receptor agonist, findings are consistent with romiplostim-associated reticulin fibrosis, which is usually reversible on drug discontinuation.

ddx.vs: PMF shows dense clusters of bizarre cloud-like megakaryocytes, often osteosclerosis, leukoerythroblastosis and a JAK2, CALR or MPL driver mutation.
ET has large hyperlobulated staghorn megakaryocytes with normal cellularity and no more than grade 1 reticulin, with thrombocytosis rather than ITP.
MDS with fibrosis has small hypolobated dysplastic megakaryocytes, cytopenias and increased blasts or clonal cytogenetics.
ITP marrow shows increased megakaryocytes but no significant reticulin increase.

20519.recognize_zh: 血液抹片中散在中至大型異常淋巴樣細胞（箭頭），核圓至不規則、染色質細緻、細胞質中等量淡藍且大多無明顯嗜天青顆粒；插圖 D 免疫染色見陽性細胞呈竇狀分布，配合年輕男性長期發燒，符合肝脾 T 細胞淋巴瘤周邊血液侵犯。
features: Medium to large atypical lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei (arrows)
Moderately condensed to fine chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Moderate pale blue cytoplasm, mostly without prominent azurophilic granules
Arrowheads mark smaller background nucleated cells for comparison
Panel D: immunostain with membranous positivity in cells distributed along sinusoidal spaces
20519.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear contains scattered medium-to-large atypical lymphoid cells with round to irregular nuclei, relatively fine chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and moderate pale basophilic cytoplasm largely lacking azurophilic granules. These cells are distinct from the smaller background nucleated cells marked for comparison. The accompanying tissue immunostain shows positive cells arranged in a sinusoidal pattern. In a young man with prolonged fever, findings are consistent with peripheral blood involvement by hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma; flow cytometry for TCR gamma-delta, CD3+/CD4-/CD8-/CD56+ phenotype and isochromosome 7q should be pursued.

ddx.vs: T-LGL cells are small with abundant cytoplasm containing coarse azurophilic granules and usually express TCR alpha-beta with CD8/CD57.
Aggressive NK-cell leukemia cells often contain azurophilic granules, lack surface CD3 and are EBV (EBER)-positive.
T-PLL cells have a prominent nucleolus and cytoplasmic blebs, are usually CD4-positive and carry TCL1A rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Reactive atypical lymphocytes (EBV or CMV infection)
ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes are polymorphous with abundant cytoplasm hugging red cells and have a polyclonal T-cell receptor.

20519.stain: Wright-Giemsa; IHC (panel D, marker not specified)

20455.recognize_zh: H&E 切片中可見寬大、帶狀、壁薄且幾乎無分隔的淡染菌絲，呈不規則分枝並散布於壞死組織內，加上上排門牙牙齦的壞死潰瘍照片（inset），符合侵襲性毛黴菌病（mucormycosis）。
features: Broad, ribbon-like, thin-walled pale eosinophilic hyphae with few or no septa
Irregular, non-parallel branching and folded/twisted hyphal profiles
Hyphae infiltrating necrotic stroma with scattered inflammatory cells and nuclear debris
Adjacent strands of residual epithelium/tissue at the edges of the field
Clinical inset: necrotic ulceration of the upper gingiva adjacent to the incisors
20455.describe_en: Section of oral (gingival) tissue stained with H&E shows necrotic stroma permeated by numerous broad, ribbon-like, thin-walled hyphae that are pauci-septate and branch irregularly, with a scattered mixed inflammatory infiltrate and karyorrhectic debris. No narrow, regularly septate, acute-angle branching hyphae are identified. The clinical inset shows a necrotic ulcer of the upper gingiva. Findings are consistent with invasive mucormycosis in an immunocompromised post-transplant patient; fungal culture or molecular identification is recommended for speciation.

ddx.vs: Aspergillus hyphae are narrow, uniform, and regularly septate with parallel walls and dichotomous acute-angle branching, unlike the broad, pauci-septate ribbons seen here.
Fusarium hyphae resemble Aspergillus (narrow, septate) and may show adventitial sporulation, and are distinguished by culture or PCR.
Candida shows budding yeasts with pseudohyphae showing constrictions rather than broad ribbon-like hyphae.

exam.answer_en: Invasive mucormycosis — broad, ribbon-like, pauci-septate hyphae with irregular branching in necrotic gingival tissue
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指寬大、少分隔、不規則分枝的菌絲，問「是 Mucorales 還是 Aspergillus、治療怎麼選」；答案 Mucorales，首選 liposomal amphotericin B 加外科清創。
鑑別：Mucorales 菌絲寬、帶狀、幾乎無分隔、近直角分枝；Aspergillus 菌絲窄、規則分隔、約 45° 二分叉分枝。
Voriconazole 對 Mucorales 無效；在 voriconazole 預防下出現的突破性黴菌感染要想到 mucormycosis。後續可改 isavuconazole 或 posaconazole。
危險因子：長期嗜中性球低下、HSCT/GVHD 使用類固醇、糖尿病酮酸中毒、鐵過載；血管侵犯導致組織梗塞壞死。Galactomannan 對 Mucorales 無診斷價值。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最易誤認為 invasive aspergillosis；靠菌絲寬度、分隔稀少與分枝角度區分，並以培養或分子方法確認，因兩者治療藥物選擇不同。

quiz.q: 圖中寬大、幾乎無分隔的帶狀菌絲最可能是哪類真菌？為何不可使用 voriconazole 治療？
quiz.a: Mucorales（mucormycosis）；voriconazole 對 Mucorales 無活性，應用 liposomal amphotericin B 並手術清創。

19431.recognize_zh: 這張合併圖呈現 NK/T 細胞淋巴瘤的不同臨床型態：硬顎壞死性潰瘍並穿孔（A）、肢體皮膚潰瘍性結節與 PET/CT 鼻腔高攝取（B），以及血液/骨髓抹片中帶嗜天青顆粒的非典型大型淋巴球（C）。中線破壞性壞死病灶是辨認鼻型的關鍵。
features: Panel A: necrotic ulcer of the hard palate progressing to a midline palatal perforation
Panel B left: multiple violaceous ulcerated nodules on an extremity (cutaneous involvement)
Panel B right: PET/CT with FDG-avid soft tissue in the nasal cavity
Panel C left: peripheral blood with atypical medium-to-large lymphoid cells with moderate basophilic cytoplasm and azurophilic granules
Panel C right: aspirate smear with clusters of atypical lymphoid cells (arrow), in keeping with leukemic/disseminated disease
19431.describe_en: This composite illustrates the clinical spectrum of extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma. Clinical photographs show a necrotic hard palate ulcer with midline perforation and ulcerated violaceous cutaneous nodules on an extremity, and PET/CT demonstrates FDG-avid disease in the nasal cavity. Smears show atypical medium-to-large lymphoid cells with basophilic cytoplasm and azurophilic granules in blood and aspirate, representing leukemic or disseminated disease such as aggressive NK-cell leukemia. The morphologic panels are low resolution and cannot establish lineage; diagnosis requires tissue showing angiocentric necrosis with cytoplasmic CD3, CD56, cytotoxic markers, and EBER positivity. Findings are consistent with nasal, extranasal (cutaneous), and disseminated/leukemic forms of NK/T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: GPA also causes destructive midline sinonasal necrosis but shows necrotizing granulomatous vasculitis with PR3-ANCA and lacks EBER-positive atypical cytotoxic lymphoid cells.
Angioinvasive fungi produce black necrotic palatal eschars with broad hyphae on biopsy rather than an atypical CD56/EBER-positive lymphoid infiltrate.
It can produce similar ulcerated skin nodules but is TCR gamma-delta positive and EBER negative.
Aggressive NK-cell leukemia presents primarily with circulating granular NK cells, marrow involvement, and fulminant course without a dominant nasal mass, though it overlaps with disseminated ENKTL.

12967.recognize_zh: 左圖周邊血中的單核細胞核圓、染色質粗塊、胞質少且深藍，外觀像小淋巴球，背景有棘狀紅血球（echinocytes）；右圖骨髓則是成片核偏位、有核周淡染區（perinuclear hof）的漿細胞，提示這些「淋巴球」其實是循環漿細胞（plasma cell leukemia）。
features: PB: small to medium mononuclear cells with round nuclei, coarse clumped chromatin, and scant deeply basophilic cytoplasm resembling mature lymphocytes
PB: numerous echinocytes (crenated red cells) and a disrupted smudged cell
BM aspirate: sheets of plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei and clock-face chromatin
BM: moderately abundant basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear hof in many cells
BM: near-complete replacement of normal hematopoiesis by plasma cells
12967.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a leukocytosis composed largely of small to medium mononuclear cells with round nuclei, coarsely clumped chromatin, and a thin rim of basophilic cytoplasm, closely mimicking mature lymphocytes; echinocytes and a smudged cell are also present. Bone marrow aspirate shows sheets of plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, clock-face chromatin, and perinuclear hofs, replacing normal hematopoietic elements. Because circulating cells lack an obvious hof, flow cytometry (CD45 negative, CD38/CD138 positive, kappa restricted) is required to establish their plasma cell lineage. Findings are consistent with plasma cell leukemia mimicking chronic lymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: CLL cells are CD5/CD23/CD19/CD20 positive with dim surface light chain and smudge cells, whereas these cells are CD45 negative, CD38/CD138 positive, with sheets of plasma cells in the marrow.
LPL shows a mixture of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes, and plasma cells with CD19/CD20 bright B cells and MYD88 L265P, rather than a monotonous CD45-negative plasma cell population.
Reactive plasma cells in sepsis are polytypic and rarely exceed a few percent in blood, unlike this monoclonal kappa-restricted population.

15143.recognize_zh: A 圖梭形細胞增生夾雜紅血球裂隙，LANA 免疫染色核呈點狀陽性，為卡波西肉瘤（Kaposi sarcoma）；B 圖體液細胞抹片中大型細胞核偏心、核仁明顯、細胞質豐富深藍，為原發性滲出性淋巴瘤（PEL）；C 圖淋巴濾泡外套區散布 LANA 陽性漿母細胞，為 HHV8 相關多中心 Castleman 病。
features: A (upper): fascicles of spindle cells with slit-like vascular spaces containing extravasated red cells
A (lower): nuclear LANA-1 (HHV8) immunostaining in many spindle cell nuclei
B: cluster of large pleomorphic cells with round to irregular nuclei, prominent nucleoli, abundant basophilic cytoplasm and occasional perinuclear clearing
C: follicle with numerous LANA-1-positive nuclei concentrated in the mantle zone (inset at higher power)
Composite of tissue H&E, cytology and IHC from HHV8-related disorders
15143.describe_en: Composite figure of HHV8-related post-transplant neoplasms. Panel A shows a spindle cell proliferation arranged in fascicles with slit-like vascular spaces and extravasated red cells (H&E), with nuclear HHV8 LANA-1 positivity in the spindle cells (IHC), consistent with Kaposi sarcoma.
