Panel B is a cytologic preparation of large pleomorphic cells with eccentric round to irregular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, with plasmablastic/immunoblastic features consistent with primary effusion lymphoma. Panel C shows a lymphoid follicle with numerous LANA-1-positive plasmablasts in the mantle zone (inset), consistent with HHV8-associated multicentric Castleman disease. Resolution is limited, but the LANA-1 staining pattern is the unifying diagnostic clue across the three entities.

ddx.dx: Spindle cell hemangioma or other vascular tumor (vs Kaposi sarcoma)
ddx.vs: Other vascular and spindle cell lesions are LANA-1 negative, which reliably separates them from Kaposi sarcoma.
Plasmablastic lymphoma is usually a solid mass that is EBV-positive but HHV8/LANA-1 negative, whereas PEL cells are LANA-1 positive and typically present as effusions.
iMCD shares regressed germinal centers and plasmacytosis but lacks LANA-1-positive plasmablasts in the mantle zone.
Conventional PTLD is EBER-positive and HHV8-negative, lacking the nuclear LANA-1 signal.

15143.stain: H&E; IHC: HHV8 LANA-1; Wright-Giemsa cytology
captions: A: Kaposi sarcoma, H&E (upper) and LANA-1 IHC (lower)
B: Primary effusion lymphoma cells on cytologic preparation
C: LANA-1-positive plasmablasts in the mantle zone in HHV8-associated MCD (inset: higher power)

3495.recognize_zh: 高度細胞化的骨髓抹片以各階段顆粒球前驅細胞為主，其間散在數顆胞質豐富、呈淡灰藍色的大型組織球，符合慢性骨髓性白血病（CML）中的偽高雪氏細胞（pseudo-Gaucher cells）。
features: Markedly hypercellular aspirate dominated by granulocytic precursors at all stages of maturation (myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands)
Scattered large histiocytes with abundant pale gray-blue cytoplasm and small eccentric nuclei
Cytoplasmic fibrillary texture only faintly appreciable at this magnification; one histiocyte shows small vacuoles
No sheets of blasts in the field
3495.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is markedly hypercellular with a predominance of maturing granulocytic elements, including myelocytes, metamyelocytes and band forms, without an increase in blasts in this field. Scattered among the myeloid cells are several large histiocytes with abundant pale gray-blue cytoplasm and small eccentric nuclei. The fine striated 'wrinkled tissue paper' texture is only subtly appreciable at this power. In the setting of CML, findings are consistent with pseudo-Gaucher cells reflecting increased cell turnover.

ddx.vs: Morphology is nearly identical, so separation relies on clinical context, glucocerebrosidase enzyme assay/GBA genotyping and the absence of a myeloproliferative background with BCR-ABL1.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain discrete blue ceroid granules rather than a finely fibrillar gray-blue cytoplasm.
MAC-laden histiocytes may appear striated but show negative-image rods and are acid-fast positive.
Megakaryocytes have a large multilobated nucleus and granular cytoplasm rather than a small eccentric nucleus.

exam.answer_en: Pseudo-Gaucher cells in CML — scattered large pale grey-blue histiocytes within a hypercellular granulocytic marrow
pearls_zh: 考法：考官先問背景（各階段顆粒球增生＝CML 類型骨髓），再指散在的淡灰藍大細胞，問名稱（pseudo-Gaucher cells）與其與真正 Gaucher disease 的差別。
Pseudo-Gaucher cell 形成原因：細胞更新極快，巨噬細胞吞入的 glucocerebroside 超過其正常酵素分解量；酵素本身正常。除 CML 外，也見於 thalassemia、multiple myeloma、ALL 與 MAC 感染。
CML 必考關聯：t(9;22)(q34;q11) BCR::ABL1，以 RT-PCR/FISH 確認並用 qPCR（IS）追蹤；第一線為 TKI（imatinib 或第二代 TKI）。
CML chronic phase 其他骨髓線索：myelocyte 與成熟顆粒球雙峰、嗜鹼性球與嗜酸性球增加、小型低分葉 megakaryocytes（dwarf megakaryocytes）；亦可見 sea-blue histiocytes。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤診為 Gaucher disease：pseudo-Gaucher cells 出現在 CML 等高細胞更新背景中且酵素活性正常；真正 Gaucher 需 glucocerebrosidase 活性下降與 GBA1 變異，骨髓背景無克隆性顆粒球增生。

quiz.q: 此顆粒球增生骨髓中散在的淡灰藍大型組織球叫什麼？應以哪個分子檢查確認背景疾病？
quiz.a: Pseudo-Gaucher cells；BCR::ABL1（RT-PCR 或 FISH 找 t(9;22)）。

3687.recognize_zh: 年長者手背皮膚薄且有日光損傷，上面有邊界不規則、深紫色的平坦瘀斑（ecchymosis），大於 1 公分且壓之不褪色，屬於皮下出血的臨床照片。
features: Irregular, flat, dark purple ecchymoses on the dorsum of the hand
Lesions larger than 1 cm with ill-defined edges, non-palpable
Thin, atrophic, sun-damaged skin of an older individual
No petechiae, palpable purpura or hemarthrosis evident in this view
3687.describe_en: Clinical photograph shows the dorsal hand and wrist of an older adult with thin, photodamaged skin. There are irregular, confluent, flat violaceous ecchymoses over the dorsum of the hand, without visible petechiae or palpable lesions. The distribution on sun-exposed, easily traumatized skin is typical of senile (actinic) purpura, but ecchymoses can also reflect a coagulation factor deficiency, anticoagulant use or platelet dysfunction, so correlation with medication history, platelet count, PT and aPTT is required.

ddx.vs: Confined to sun-damaged forearms and hands of elderly patients with normal coagulation tests, as the distribution here suggests.
Presents with extensive spontaneous ecchymoses in the elderly but with an isolated prolonged aPTT and a factor VIII inhibitor.
Typically also shows petechiae and mucosal bleeding and is confirmed by platelet count or function testing.
Vasculitic lesions are raised, palpable and often on the lower legs, unlike these flat ecchymoses.

3047.recognize_zh: 組織切片免疫染色中，一群成巢狀聚集的上皮樣腫瘤細胞呈強烈棕色細胞質及膜狀染色，周圍基質細胞為藍色陰性，這種群聚的陽性上皮細胞支持轉移性癌侵犯（圖上未標示抗體名稱）。
features: Immunohistochemical stain with strong brown cytoplasmic and membranous positivity in clustered tumor cells
Nested/cohesive arrangement of polygonal to oval cells with vesicular nuclei
Negative spindle stromal cells and background elements with blue hematoxylin counterstain
Scattered single positive cells infiltrating adjacent stroma
Antibody identity not indicated in the image
3047.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain on a tissue (likely bone marrow core biopsy) section shows cohesive nests and scattered single epithelioid tumor cells with strong cytoplasmic and membranous brown staining, set in a negative fibrous stroma with hematoxylin counterstain. The positive cells have oval vesicular nuclei and infiltrate the intertrabecular stroma. The specific antibody is not stated; the pattern is compatible with an epithelial marker such as cytokeratin or a prostate marker such as PSA. In context, findings are consistent with metastatic prostatic carcinoma; NKX3.1 or PSA positivity confirms prostatic origin.

ddx.vs: Cytokeratin positivity is shared; prostatic origin requires PSA, PSAP or NKX3.1 positivity with GATA3/p63 negativity.
Plasma cells are discohesive and CD138/MUM1 positive with light-chain restriction, and cytokeratin negative.

ddx.dx: Non-specific staining of stromal cells or macrophages
ddx.vs: Artifactual staining lacks the cohesive epithelioid nests and crisp membranous pattern seen here; CD68 highlights macrophages.

2023.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片中成片的大型細胞，胞質豐富淡粉灰色、呈細纖維狀條紋（像揉皺紙），細胞核小且偏位，夾雜少數造血細胞與褐色含鐵血黃素；這種條紋狀淡染胞質是 Gaucher 細胞在 H&E 切片上的樣貌。
features: Sheets of large histiocytes with abundant pale pink-gray cytoplasm and distinct cell borders
Cytoplasm with fine fibrillary, striated 'crumpled tissue paper' texture
Small, round to oval, eccentric nuclei with occasional small nucleoli
Interspersed residual hematopoietic cells (erythroid precursors, neutrophils)
Scattered golden-brown pigment consistent with hemosiderin
2023.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows sheets of large histiocytes with abundant pale, fibrillary to striated cytoplasm and small eccentric nuclei, among which residual erythroid and granulocytic cells and scattered hemosiderin pigment are present. No cytologic atypia is identified. The storage cells would be expected to be PAS-positive and diastase-resistant, iron-positive and CD68-positive. Findings are consistent with bone marrow involvement by Gaucher disease; enzyme assay for glucocerebrosidase and GBA1 genotyping are recommended.

ddx.vs: Similar striated cytoplasm but with an underlying neoplastic or hemolytic disorder and normal glucocerebrosidase activity.
Striated histiocytes contain abundant acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen stain.
Cytoplasm is finely vacuolated and bubbly rather than fibrillary.
Histiocytes contain eosinophilic crystalline immunoglobulin inclusions with an associated light-chain-restricted plasma cell neoplasm.

exam.answer_en: Gaucher disease in marrow — sheets of histiocytes with striated 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm and small eccentric nuclei (H&E)
pearls_zh: 考法：高倍切片指著條紋狀淡染胞質的大細胞問細胞名稱與病名；關鍵詞是 fibrillary / striated cytoplasm（crumpled tissue paper），不是泡沫狀空泡。
機轉：GBA1 突變致 glucocerebrosidase 缺乏，glucosylceramide 在溶小體堆積成管狀結構，電顯下呈 tubular inclusions，光學下即條紋狀胞質。
染色特性：PAS 陽性且抗 diastase、CD68 陽性、常含鐵（Prussian blue 陽性）；另可見 TRAP 陽性，確診仍靠酵素活性與 GBA1 基因檢測。
臨床：type 1 最常見、無 CNS 侵犯；types 2、3 有神經侵犯；病人 Parkinson disease 與 plasma cell neoplasm 風險增加，是常見延伸考點。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 Mycobacterium avium complex 感染的條紋狀組織球（pseudo-Gaucher）混淆；免疫低下病人需做 Ziehl-Neelsen/AFB 染色，可見大量抗酸桿菌。

quiz.q: 圖中大型細胞胞質呈條紋「皺紙」樣，這是什麼細胞？其堆積的物質為何？

1255.recognize_zh: 中央一個大型雙核漿細胞，細胞質深藍色並含粉紫色顆粒與細桿狀包涵物，核有核仁；周圍還有數個具偏心核與核周淡染區的漿細胞，符合含類 Auer 小體顆粒的骨髓瘤細胞。
features: Large binucleate plasma cell with two eccentric round nuclei and visible nucleoli
Abundant intensely basophilic cytoplasm with purple granules and faint rod-like inclusions in the upper portion
Additional smaller plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and perinuclear hofs
Some neighboring plasma cells show azurophilic granular cytoplasm
Background mixed marrow cells, a neutrophil and red cells
1255.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows atypical plasma cells, including a large binucleate form with prominent nucleoli and abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm. The cytoplasm of this and neighboring plasma cells contains azurophilic granules and rod-like inclusions resembling Auer rods, although the inclusions are less distinct at this magnification than in classic examples. Multinucleation and nucleoli indicate cytologic atypia. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with Auer rod-like cytoplasmic granules.

ddx.vs: Osteoblasts have a hof located away from the nucleus and occur in clusters without granular inclusions, and megakaryocytes have lobulated nuclei.
Myeloblasts have high N:C ratio and fine chromatin without plasmacytoid hof, and are MPO-positive.
Plasmablastic lymphoma shows sheets of immunoblast-like cells with large central nucleoli, usually EBER-positive, rather than recognizably plasmacytic cells with inclusions.

1191.recognize_zh: 小淋巴球呈同心圓層狀排列（洋蔥皮樣，onion-skin）包圍一個退化的生發中心，中央有玻璃樣變性的穿入血管（lollipop 樣），是透明血管型 Castleman 病的典型線索。
features: Concentric, onion-skin layering of small mantle-zone lymphocytes around a follicle
Atretic (regressed) germinal center depleted of centroblasts, composed of dendritic/endothelial-type cells with pale oval nuclei
Central penetrating vessel with hyalinized, eosinophilic wall entering the follicle (lollipop pattern)
Monotonous small round lymphocytes with dense chromatin and scant cytoplasm; no cytologic atypia
Scattered hyalinized vessels in the interfollicular area
1191.describe_en: Lymph node section shows a follicle with an expanded mantle zone in which small, mature lymphocytes are arranged in concentric onion-skin layers. The germinal center is regressed and lymphocyte-depleted, composed predominantly of follicular dendritic and endothelial cells, and is penetrated by a hyalinized small vessel. No sheets of large atypical cells or Reed-Sternberg-like cells are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with the hyaline-vascular pattern of Castleman disease (unicentric Castleman disease).

ddx.vs: Follicular lymphoma has back-to-back neoplastic follicles with attenuated mantles and centrocyte/centroblast-rich germinal centers (BCL2+), rather than regressed germinal centers with onion-skin mantles.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma, mantle zone pattern
ddx.vs: MCL shows mildly irregular monotonous lymphocytes that are cyclin D1/SOX11 positive, whereas Castleman mantle cells are cyclin D1 negative polyclonal B cells.

ddx.dx: Reactive lymphadenopathy with regressed follicles (e.g., HIV, autoimmune, IgG4-related)
ddx.vs: Regressive changes in reactive nodes are usually focal and admixed with hyperplastic follicles, lacking the widespread lollipop follicles and interfollicular hypervascularity.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell or mixed-type (HHV8-associated multicentric) Castleman disease
ddx.vs: These show sheets of interfollicular plasma cells and, in HHV8 disease, LANA-1 positive plasmablasts in the mantle zone, which are not a feature of this hyaline-vascular field.

exam.answer_en: Hyaline-vascular Castleman disease — onion-skin mantle zone around an atretic germinal center with a penetrating hyalinized 'lollipop' vessel
pearls_zh: 考法：這是 Castleman 最典型的單一濾泡特寫，考官會指外套區問「onion-skin」、指中央血管問「lollipop」，兩個名詞都要會。
UCD 與 MCD 的區分靠臨床與影像：UCD 為單一淋巴結區域、多無全身症狀；MCD 有多區淋巴結、全身發炎症狀與實驗室異常（貧血、低白蛋白、CRP 上升）。
HHV8 相關 MCD 在 HIV 病人常見，需驗 HHV8 viral load 並做 LANA-1 IHC；可合併 Kaposi sarcoma 或 HHV8+ 淋巴瘤。
iMCD 需排除感染、自體免疫與腫瘤等 mimics（如 IgG4-related disease、SLE）；一線治療為抗 IL-6 的 siltuximab。
exam.pitfall_zh: 容易與 follicular lymphoma 混淆；FL 為密集背靠背的腫瘤性濾泡、生發中心充滿 centrocytes 並 BCL2+，Castleman 的生發中心反而萎縮、淋巴球稀少且外套區同心圓排列。

quiz.q: 圖中濾泡外套區小淋巴球的同心圓排列稱為什麼型態？

1319.recognize_zh: 中央的巨核細胞（megakaryocyte）核呈濃縮、分葉少的雙葉或圓形團塊，細胞質深藍且邊緣呈毛邊狀，在化療後骨髓中屬於巨核細胞的治療相關變化。
features: Megakaryocyte with a dense, hyperchromatic, hypolobated (round to bilobed) nucleus
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with ragged, frayed margins and scant granulation
Cell smaller than a typical mature megakaryocyte, but much larger than surrounding myeloid cells
Background of maturing granulocytes (myelocytes, bands, segmented neutrophils) and scattered erythroid precursors
Occasional cell with coarse cytoplasmic vacuolization in the background
1319.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a megakaryocyte with a compact, hyperchromatic, hypolobated nucleus and deeply basophilic cytoplasm with irregular, frayed borders. The background contains maturing granulocytic precursors and occasional erythroid precursors without an increase in blasts in this field. In the setting of recent cytotoxic therapy, these megakaryocytic changes are most consistent with chemotherapy effect; true dysplasia should not be diagnosed on post-therapy marrow without clinical correlation.

ddx.vs: MDS dysplasia persists without recent therapy and is accompanied by dysplasia in other lineages and often cytopenias with clonal cytogenetic or molecular abnormalities.
The 5q- syndrome shows numerous small monolobated megakaryocytes with isolated del(5q), whereas this change is a transient post-chemotherapy effect.
Megakaryoblasts have fine blastic chromatin, nucleoli and cytoplasmic blebs, unlike the condensed mature chromatin of this megakaryocyte.

1127.recognize_zh: 低倍的周邊血抹片中，白血球多為中型、細胞質少、無顆粒的芽細胞，成熟中性球很少；芽細胞無顆粒亦無 Auer 小體，形態上無法分辨系別，需流式細胞儀才能確認為 AML 微分化型。
features: Increased circulating medium-sized mononuclear cells with high N:C ratio (blasts)
Round to slightly irregular nuclei; chromatin detail limited at this low magnification
Scant, agranular pale blue cytoplasm without visible Auer rods
Rare mature neutrophil; red cells appear normocytic
Platelets appear reduced
1127.describe_en: Low-power peripheral blood smear shows increased circulating medium-sized blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios and scant, agranular cytoplasm; Auer rods are not seen. Mature neutrophils are rare and platelets appear decreased. Chromatin and nucleolar details cannot be adequately assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with acute leukemia; because blasts in AML with minimal differentiation lack morphologic and cytochemical evidence of myeloid differentiation, lineage assignment requires flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: ALL blasts look similar but express B- or T-lineage antigens (CD19, CD79a, cyCD3) instead of myeloid markers such as CD13, CD33 and CD117.
MPAL blasts express lineage-defining markers of more than one lineage by flow cytometry, which morphology cannot detect.
Reactive lymphocytes have abundant basophilic cytoplasm and mature chromatin, not the high N:C ratio of blasts.

1063.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一顆巨大的多核細胞，約十餘個大小一致、圓形分離的細胞核，彼此不相連，細胞質豐富、帶細緻顆粒，這是破骨細胞（osteoclast），和核相連分葉的巨核細胞不同。
features: Giant cell many times larger than surrounding marrow cells
Multiple (more than 10) uniform, round to oval, separate nuclei
Nuclei with finely granular chromatin and small nucleoli
Abundant grey-blue cytoplasm with fine pink-purple granules and ill-defined borders
Surrounding granulocytic and erythroid precursors in an aspirate background
1063.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a giant multinucleated cell containing more than a dozen discrete, uniform round nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli, set in abundant finely granular grey-blue cytoplasm. The nuclei are separate rather than lobulated and interconnected. Surrounding hematopoietic precursors are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with an osteoclast, a normal constituent of marrow aspirates that is more frequent in children and states of increased bone remodeling.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have a single large lobulated, interconnected nucleus rather than multiple separate uniform nuclei.
Tumor clusters consist of separate cells with individual cell borders, pleomorphic nuclei and nuclear molding, not a single syncytial cell with uniform nuclei.

ddx.dx: Multinucleated giant cell of granuloma (Langhans type)
ddx.vs: Langhans cells arrange nuclei in a peripheral horseshoe and occur with epithelioid histiocytes in a granuloma.

exam.answer_en: Osteoclast — giant multinucleated marrow cell with numerous separate, uniform round nuclei (normal marrow constituent)
pearls_zh: 考法：與 megakaryocyte 比較。答 osteoclast：多個彼此分離、大小一致的圓核；megakaryocyte 則是單一個分葉且相連的大核。
來源：osteoclast 由 monocyte/macrophage 系分化而來，屬正常骨髓成分，負責骨吸收；TRAP 陽性。
增加情境：兒童、骨骼重塑活躍（hyperparathyroidism、Paget disease、骨轉移），在抽吸片常與 osteoblasts 一起出現。
報告時不應計入骨髓分類計數，也不代表腫瘤；若在切片中大量出現並伴骨破壞，需找背後的骨病因。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常被誤認為 megakaryocyte（或轉移腫瘤團）：megakaryocyte 為單一分葉相連核；腫瘤團由彼此有細胞界線、核多形且互相擠壓的細胞組成，而 osteoclast 是單一合胞體、核一致。

quiz.q: 這顆多核巨大細胞是什麼？與 megakaryocyte 在核的形態上差在哪？
quiz.a: Osteoclast；多個分離一致的圓核 vs megakaryocyte 單一分葉相連核

4135.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片中以大量小型、核質比高、染色質呈塊狀的成熟淋巴球為主，取代正常造血細胞；箭頭所指為一顆大型細胞（形態上像巨核細胞），可作為大小對照。
features: Marrow particle-rich smear dominated by small mature lymphocytes
Round nuclei with condensed, clumped (soccer-ball) chromatin and scant cytoplasm
Admixed slightly larger lymphoid cells with more open chromatin and small nucleoli
Reduced residual myeloid and erythroid precursors
Arrow marks a large, dense round cell (likely a megakaryocyte) for size comparison
4135.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen extensively infiltrated by small, mature-appearing lymphocytes with round nuclei, clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm, with a minor population of somewhat larger lymphoid cells. Residual trilineage hematopoiesis appears reduced. A large dense cell (arrow), most likely a megakaryocyte, is present. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by chronic lymphocytic leukemia; immunophenotyping (CD5+, CD23+, dim sIg) is required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: MCL cells often have more irregular nuclei and are CD5+ but CD23-negative with cyclin D1/SOX11 expression.
These show plasmacytoid differentiation or monocytoid cytoplasm and are typically CD5- and CD23-.
Hematogones have homogeneous smudged chromatin and a maturing B-precursor phenotype (CD10, CD34/TdT subsets) rather than clumped mature chromatin.

4007.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片高倍下可見核摺疊的單核球、前單核球與各階段顆粒球（桿狀核、分葉核、中幼粒細胞）混合存在，並有有核紅血球；單核球與顆粒球共同增生而非母細胞成片，符合幼年型骨髓單核球性白血病（JMML）。
features: Monocytes and promonocytes with folded, convoluted nuclei and gray-blue cytoplasm
Granulocytic maturation present: myelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils
Occasional cells with ring-shaped or doughnut nuclei
Orthochromatic erythroid precursors with dense pyknotic nuclei
Scattered larger cells with finer chromatin but no sheets of blasts
4007.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a mixed population of monocytes and promonocytes with folded nuclei and gray-blue cytoplasm, admixed with maturing granulocytes including myelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils. Scattered late erythroid precursors are present. Blasts are identified but do not form sheets in this field. Findings are consistent with a myelomonocytic proliferation compatible with juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: AMML requires at least 20% blasts including promonocytes, whereas JMML shows predominant maturing myelomonocytic cells with blasts below 20%.
CMML has overlapping marrow morphology but occurs in older adults and lacks the childhood RAS-pathway (PTPN11, NRAS, KRAS, NF1, CBL) genetic context.
Pediatric MDS is usually hypocellular without prominent monocytic proliferation or peripheral monocytosis.

3879.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血抹片裡白血球明顯增加，大多是小到中型、胞質嗜鹼性的淋巴樣細胞，好幾顆細胞邊緣有胞質突起（cytoplasmic blebs），這是 T 細胞前淋巴球性白血病（T-PLL）常見的外觀。
features: Marked lymphocytosis of small to medium-sized lymphoid cells
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with relatively condensed chromatin at this magnification
Scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm, several cells with cytoplasmic blebs/protrusions
Occasional smudged/disrupted cells
Nucleoli not resolvable at this low power; red cells unremarkable
3879.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows a marked lymphocytosis composed of small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei and scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm; several cells display cytoplasmic blebs. Scattered smudged cells are present. Nucleolar detail cannot be assessed at this magnification. In the appropriate context, findings are consistent with T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia, to be confirmed by flow cytometry (CD4/CD7-positive T cells) and TCL1A/MTCP1 rearrangement studies.

ddx.dx: B-cell prolymphocytic leukemia / CLL with increased prolymphocytes
ddx.vs: B-cell cases have larger cells with a single prominent central nucleolus and no cytoplasmic blebs, and flow shows B-cell markers rather than CD3/CD7.
ATLL cells have deeply lobated 'flower' nuclei, and the patient is HTLV-1 positive with CD25-bright, CD7-negative T cells.
Sézary cells have cerebriform, grooved nuclei and are typically CD7-negative/CD26-negative without TCL1A rearrangement.

exam.answer_en: T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia — marked lymphocytosis of small-medium basophilic lymphoid cells with cytoplasmic blebs (low power)
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍看到大量淋巴樣細胞＋細胞質 bleb，考官問鑑別清單：CLL、B-PLL 轉化、T-PLL、Sézary、ATLL、T-LGL，並問下一步做 flow。
T-PLL 細胞大小可偏小（small-cell variant），低倍核仁不易看到，不能因看不到核仁就排除；bleb 與強嗜鹼性細胞質是線索。
Flow 要點：CD7 強陽性、sCD3 可弱、CD52 高表現；CD4+CD8− 最常見，其次 CD4+CD8+ 雙陽性。
遺傳：TCL1A（14q32.13）經 inv(14)/t(14;14) 或 MTCP1（Xq28）經 t(X;14) 活化；FISH 找 TCL1A 重排可確診。
與 ATLL 鑑別需查 HTLV-1 血清學（台灣屬 HTLV-1 流行區之一）；ATLL 常 CD25+、CD7−。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 CLL；CLL 細胞小、染色質塊狀、細胞質少而淡並伴大量 smudge cell，且為 CD5+CD23+ 的 B 細胞，T-PLL 為 T 細胞表型、細胞質嗜鹼帶 bleb。

quiz.q: 低倍抹片見大量帶細胞質 bleb 的淋巴樣細胞，懷疑 T-PLL，flow 中哪個 T 細胞抗原典型為強陽性（有助與 Sézary 區分）？
quiz.a: CD7（強陽性；Sézary 常 CD7 丟失）

3943.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中央有一團淡粉紅、細胞核呈卵圓或腎形的類上皮組織球（epithelioid histiocytes）聚集，周圍混有淋巴球與嗜酸性球（箭頭），為骨髓肉芽腫。
features: Aggregate of epithelioid histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and indistinct cell borders
Histiocyte nuclei oval to reniform with vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli
Admixed eosinophils with bright red granules (arrows) and small lymphocytes
No necrosis or multinucleated giant cells in this field
Surrounding hematopoietic marrow and fat spaces
3943.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a loosely formed aggregate of epithelioid histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval to reniform vesicular nuclei. Admixed eosinophils (arrows) and small lymphocytes are present at the periphery. No caseous necrosis or multinucleated giant cells are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with a bone marrow granuloma; special stains for organisms (AFB, GMS) and clinical correlation are recommended to determine etiology.

ddx.vs: Lipogranulomas are small, centered on fat vacuoles with foamy macrophages, and are incidental, unlike this compact epithelioid aggregate.
Hodgkin involvement shows Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells (CD30+, CD15+) within a fibrotic mixed infiltrate, which are not seen here.
Mast cell aggregates are spindled with clear cytoplasm, often paratrabecular with eosinophils, and are CD117/tryptase positive rather than CD68-positive histiocytes.
LCH cells have grooved, coffee-bean nuclei and are CD1a/langerin positive, typically with numerous eosinophils.

3623.recognize_zh: 高倍細胞學可見多個核偏位、核仁明顯、細胞質豐富帶顆粒且有核旁淡染區的漿細胞樣細胞，部分為雙核，屬較不成熟的腫瘤性漿細胞，符合漿細胞瘤。
features: Large plasmacytoid cells with abundant granular, lightly basophilic cytoplasm
Eccentric round to oval nuclei with perinuclear clearing (hof)
Vesicular chromatin with visible, occasionally prominent nucleoli
Binucleated and mildly pleomorphic forms
Discohesive arrangement without epithelial clustering
3623.describe_en: High-power cytologic preparation shows discohesive large plasmacytoid cells with eccentric round to oval nuclei, perinuclear clearing, and abundant granular cytoplasm. Nuclei have vesicular chromatin with visible nucleoli, and binucleated and mildly pleomorphic forms are present, indicating immature (plasmacytic to plasmablastic) morphology. No cohesive epithelial groups are seen. Findings are consistent with a neoplastic plasma cell proliferation; in an extramedullary mass this supports plasmacytoma, pending confirmation with CD138 and light-chain restriction.

ddx.vs: Plasmablastic lymphoma cells are larger with more prominent central nucleoli and less abundant cytoplasm, show very high Ki-67, and are often EBV-positive.
Immunoblasts have central prominent nucleoli and are CD20/PAX5 positive, whereas neoplastic plasma cells are CD20-negative and CD138-positive.
Carcinoma cells tend to cluster and are keratin positive, CD45/CD138 pattern and light-chain restriction are absent.
ALCL hallmark cells have horseshoe-shaped nuclei and strong CD30 (with or without ALK) positivity.

3559.recognize_zh: 這不是型態學影像，而是間期細胞核的螢光原位雜交（interphase FISH）：藍色 DAPI 核內可見三個綠色、兩個水藍色與兩個紅色訊號；若依常見 CLL panel 綠色代表 CEP12，則為 trisomy 12，此異常與非典型型態 CLL 相關。
features: Single interphase nucleus counterstained blue with DAPI
Three green signals, suggesting a chromosomal gain of the corresponding locus
Two aqua and two red signals, consistent with normal copy number at those loci
Signals are discrete and well separated, allowing reliable enumeration in this nucleus
Probe identities are not labeled; interpretation assumes a standard CLL panel with green CEP12
3559.describe_en: Interphase FISH image shows a single DAPI-counterstained nucleus with three green signals, two aqua signals, and two red signals. Assuming a standard CLL panel in which the green probe is the chromosome 12 centromere (CEP12) and the red/aqua probes target 13q14 (D13S319) and 13q34, the pattern indicates trisomy 12 without 13q14 deletion. A single nucleus cannot establish a clone, and the result must be based on scoring of an adequate number of nuclei against laboratory cutoffs. Trisomy 12 is associated with atypical CLL morphology (increased prolymphocytes and cleaved or plasmacytoid cells) and CD5+ cases with FMC7/CD22 or brighter surface light chain expression.

3367.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 H&E 中可見成片大型組織球，細胞質豐富、呈灰粉紅色細顆粒或纖維狀質地，細胞核小而偏心，其間夾雜紅血球與殘存造血細胞；大量顆粒狀細胞質的組織球取代骨髓，是骨髓組織球增生的表現，外觀類似 Gaucher 或假 Gaucher 細胞。
features: Aggregates of large histiocytes with abundant pale grey-pink cytoplasm
Cytoplasm finely granular to fibrillary, giving a stippled texture
Small, bland, eccentric round to oval nuclei
Interspersed residual hematopoietic cells, including erythroid and myeloid precursors
Extravasated red cells and loose, partly disrupted stroma
3367.describe_en: Bone marrow section shows extensive aggregates of large histiocytes with abundant pale grey-pink, finely granular to fibrillary cytoplasm and small bland eccentric nuclei. Residual hematopoietic cells, including erythroid and myeloid precursors, and extravasated red cells are interspersed among the histiocytes. No granulomas, necrosis or atypical tumor cells are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with marrow histiocytosis with Gaucher-like (storage-type) histiocytes; the differential includes Gaucher disease and pseudo-Gaucher cells secondary to high cell turnover, and PAS, AFB stains and clinical correlation are recommended.

ddx.vs: True Gaucher cells show the same crumpled fibrillary cytoplasm but are confirmed by deficient glucocerebrosidase activity or GBA1 mutation.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher cells in CML, myeloma or thalassemia
ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells are morphologically similar but occur with an underlying neoplasm or hemolytic state recognizable elsewhere in the marrow.
MAC-laden histiocytes have a striated pseudo-Gaucher appearance but are strongly AFB-positive, typically in immunosuppressed patients.

ddx.dx: Metastatic signet-ring or clear cell carcinoma
ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells have atypical hyperchromatic nuclei and are cytokeratin-positive and CD68/CD163-negative.

3431.recognize_zh: 與同系列相同的濃縮抹片：大量中到大型、核質比高、染色質細緻的非典型淋巴樣細胞，偶有核仁與細胞質空泡，並混有許多洋紅色的破裂細胞；看不到明顯的裂核，需靠免疫表現型確認為周邊化的濾泡性淋巴瘤。
features: Sheet of intermediate to large atypical lymphoid cells with high N:C ratio
Round to oval nuclei, occasionally indented, with fine to slightly clumped chromatin
Small nucleoli visible in a subset of cells
Scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm; a few cells contain small vacuoles
Many ruptured cells with pink-magenta smeared chromatin
Red cells are sparse relative to the lymphoid population, suggesting a concentrated preparation
3431.describe_en: The concentrated smear shows a monotonous infiltrate of intermediate to large atypical lymphoid cells with high N:C ratios. Nuclei are round to oval, occasionally indented, with fine to slightly clumped chromatin and small nucleoli in some cells. Cytoplasm is scant and basophilic, with occasional small vacuoles, and numerous disrupted cells with smeared magenta chromatin are present. Classic small cleaved centrocyte-like cells are not prominent. Findings are consistent with leukemic involvement by a B-cell lymphoma with atypical, large-cell morphology; in context this represents peripheralizing follicular lymphoma, to be confirmed by flow cytometry and BCL2 rearrangement studies.

ddx.vs: Blasts are TdT and CD34 positive with very fine chromatin, while FL cells are mature CD10+ B cells with surface light chain restriction.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma in leukemic phase
ddx.vs: Large-cell transformation can look identical; tissue biopsy showing diffuse sheets of large cells is needed to distinguish it from FL with atypical circulating cells.
Cyclin D1 and SOX11 positivity with CD10 negativity identify MCL.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with many sharply punched-out vacuoles and a near-100% Ki-67 with MYC rearrangement without BCL2 rearrangement.

3303.recognize_zh: 骨髓觸片上大量單一形態的原始細胞，核質比高、細胞核圓至卵圓或有凹陷，染色質細緻、無顆粒；背景為粉紫色蛋白質與大量透明脂肪空泡，這是 ALL 觸片的典型樣貌，Ph 陽性需靠 FISH 或 PCR 檢測 BCR::ABL1。
features: Monotonous population of blasts, roughly twice the size of red cells
High N:C ratio with scant pale basophilic cytoplasm
Round, oval or indented nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin
Nucleoli small or inconspicuous; no granules or Auer rods
Background of proteinaceous material with abundant clear lipid droplets from touch imprint
3303.describe_en: Touch imprint preparation shows numerous monotonous blasts dispersed singly and in loose aggregates against a pink-purple proteinaceous background containing many clear lipid droplets. The blasts have high N:C ratios, scant pale basophilic cytoplasm, round to oval or indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. Cytoplasmic granules and Auer rods are absent. Findings are consistent with acute lymphoblastic leukemia; immunophenotyping and cytogenetic or molecular testing are required to confirm B-lineage and BCR::ABL1 (Philadelphia chromosome) positivity.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts often have granules or Auer rods and express MPO, whereas lymphoblasts are MPO-negative and TdT-positive.
Blastoid MCL is TdT-negative, cyclin D1-positive and expresses surface light chains.
Morphology is identical; history of CML or BCR::ABL1 detected in neutrophils favors CML blast phase over de novo Ph+ ALL.

ddx.dx: Small round blue cell tumors (e.g., neuroblastoma, rhabdomyosarcoma)
ddx.vs: These form rosettes or cohesive clusters and are CD45/TdT-negative with lineage-specific markers.

3239.recognize_zh: 低中倍骨髓切片中，骨小樑之間細胞密度高、脂肪減少，巨核細胞明顯增多並鬆散成群，大小不一、核深染不規則，周圍基質略呈流線狀，符合骨髓纖維化中巨核細胞群聚。
features: Hypercellular intertrabecular marrow with reduced fat
Markedly increased megakaryocytes forming loose and tight clusters
Megakaryocytes vary in size with hyperchromatic, irregular or bulbous nuclei
Background with pale eosinophilic, somewhat streaming stroma and dilated sinus spaces
Scattered erythroid and granulocytic cells; bony trabeculae at upper left, upper right and bottom
3239.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E) at low to medium power shows a hypercellular marrow with reduced fat between bony trabeculae. Megakaryocytes are markedly increased and form loose and tight clusters; they vary in size and have hyperchromatic, irregular and bulbous nuclei. The intervening stroma is pale and somewhat streaming, suggesting fibrosis, with dilated sinusoidal spaces. Findings are consistent with a myeloproliferative neoplasm with atypical megakaryocyte clustering, most suggestive of primary myelofibrosis; reticulin/trichrome grading and driver mutation studies are recommended.

ddx.vs: ET shows increased, mostly dispersed giant megakaryocytes with hyperlobulated staghorn nuclei and normal cellularity without hyperchromatic atypia.
PV shows prominent erythroid and granulocytic panmyelosis with pleomorphic but non-hyperchromatic megakaryocytes.

ddx.dx: Myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm or MDS with fibrosis
ddx.vs: MDS shows small dysplastic hypolobated megakaryocytes and multilineage dysplasia rather than large bulbous cloud-like forms.
Reactive hyperplasia shows increased but evenly spaced morphologically normal megakaryocytes without clustering or fibrosis.

3175.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的骨髓細胞胞質內有數顆大而圓、紫紅色的粗大包涵顆粒，遠大於一般嗜天青顆粒，是融合而成的巨大顆粒（pseudo-Chédiak-Higashi granules），常見於AML或MDS。
features: Arrowed myeloid cell with a large nucleus and fine chromatin containing several large round purple-red cytoplasmic granules
Giant granules markedly larger than normal azurophilic granules, clustered at one pole of the cytoplasm
Adjacent blast with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm without granules
Nearby myelocyte/promyelocyte with oval eccentric nucleus and pale granular cytoplasm
Background red cells without significant abnormality
3175.describe_en: Smear shows an immature myeloid cell (arrow) with fine nuclear chromatin whose cytoplasm contains several large, round, purple-red granules considerably larger than ordinary azurophilic granules. An adjacent blast with basophilic agranular cytoplasm and a more mature granulocytic precursor are also present. Findings are consistent with pseudo-Chédiak-Higashi granules, an acquired abnormality typically seen in AML or myelodysplastic neoplasms rather than inherited Chédiak-Higashi syndrome.

ddx.vs: The inherited disorder shows giant granules in mature neutrophils, lymphocytes and other lineages of most cells in a child with albinism, rather than in occasional leukemic precursors.
Auer rods are slender needle-shaped pink-red inclusions, whereas pseudo-Chédiak-Higashi granules are large round globules.
Döhle bodies are pale blue cytoplasmic patches and toxic granules are fine dark granules in mature neutrophils, not large round granules in immature cells.
Alder-Reilly granules are diffuse dark lilac granules in all neutrophils in mucopolysaccharidosis, not a few giant globules in blasts.

exam.answer_en: Pseudo-Chédiak-Higashi granules — giant fused azurophilic granules in an immature myeloid cell, typical of AML/MDS
pearls_zh: 考法：箭頭指的細胞胞質內巨大紫紅色顆粒，考官問「這是 Chédiak-Higashi syndrome 嗎」；答 acquired pseudo-CH granules，見於 AML 或 MDS。
Pseudo-CH granules 由一般嗜天青顆粒融合而成，MPO 陽性；在 AML 中曾報告與 AML with maturation 等相關，屬 dysplasia 表現。
真正 Chédiak-Higashi syndrome：LYST 突變、體染色體隱性，表現為部分白化症、反覆感染、出血傾向、神經病變，且可進入 HLH accelerated phase。
與 Alder-Reilly anomaly（mucopolysaccharidosis 的深紫粗顆粒）及 toxic granulation 區分。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 Chédiak-Higashi syndrome；遺傳性 CHS 巨大顆粒見於多系成熟細胞並有白化症，pseudo-CH 只在少數白血病前驅細胞。

quiz.q: 箭頭細胞胞質內的巨大圓形紫紅色顆粒稱為什麼？通常見於哪些疾病？

2983.recognize_zh: 周邊血中一顆白血球的細胞質內布滿粗大、不規則的深紫紅色顆粒，比正常顆粒大很多且大小不一，是 Chediak-Higashi 症候群的巨大顆粒；旁邊有一顆血小板。
features: Single granulocyte with a dense, irregular nucleus
Cytoplasm filled with coarse, irregular, variably sized dark purple-red granules
Granules markedly larger than normal neutrophilic granules
Nearby platelet of normal size
Normocytic red cells without significant poikilocytosis
2983.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic red cells, a normal-sized platelet and a single granulocyte. The granulocyte cytoplasm contains numerous coarse, irregular, variably sized dark purple-red granules that are much larger than normal neutrophilic granules. Findings are consistent with the abnormal giant granules of Chediak-Higashi syndrome.

ddx.vs: Normal eosinophil granules are uniform orange-red spheres and basophil granules obscure a lobed nucleus, whereas these granules are irregular and variably sized.
Toxic granules are fine and uniform in neutrophils and accompany Döhle bodies or vacuoles.
Alder-Reilly granules appear in lymphocytes and monocytes as well and are small and dense rather than giant.

exam.answer_en: Chediak-Higashi syndrome — granulocyte with cytoplasm filled by coarse, irregular, variably sized dark purple-red giant granules
pearls_zh: 考法：考官可能問這顆是否為 eosinophil 或 basophil；關鍵是顆粒大小不一、形狀不規則，不同於嗜酸性球均勻圓形橘紅顆粒。
LYST 突變造成顆粒融合；嗜中性球殺菌與趨化功能下降，導致反覆細菌感染。
出血傾向來自血小板 dense granule 缺乏（storage pool deficiency），血小板數可正常；旁邊的血小板大小正常也符合。
NK/CTL 細胞毒性顆粒釋放缺陷是進展為 HLH 的機轉。
與 Alder-Reilly anomaly 區分：後者為黏多醣病相關、所有白血球含細小深染顆粒，非巨大顆粒。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 eosinophil 或 basophil；嗜酸性顆粒均勻圓形、嗜鹼性顆粒會遮蓋核，CHS 顆粒則大小不一、形狀不規則。

quiz.q: CHS 病人血小板數常正常卻有出血傾向，機轉為何？
quiz.a: 血小板 dense granule 缺乏（storage pool deficiency）

2855.recognize_zh: 淋巴結 H&E：大片形態一致的小至中型細胞，核圓形、染色質細緻、有小核仁，每顆細胞周圍有淡粉紅細胞質使核彼此平均間隔，間有纖細血管，是邊緣區（monocytoid）B 細胞的生長型態。
features: Diffuse monotonous sheet of small to intermediate lymphoid cells
Round, regular nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli
Moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm producing even nuclear spacing
Few larger cells; low mitotic activity in this field
Delicate thin-walled vessels traversing the infiltrate
2855.describe_en: H&E section of lymph node shows a diffuse, monotonous infiltrate of small to intermediate lymphoid cells with round, regular nuclei, fine chromatin and small nucleoli. Moderate pale cytoplasm results in evenly spaced nuclei, and delicate vessels traverse the infiltrate. Mitotic figures and large transformed cells are infrequent in this field. The appearance is compatible with marginal zone lymphoma with monocytoid features, though immunohistochemistry is required to separate it from other small B-cell lymphomas.

ddx.vs: Mantle cell lymphoma is also monotonous but has scant cytoplasm, irregular nuclei, pink hyalinized vessels and cyclin D1 positivity.
Lymphoblasts have finer dusty chromatin, higher N:C ratio, frequent mitoses and TdT positivity.
Hairy cells have abundant clear cytoplasm with 'fried-egg' spacing and express CD103, CD123, annexin A1 and BRAF V600E.

2791.recognize_zh: 同一種淋巴球聚集在這張免疫染色幾乎全為陰性，只有極少數零星棕色陽性細胞；抗體未標示，依標題推測是 B 細胞標記（如 CD20），代表 rituximab 後聚集內 B 細胞缺乏。
features: Interstitial lymphoid aggregate of small cells, appearing more hypercellular than surrounding marrow
Aggregate essentially negative for the stain
Only rare scattered positive cells within and around the aggregate
Surrounding hematopoietic marrow negative with hematoxylin counterstain
Fat spaces and trabecular edge at the periphery
2791.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain of a bone marrow core biopsy shows an interstitial lymphoid aggregate that is essentially negative, with only rare scattered positive cells. The surrounding marrow is negative. The antibody is not labeled; if this is a B-cell marker such as CD20, the aggregate lacks B cells. Because rituximab may cause loss of CD20 expression by residual neoplastic B cells, a negative CD20 stain should be complemented by PAX5 or CD79a before concluding that the aggregate represents reactive T-cell hyperplasia.

ddx.dx: Residual CD20-negative B-cell lymphoma after rituximab
ddx.vs: Residual lymphoma loses CD20 but remains PAX5/CD79a/CD19-positive and light-chain restricted.
A CD20-negative aggregate composed of atypical T cells with aberrant antigen loss and TCR clonality would indicate T-cell lymphoma rather than reactive hyperplasia.
CD138/MUM1 or MPO/CD117 staining identifies non-lymphoid aggregates that would also be CD20-negative.

2535.recognize_zh: 中低倍骨髓抹片中成簇細胞裡可見數顆核大、胞質深藍無顆粒的原始細胞，與分葉嗜中性球、紅血球前驅細胞混雜，提示 MDS 伴過量原始細胞；確切比例需計數。
features: Clusters of marrow cells on a sparsely cellular background
Several blasts with large round nuclei, fine chromatin and deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Admixed segmented neutrophils, myelocytes and erythroid precursors
Occasional large cells with abundant granular cytoplasm
Low magnification limits evaluation of dysplasia and blast percentage
2535.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at low to intermediate power shows small clusters of hematopoietic cells, including several blasts with large round nuclei, fine chromatin and deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm, admixed with maturing granulocytes and erythroid precursors. Dysplastic features cannot be confidently assessed at this magnification. A 500-cell differential is required to establish the blast percentage. Findings are suggestive of myelodysplastic syndrome with excess blasts in the appropriate clinical and cytogenetic context.

ddx.vs: AML is defined by at least 20% blasts (or a defining genetic lesion), which requires a formal differential rather than a single field.
MDS with low blasts has fewer than 5% marrow blasts and no Auer rods, so the blast count is the discriminator.
Plasma cells have eccentric nuclei with clockface chromatin and a perinuclear hof, whereas myeloblasts have central fine chromatin and scant hofless cytoplasm.

2407.recognize_zh: 箭頭處骨小樑旁有一小群大型細胞，細胞質豐富、嗜雙性，核偏位、有明顯核仁，其中可見雙核細胞，比周圍造血細胞大很多，符合骨髓瘤的大型不典型漿細胞聚集。
features: Small cluster of large cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm (arrow)
Eccentric round nuclei with vesicular chromatin and prominent central nucleoli
Binucleate/multinucleate forms within the cluster
Located in paratrabecular marrow adjacent to a bony trabecula
Background of fat and mixed hematopoietic cells with hemorrhage
2407.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy (H&E) shows marrow adjacent to a bony trabecula with a small cluster of large atypical cells (arrow) having abundant amphophilic cytoplasm, eccentric round nuclei, vesicular chromatin, and prominent nucleoli, including binucleate forms. The surrounding marrow contains fat and a mixed population of hematopoietic cells. The morphology is consistent with large atypical plasma cells; confirmation with CD138 and kappa/lambda immunohistochemistry or ISH is recommended to assess extent and clonality. Findings are suggestive of plasma cell myeloma with large plasma cells.

ddx.vs: Osteoblasts line the bone surface in a single layer with a hof distant from the nucleus and are CD138/light chain negative, rather than forming interstitial clusters.
Megakaryocytes have lobulated nuclei, finely granular pink cytoplasm, and are CD61 positive, whereas plasma cells have round eccentric nuclei and are CD138 positive.
Carcinoma forms cohesive nests often with desmoplasia and is cytokeratin positive, CD138 variable, without light chain restriction.

2343.recognize_zh: 中倍下可見淡紫紅色、呈條紋狀流動的無定形基質，其中散布稀疏的小型有核細胞與紅血球，並有數個圓形脂肪空泡，細胞量明顯減少，符合骨髓膠狀轉化。
features: Streaming, pale magenta amorphous extracellular matrix with a faintly fibrillar, wispy texture
Sparse, scattered small nucleated cells embedded in the matrix
Red cells distributed throughout, partly outlined by the ground substance
Several round clear vacuoles consistent with fat droplets
Occasional dark refractile debris/pigment particle
2343.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at intermediate power shows abundant pale magenta, amorphous ground substance with a streaming fibrillar appearance. Nucleated marrow cells are sparse and scattered individually within the matrix, accompanied by red cells and occasional small fat vacuoles. No cohesive abnormal cell clusters are identified. Findings are consistent with gelatinous transformation of the marrow, compatible with the clinical history of anorexia nervosa.

ddx.vs: Amyloid is dense, waxy and Congo red positive, while gelatinous transformation material is loose, mucoid and Alcian blue positive (hyaluronic acid).
A dilute aspirate shows blood without the thick extracellular magenta ground substance.
Necrosis shows smudged, degenerating cells with loss of nuclear detail rather than intact cells in a mucoid matrix.

2279.recognize_zh: 一片單一的中型淋巴母細胞，高核質比、細胞質很少且淡藍，染色質細緻而緻密、部分核有凹痕或摺痕，缺乏顆粒與 Auer rod；形態只能提示淋巴母細胞，T 細胞系需靠流式細胞儀確認。
features: Monotonous medium-sized blasts with very high N:C ratio
Round to oval nuclei, several with indentations, clefts or convolutions
Finely stippled, moderately dense chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant pale blue agranular cytoplasm, some with small cytoplasmic tails
Smudged cell debris in background; no Auer rods or granules
2279.describe_en: Smear shows a monotonous population of medium-sized blasts with very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round to oval nuclei with occasional indentations or convolutions, finely stippled chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. Cytoplasm is scant, pale blue and agranular, and no Auer rods are seen. Smudged cells are present in the background. Findings are consistent with lymphoblastic leukemia; T-lineage assignment (cytoplasmic CD3, TdT) requires flow cytometry or immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: B-ALL is morphologically indistinguishable and is separated by flow cytometry (CD19, CD22, CD79a versus cytoplasmic CD3).
Minimally differentiated myeloblasts are also agranular but express CD13, CD33, CD117 and MPO by flow and lack T-cell markers.

ddx.dx: Leukemic phase of mantle cell lymphoma (blastoid)
ddx.vs: Blastoid MCL cells are TdT negative, CD5 and cyclin D1 positive mature B cells.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent lipid vacuoles and are TdT-negative surface Ig-positive B cells.

2151.recognize_zh: 高倍抹片中多數細胞為核呈折疊、分葉或腦回狀的單核球，胞質灰藍、含細顆粒與小空泡，邊緣有胞質突起（blebs），夾雜骨髓細胞與少數小淋巴球，呈現單核球系明顯增生，符合 CMML。
features: Many monocytes with folded, convoluted, or lobulated nuclei
Fine to moderately condensed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules, small vacuoles, and cytoplasmic blebs
Admixed granulocytic precursors (myelocytes, metamyelocytes) and occasional band forms
Rare small lymphocytes; blast-like cells few
2151.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows numerous monocytes with folded, convoluted, and lobulated nuclei, fine to moderately condensed chromatin, and abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules, small vacuoles, and irregular cytoplasmic blebs. Granulocytic precursors and occasional small lymphocytes are admixed. Blasts and promonocytes do not predominate in this field. Findings are consistent with a monocytic and granulocytic proliferation, supporting chronic myelomonocytic leukemia in conjunction with peripheral blood monocytosis and exclusion of BCR::ABL1.

ddx.vs: Would show ≥20% monoblasts/promonocytes with fine chromatin and prominent nucleoli, whereas most cells here are mature monocytes.
Lacks dysplasia and clonal genetic abnormalities; monocytes are usually less numerous in the marrow.

ddx.dx: Chronic myeloid leukemia with monocytosis (p190 BCR::ABL1)
ddx.vs: Requires BCR::ABL1 testing, as morphology alone cannot exclude it.

2087.recognize_zh: 左側血液抹片可見三顆中型淋巴球，核深度分葉成花瓣狀（flower cell），染色質致密、細胞質淡藍；右側臨床照片為足跟皮膚的結痂潰瘍性病灶。花瓣狀多葉核淋巴球合併皮膚病灶，是成人 T 細胞白血病/淋巴瘤的典型組合。
features: Composite: peripheral blood smear (left) and clinical photograph of the foot (right)
Medium-sized lymphoid cells with deeply lobulated, clover-leaf/flower-shaped nuclei
Condensed chromatin without prominent nucleoli; moderate pale basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Clinical photo shows a sharply demarcated, crusted, hyperkeratotic ulcerated plaque on the heel
Background red cells unremarkable; a platelet clump at top
2087.describe_en: The left panel is a peripheral blood smear showing medium-sized abnormal lymphocytes with markedly polylobated, flower-like nuclei, condensed chromatin, absent nucleoli and pale basophilic agranular cytoplasm. The right panel is a clinical photograph of the heel with a well-circumscribed crusted and ulcerated skin lesion. Skin involvement is frequent in adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma. Findings are consistent with adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma ('flower cells'), to be confirmed by CD4+ CD25+ CD7- T-cell immunophenotype and HTLV-1 serology.

ddx.vs: Sézary cells have cerebriform, finely convoluted nuclei rather than discrete petal-like lobes, and HTLV-1 serology is negative.
T-PLL cells have a single visible nucleolus and cytoplasmic blebs with round or irregular nuclei, typically CD7 positive, unlike the CD7-negative lobulated ATLL cells.
Neutrophils have pink granular cytoplasm and thin chromatin bridges between lobes, whereas these cells have agranular blue cytoplasm of lymphocytes.

exam.answer_en: Adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma — polylobated 'flower cell' lymphocytes in blood with an associated crusted ulcerated skin lesion
pearls_zh: 考法：組合圖，考官會先問左側血片細胞名稱（flower cell），再問右側皮膚病灶的意義；答 ATLL 皮膚侵犯常見，需切片確認。
確認：flow 呈 CD4+、CD25+、CD7−（常見）T 細胞；HTLV-1 抗體陽性，並以 proviral DNA 單株整合證實克隆性。
急性型常見高血鈣、LDH 升高、溶骨病灶與器官侵犯；需預防機會性感染（PJP），並篩檢 Strongyloides。
Shimoyama 分型決定治療：acute/lymphoma 型需積極化療並考慮 allogeneic HSCT；indolent 型可觀察或用 zidovudine 合併 interferon-α。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 Sézary syndrome/mycosis fungoides 混淆（同樣 CD4+ 並有皮膚病灶）：Sézary 核為腦迴狀溝紋且 HTLV-1 陰性；ATLL 為花瓣狀分葉核並 HTLV-1 陽性。

quiz.q: 左側血片中花瓣狀核的 T 淋巴球配合右側皮膚病灶，最可能的診斷？應檢驗哪一種病毒？

1959.recognize_zh: 整個視野布滿大量分支、彎曲的小血管，內皮細胞肥厚、管壁淡粉紅，形成樹枝狀的高內皮小靜脈（arborizing HEV）網絡，血管間是小至中型淋巴球的浸潤，部分細胞胞質淡染，是 AITL 教科書式的血管增生表現。
features: Prominent proliferation of arborizing, branching high endothelial venules with plump endothelial cells
Vessel walls with pale eosinophilic, slightly hyalinized material
Dense intervening infiltrate of small to medium lymphocytes with irregular dark nuclei
Some cells with pale to clear cytoplasm clustered around vessels
Nodal architecture effaced without identifiable follicles in this field
1959.describe_en: Lymph node section shows effacement of the architecture by a dense infiltrate of small to medium lymphoid cells, some with pale to clear cytoplasm, set among a prominent network of arborizing high endothelial venules lined by plump endothelial cells with pale eosinophilic walls. No reactive follicles are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma; immunostains for TFH markers and CD21 to highlight expanded perivascular follicular dendritic cell meshworks are recommended.

ddx.vs: Reactive paracortical expansion also contains HEVs but preserves follicles and sinuses and lacks clonal TFH-phenotype T cells and expanded FDC meshworks.
PTCL-NOS lacks the prominent arborizing vasculature with perivascular CD21-positive meshworks and the TFH immunophenotype.

ddx.dx: Kaposi sarcoma or vascular tumor involving node
ddx.vs: Kaposi sarcoma shows spindle cell fascicles with slit-like vascular spaces and HHV-8 LANA positivity rather than lymphoid cells between HEVs.

exam.answer_en: Angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma — effaced node with prominent arborizing high endothelial venules and perivascular clear-cell lymphoid infiltrate
pearls_zh: 考法：指著樹枝狀分支血管問「這是什麼血管？在哪種淋巴瘤最明顯？」答：arborizing high endothelial venules；AITL。
CD21 染色顯示 HEV 周圍擴張、不規則的 follicular dendritic cell meshwork，是 AITL 的重要診斷依據。
單株性：TCR gene rearrangement（PCR）多為陽性；因常伴隨 EBV+ B 細胞，IGH rearrangement 也可能陽性，不可因此誤判為 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
WHO 5th 將 AITL、follicular type 與 NOS 合併歸入 nodal T-follicular helper cell lymphoma 家族，共同特徵為 TFH 表型。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 reactive paracortical hyperplasia：反應性增生也有 HEV，但保留濾泡與淋巴竇、無 clear TFH 細胞團、無擴張 FDC 網，TCR 為多株。

quiz.q: 要證明圖中血管周圍有擴張的 FDC meshwork，應使用哪個 IHC？

1703.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀圖：上圖以低側向散射（SSC）、中等前向散射（FSC）圈出母細胞區（blast gate）；下圖母細胞同時表現 CD13 與 CD19。注意 CD13 屬非系別決定性標記，單靠它不足以診斷混合表型急性白血病（MPAL）。
features: Forward scatter vs side scatter dot plot with an R1 blast gate on the low-SSC, intermediate-FSC population
CD13 (PE) vs CD19 (FITC) plot of gated events
Dominant population in the upper-right quadrant coexpressing CD13 and CD19
Smaller double-negative population in the lower-left quadrant
No MPO, cytoplasmic CD79a or CD22 data shown
1703.describe_en: Flow cytometry dot plots are shown. Blasts are gated in the low side scatter, intermediate forward scatter region (R1), and the gated population coexpresses CD19 and CD13, with a minor CD13-/CD19- population. This demonstrates a B-lineage blast population with aberrant expression of the myeloid-associated antigen CD13. Under current WHO/ICC criteria, CD13 or CD33 expression alone does not establish myeloid lineage; a diagnosis of B/myeloid mixed-phenotype acute leukemia requires MPO positivity (or monocytic differentiation) in addition to B-lineage markers, so these plots alone are most consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia with aberrant myeloid antigen expression.

ddx.dx: B-lymphoblastic leukemia with aberrant myeloid antigen
ddx.vs: CD13/CD33 coexpression is common in B-ALL (notably with ETV6::RUNX1 or BCR::ABL1) and does not change the diagnosis when MPO is negative.
Requires MPO expression (flow or cytochemistry) or clear monocytic differentiation in addition to strong CD19 with CD79a, CD22 or CD10.

ddx.dx: AML with aberrant CD19 (e.g., AML with RUNX1::RUNX1T1)
ddx.vs: Blasts are MPO-positive and usually only weakly or partially CD19-positive without cytoplasmic CD79a or CD22, and often show Auer rods morphologically.

exam.answer_en: Flow cytometry: gated blasts coexpressing CD19 and CD13 — B-lineage blasts with aberrant myeloid antigen; insufficient alone for B/myeloid MPAL (needs MPO)
pearls_zh: 判讀流程：先看 FSC/SSC 圈 blast gate（低 SSC、中 FSC），再看 CD13 對 CD19 四象限；主族群落在右上象限即雙陽性。
考點：CD13、CD33、CD117 非系別決定性（lineage-assigning）標記；B-ALL 常見 CD13/CD33 異常表現，不改變診斷。
MPAL 骨髓系認定：MPO 陽性，或單核球分化（NSE、CD11c、CD14、CD64、lysozyme 其中 ≥2）；B 系需 CD19 加 CD79a、cCD22、CD10 等支持，T 系靠 cytoplasmic CD3。
MPAL 具定義性遺傳亞型：BCR::ABL1 與 KMT2A 重組，需做 FISH/分子；Ph+ MPAL 可加 TKI。
WHO 5th/ICC 2022 對系別標記加入強度要求（如 CD19 強度與其他 B 標記的組合），不能只看陽性百分比。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常把「CD19 + CD13 雙陽性」直接判為 biphenotypic/MPAL；沒有 MPO（或單核球分化證據）時應報告為 B-ALL 合併異常骨髓抗原表現。

quiz.q: 此流式圖中母細胞同時表現 CD19 與 CD13，是否足以診斷 B/myeloid MPAL？還缺哪一個標記？
quiz.a: 不足；需證明 MPO 陽性（或單核球分化），否則為 B-ALL 合併異常 CD13 表現。

1447.recognize_zh: 上方骨髓切片（H&E）與下方抹片中的巨核細胞，細胞核都是單一圓形、不分葉且偏於一側，細胞質豐富，是 del(5q) MDS 典型的非分葉巨核細胞（non-lobated megakaryocytes）。
features: Upper panel (H&E biopsy): megakaryocytes with single round to oval non-lobated nuclei and abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm
Upper panel background: clusters of erythroid precursors with round dense nuclei near fat spaces
Lower panel (aspirate smear): two megakaryocytes with abundant granular cytoplasm and single eccentric round nuclei
Megakaryocytes are normal to slightly reduced in size, not micromegakaryocytes
Adjacent platelets and platelet clumps in the aspirate background
1447.describe_en: Composite of a bone marrow core biopsy section (H&E, upper) and aspirate smear (Wright-Giemsa, lower). In the biopsy, megakaryocytes with single round to oval non-lobated nuclei and abundant cytoplasm are seen among erythroid precursors. The aspirate shows two megakaryocytes of near-normal size with abundant granular cytoplasm and single, eccentric, round nuclei, with nearby platelet clumps. Non-lobated or hypolobated megakaryocytes of normal to slightly reduced size are the characteristic finding of myelodysplastic syndrome with isolated del(5q), and the findings are consistent with that diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Micromegakaryocytes are small with scant cytoplasm and a single small nucleus, whereas del(5q) megakaryocytes retain normal size and abundant cytoplasm.
ET megakaryocytes are large to giant with hyperlobulated staghorn nuclei in loose clusters.
Other MDS show megakaryocytes with multiple widely separated round nuclear lobes rather than one compact round nucleus.
Immature forms have scant basophilic cytoplasm and high N:C ratio rather than abundant mature granular cytoplasm.

exam.answer_en: MDS with isolated del(5q) — non-lobated eccentric megakaryocyte nuclei on both biopsy (H&E) and aspirate
pearls_zh: 考法：切片加抹片對照，考官要你說出兩處巨核細胞共同特徵（單核不分葉、偏位）並連結 del(5q)。
WHO 5th 稱 MDS with low blasts and isolated 5q deletion（MDS-5q）；ICC 2022 稱 MDS with del(5q)。可再合併一個額外異常，但不可為 -7 或 del(7q)。
Lenalidomide 機轉：透過 cereblon 促使 CK1α（CSNK1A1）降解，del(5q) 細胞因 haploinsufficiency 特別敏感；治療初期常見血球低下。
合併 TP53 mutation 者預後較差、較易對 lenalidomide 失去反應，診斷時建議一併檢測 TP53。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 MDS 常見的 separated nuclear lobes 巨核細胞混淆；後者核分成多個分離小葉，del(5q) 則是單一圓核。

quiz.q: 切片與抹片巨核細胞的共同異常為何？應安排哪項檢查確認？
quiz.a: 單核不分葉偏位；骨髓 karyotype（del(5q)）

103.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有大量芽細胞，並散在許多小型、核單葉或雙葉的發育異常巨核細胞（hypolobated micromegakaryocytes）；切片同樣可見小而不分葉的巨核細胞，加上核型 -7 與 MECOM FISH 訊號分離，符合 t(3;3)(q21;q26.2) AML。
features: Increased blasts: medium to large cells with high N:C ratio, round nuclei, fine chromatin and scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm
Numerous small megakaryocytes with non-lobated (monolobated) or bilobed nuclei, seen on both aspirate and biopsy
Hypercellular marrow particle with residual erythroid and granulocytic precursors
Biopsy: sheets of immature mononuclear cells with dispersed chromatin among dysplastic small megakaryocytes; scattered coarse dark-brown to black pigment deposits
Flow (blast gate): CD34+/CD117+ (71%), CD33+/CD13+ (70%), partial CD7, mostly CD11b-negative
Karyotype shows a single chromosome 7 (monosomy 7) with structurally abnormal chromosome 3 homologs; tricolor interphase FISH shows a separated signal pattern suggesting 3q26 (MECOM) rearrangement
103.describe_en: The bone marrow aspirate smear is hypercellular with a prominent population of blasts showing high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm, accompanied by numerous small megakaryocytes with non-lobated or bilobed nuclei. The core biopsy shows increased immature mononuclear cells and many small, hypolobated megakaryocytes, with scattered dark pigment deposits. Flow cytometry of the blast gate demonstrates myeloblasts positive for CD34, CD117, CD33 and CD13 with partial CD7 and largely lacking CD11b. The karyotype shows monosomy 7 with abnormal chromosome 3 homologs, and interphase FISH shows a split signal pattern supporting 3q26 (MECOM) rearrangement. Findings are consistent with relapsed acute myeloid leukemia with t(3;3)(q21.3;q26.2); GATA2::MECOM, with monosomy 7.

ddx.vs: It also has small monolobated megakaryocytes but lacks increased blasts, and cytogenetics shows isolated del(5q) rather than 3q26 rearrangement.
Blasts express CD41/CD61 and often lack CD34, whereas here the blasts are CD34+/CD117+/CD13+/CD33+ myeloblasts with dysplastic mature megakaryocytes.
Multilineage dysplasia with -7 may look similar, but the defining t(3;3)/inv(3) MECOM rearrangement can only be shown by karyotype or FISH.
Megakaryocytes are large, clustered and hyperchromatic with cloud-like nuclei and marrow fibrosis, not small hypolobated forms, and driver JAK2/CALR/MPL mutations are usually present.

103.stain: Wright-Giemsa; H&E; flow cytometry; karyotype; FISH
captions: BM aspirate: increased blasts with numerous small hypolobated megakaryocytes
BM biopsy (H&E): immature cells and small non-lobated megakaryocytes with dark pigment deposits
BM biopsy (H&E): small monolobated and bilobed megakaryocytes among immature cells
Flow CD117 vs CD34 (blast gate): CD34+CD117+ 71.02%
Flow CD7 vs CD34 (blast gate): partial CD7 expression on CD34+ blasts
Flow CD13 vs CD33 (blast gate): CD33+CD13+ 69.81%
Flow CD11b vs CD13 (blast gate): blasts largely CD11b-negative
Karyotype: monosomy 7 with abnormal chromosome 3 homologs
Interphase tricolor FISH with separated signals suggesting 3q26 (MECOM) rearrangement

exam.answer_en: AML with t(3;3)(q21;q26.2) GATA2::MECOM — increased blasts with numerous small mono/bilobed megakaryocytes, monosomy 7, MECOM FISH split
pearls_zh: 考法：芽細胞之間指著小型單葉或雙葉的巨核細胞，問哪種 AML 典型如此，並要你看核型 3 號異常與 MECOM break-apart FISH 分離訊號。
機轉：inv(3)/t(3;3) 使 GATA2 增強子接到 MECOM，導致 MECOM 過度表現；常合併 monosomy 7。
臨床特徵：血小板可正常或上升，芽細胞常 CD34+、CD7 陽性；屬 ELN 2022 adverse risk，適合者應移植。
WHO 5th 歸為 AML with MECOM rearrangement；此重排也可見於 CML 急變期，須檢查 BCR::ABL1。
exam.pitfall_zh: 小型單葉巨核細胞易誤判為 MDS del(5q) 或 AML-MR；以芽細胞比例、核型 3q26 異常與 MECOM FISH 區分。

quiz.q: 此 AML 中哪個基因因 GATA2 增強子重排而過度表現？常合併哪個染色體異常？

39.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大量小至中型母細胞，核質比極高、染色質細緻、細胞質少且呈淡藍色，沒有顆粒或 Auer rods；切片呈 100% 母細胞成片浸潤。免疫染色 CD34、TdT、CD79a（及 CD10）陽性，符合 B 淋巴母細胞白血病復發。
features: Small-to-intermediate blasts with very high N:C ratio and scant agranular pale-blue cytoplasm; no Auer rods
Round to slightly irregular or indented nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous-to-small nucleoli
Core biopsy: near 100% cellular marrow diffusely replaced by monotonous sheets of blasts with mitoses and scattered residual erythroid precursors
IHC: blasts positive for CD34, TdT (nuclear) and CD79a; CD10 positive per caption
Peripheral blood: circulating blasts with marked poikilocytosis including teardrop cells, target cells and ovalocytes
39.describe_en: The peripheral blood smear shows occasional circulating blasts with a high N:C ratio, fine chromatin, and scant basophilic cytoplasm. The red cells show marked anisopoikilocytosis with teardrop cells, target cells, and ovalocytes. The bone marrow aspirate is dominated by small-to-intermediate blasts with scant agranular cytoplasm, round-to-indented nuclei, and finely dispersed chromatin; no Auer rods are seen. The core biopsy is nearly 100% cellular and diffusely replaced by sheets of monotonous blasts, with frequent mitoses and only scattered residual erythroid elements. On immunohistochemistry, the blasts are positive for CD34, TdT, and CD79a, and they are reported as CD10 positive. In this patient with a history of B-lymphoblastic leukemia, findings are consistent with relapsed B-lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: T-ALL blasts look the same on morphology, but they express cytoplasmic CD3 and lack CD79a/CD19/PAX5, whereas these blasts are CD79a positive.
Minimally differentiated AML blasts may also be agranular, but they express CD13, CD33, CD117 and often MPO by flow, and they lack the CD79a/CD10 B-lineage profile seen here.

Hematogones do not form effacing sheets, and they show a continuous maturation spectrum (TdT/CD34 to CD20) by flow cytometry, whereas this marrow is diffusely replaced by a uniform CD34+/TdT+ population.

ddx.dx: Blastoid mantle cell lymphoma / Burkitt lymphoma
ddx.vs: These mature B-cell neoplasms are TdT and CD34 negative (cyclin D1+ in MCL, MYC rearranged with vacuolated cytoplasm in Burkitt), whereas these blasts are TdT and CD34 positive.

39.stain: Wright-Giemsa; H&E; IHC: CD34, TdT, CD79a
captions: Bone marrow aspirate: clusters of blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and scant agranular cytoplasm (Wright-Giemsa)
Peripheral blood: circulating blast with target cells and poikilocytosis
Peripheral blood: two circulating blasts with teardrop cells, target cells and ovalocytes
Core biopsy, medium power: diffuse sheets of blasts replacing the marrow (H&E)
Core biopsy, high power: monotonous blasts with fine chromatin and mitoses, with scattered residual erythroid cells
Core biopsy, highest power: blasts with round-to-indented nuclei, fine chromatin and a mitotic figure
Core biopsy, low power: nearly 100% cellular marrow between bony trabeculae
Composite: H&E with IHC showing blasts positive for CD34, TdT and CD79a (CD10 also positive per caption)

exam.answer_en: Relapsed B-lymphoblastic leukemia — marrow replaced by agranular high N:C blasts, CD34+, TdT+, CD79a+ (CD10+)
pearls_zh: 考法：考官會指無顆粒、高核質比的芽細胞問系別，並問 IHC 組合：TdT（未成熟）＋CD79a/CD19/PAX5（B 系）＋CD34。
復發評估：需流式或 NGS 追蹤 MRD，並重驗遺傳（如 BCR::ABL1、KMT2A）以決定標靶治療。
復發後免疫治療：blinatumomab（CD19×CD3）、inotuzumab ozogamicin（CD22）、CD19 CAR-T；CD19 標靶後可能出現 CD19 陰性復發或系別轉換。
周邊血淚滴細胞提示骨髓被芽細胞塞滿（marrow packing），切片可呈近 100% 細胞量。
exam.pitfall_zh: 治療後骨髓的 hematogones 易被誤認為復發芽細胞：hematogones 在流式呈 CD34→CD10→CD20 連續成熟譜、無異常表現；復發芽細胞為單一族群並帶原診斷的 aberrant 表型。

quiz.q: 確認此芽細胞為 B 系未成熟細胞，IHC 需要哪兩類標記？
quiz.a: 未成熟標記 TdT/CD34，加上 B 系標記 CD79a（或 CD19/PAX5）

1639.recognize_zh: 淋巴組織的免疫組化（標記未標明，蘇木素複染偏重）中，右上方可見一個濾泡（生發中心淡、外圍套區深藍），濾泡間的副皮質區呈淡棕色陽性，並有一條穿越的血管；影像對比不佳、陽性強度弱，只能判讀為分區分布，無法指認標記。
features: Low to intermediate power view of lymphoid tissue with a secondary follicle at upper right
Follicle shows a paler germinal center and a dense, darkly counterstained mantle zone, both largely negative
Faint brown staining concentrated in the interfollicular/paracortical zone (lower half)
A branching vessel traversing the field
Weak chromogen signal and heavy blue counterstain limit interpretation
1639.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (antigen not specified) on normal lymphoid tissue shows a secondary follicle with a pale germinal center and a dense mantle zone that are largely unstained, whereas faint brown positivity is concentrated in the interfollicular and paracortical regions, with a vessel crossing the field. The chromogen signal is weak and the counterstain heavy, so the intensity and subcellular pattern cannot be reliably assessed. The compartmental distribution most closely fits a T-zone marker, but the specific antigen cannot be determined from this image. The findings illustrate preserved normal lymphoid compartmentalization.

1767.recognize_zh: 組合圖中左側為大片胞質豐富淡染、核偏心呈腎形或馬蹄形的大型細胞；右上高倍可見多核、核仁明顯的大型異型細胞；右下低倍為瀰漫片狀浸潤夾纖維帶，這些標誌細胞（hallmark cells）的形態符合間變性大細胞淋巴瘤（ALCL）。
features: Sheets of large cells with abundant pale to clear cytoplasm and distinct cell borders
Eccentric kidney-shaped or horseshoe nuclei (hallmark cell features) in several cells
High-power panel: large atypical cell with multiple nuclei and prominent eosinophilic nucleoli
Vesicular chromatin with conspicuous nucleoli in many tumor cells
Low-power panel: diffuse cohesive-appearing infiltrate traversed by a fibrous band
Scattered small lymphocytes and occasional red cells between tumor cells
1767.describe_en: Composite H&E images show a diffuse infiltrate of large atypical cells with abundant pale to clear cytoplasm, vesicular chromatin, and prominent nucleoli, many with eccentric kidney- or horseshoe-shaped nuclei characteristic of hallmark cells. At high power, a large multinucleated cell with prominent eosinophilic nucleoli resembling a Reed-Sternberg-like cell is present, and at low power the tumor forms sheets separated by fibrous bands. The cohesive growth may mimic carcinoma. Findings are consistent with anaplastic large cell lymphoma; strong uniform CD30 and ALK immunostaining (with loss of pan-T markers and EMA positivity) are required to confirm ALK-positive ALCL.

ddx.vs: CHL has scattered Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells in a mixed inflammatory background and is CD15+, PAX5 weak, and ALK negative, rather than sheets of CD30+ hallmark cells.
Carcinoma is cytokeratin positive and melanoma is S100/SOX10 positive, whereas ALCL is CD30+ with T-cell or null phenotype.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, anaplastic variant
ddx.vs: Anaplastic DLBCL expresses CD20 and PAX5, while ALCL lacks B-cell markers.

ddx.dx: ALK-negative ALCL or PTCL-NOS with CD30 expression
ddx.vs: ALK-negative ALCL is morphologically identical and requires ALK immunostain; PTCL-NOS shows variable rather than strong uniform CD30.

exam.answer_en: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma — sheets of large pleomorphic cells with horseshoe/kidney-shaped nuclei (hallmark cells) on H&E
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指腎形或馬蹄形偏心核的大細胞，問名稱與必做 IHC；答 hallmark cells，需做 CD30（膜與 Golgi 強陽性、一致）與 ALK。
ALK+ ALCL 最常見 t(2;5)(p23;q35) NPM1::ALK，ALK 染色呈核加胞質陽性；其他伙伴基因多僅胞質陽性。常見 EMA+、cytotoxic 標記（TIA-1、granzyme B、perforin）陽性，並常失去 CD3 等 pan-T 標記。
ALK+ ALCL 多見於兒童與年輕人，預後優於 ALK− ALCL；ALK− ALCL 中 DUSP22 rearrangement 與 TP63 rearrangement 具預後意義。
治療：CD30+ PTCL 包含 ALCL，第一線可用 brentuximab vedotin 合併 CHP（BV-CHP）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 classic Hodgkin lymphoma 或轉移性癌；ALCL 為成片 CD30 一致強陽性、CD15 通常陰性，且 cohesive 生長與竇內浸潤易像 carcinoma，需以 cytokeratin 與 CD30／ALK 區分。

quiz.q: 圖中馬蹄形核的大細胞叫什麼？ALK+ ALCL 最常見的染色體易位為何？
